raw.title: Social Media Strategist (Pro Bono)
raw.excerpt: Professors Without Borders (PROWIBO) is an international charity dedicated to improving access to quality higher education worldwide.
raw.description:
Professors Without Borders (PROWIBO) is an international charity dedicated to improving access to quality higher education worldwide. Inspired by the model of Doctors Without Borders, we deploy volunteer educators to partner institutions across the Global South. Our work contributes directly to UN Sustainable Development Goal 4: Quality Education.

Operating in over 16 countries and with a growing online community of 8,000+ followers, PROWIBO delivers teaching, mentoring, and capacity-building programmes that expand opportunities for students often overlooked by mainstream systems.

The Role

We are seeking a volunteer Social Media Strategist to shape the next phase of PROWIBO’s digital presence.

This is a voluntary, pro bono role suited to an experienced communications professional who wishes to use their skills for global impact. You will lead our social media strategy, help us tell powerful human stories, and grow our international reach.

This is a hands-on leadership role with scope to introduce new tools, workflows, and ideas, while guiding a small team of volunteer contributors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver a cross-platform content strategy aligned with PROWIBO’s mission.

  • Manage and grow our presence on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and X.

  • Create engaging, original content that highlights our impact and stories.

  • Mentor and support a small team of volunteer social media contributors.

  • Introduce systems for planning, scheduling, and tracking performance.

  • Monitor trends and strengthen engagement with online communities.

  • Report on progress and adjust strategies based on insights.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience managing brand or nonprofit social media.

  • Strong track record in content strategy, audience growth, and storytelling.

  • Proficiency with scheduling tools, analytics, and basic design tools.

  • Experience mentoring or managing junior colleagues or volunteers.

  • Excellent writing and editing skills.

  • Strong organisational and project management abilities.

  • Alignment with PROWIBO’s mission and values.

What We Offer (Voluntary Role)

  • A leadership opportunity to shape the digital voice of an international nonprofit.

  • A meaningful volunteer experience aligned with UN SDGs.

  • Flexible, remote role with global visibility.

  • Opportunity to mentor and build capacity in a small team.

  • Belonging to a diverse network of educators and changemakers.

Commitment

This is a volunteer position. Hours are flexible, and we are mindful of professional and personal commitments. The aim is to contribute skills with impact, without an excessive time burden.

raw.title: Full-Stack Engineer
raw.excerpt: About the JobAs a Full-Stack Engineer at Splitero, you will play a crucial role in architecting, developing, and maintaining our software from marketing through origination.
raw.description:
About the Job

As a Full-Stack Engineer at Splitero, you will play a crucial role in architecting, developing, and maintaining our software from marketing through origination. Your expertise in modern back-end technologies, cloud computing, and the full software development lifecycle will be essential in delivering high-quality solutions in a fintech and proptech ecosystem. You will work closely with product, engineering, and QA teams to ensure our software meets the highest standards of functionality and performance while we scale our operations to meet team and organization goals. As an individual contributor, you will be able to balance pace with perfection and understand tradeoffs in how you deliver your work.

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient back-end systems using Node, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Develop APIs and services that support robust application functionality.
  • Utilize PostgreSQL to design and manage databases, ensuring data integrity and optimizing performance across a Heroku Connect/Salesforce-based data infrastructure.
  • Develop and deploy serverless applications using AWS Lambda and IaC platforms such as Terraform and AWS CDK.
  • Work with AI technologies for both your day-to-day role as an engineer and also for new product implementations, leveraging APIs with major AI platforms
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate back-end services with a modern React ecosystem (, Tailwind, Vercel, etc), ensuring a seamless and responsive user experience.
  • Participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Work closely with product managers and QA teams to gather requirements, identify issues, and deliver high-quality software solutions.
  • Maintain a high level of attention to detail, ensuring that software is reliable, efficient, and meets established standards and specifications.
  • Stay current with industry trends and technologies, recommending improvements and adopting best practices for software development and cloud computing.

The salary range for this position is $140,000 - $155,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

About You

  • 4-6 years of experience as a full-stack engineer with a strong focus on back-end technologies
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript for front-end and back-end development
  • Strong experience with Node.js for building server-side applications
  • Expertise in PostgreSQL (or similar) and database design
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms, specifically AWS Lambda
  • Extensive experience working with Claude Code (or similar) to build tools and workflows that accelerate the development lifecycle; not just individual chat use or vibe coding
  • Hands-on experience working with Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation
  • Experience implementing and working with modern analytics tools for event tracking and reporting (Mixpanel, Posthog, Google Analytics, etc)
  • Strong experience working with testing and quality engineering tools such as Playwright, Jest, and/or Mocha
  • Solid understanding of modern cloud computing pipelines and the full software development lifecycle
  • Proven experience working directly with product and QA teams to ensure high-quality software delivery
  • Experience with Heroku Connect and Salesforce platforms is a plus
  • Candidates must be located in the United States. Working timezone in PST or MST preferred.
  • Ability to break down complex technical problems and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Effective communication skills and a track record of collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Desire to participate in fast-paced early-stage startup
  • Adaptability: Embraces changing circumstances with resiliency and positivity
  • Team-Oriented: Prioritizes collaboration, inclusivity, and teammate support

About Us

Millions of homeowners in today’s economy are sitting on substantial home equity they are unable to access due to rising interest rates and strict qualification requirements of traditional lenders. That means millions of homeowners can’t convert their hard-earned equity into cash to pay off debt, start a home renovation, or pad their retirement to better their lives.

Splitero co-founders Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler witnessed the problem firsthand throughout their real estate careers. They set out to create a win-win product that could help those homeowners access their home equity but not make monthly payments like traditional financing options. And thus, Splitero was born.

As part of our team, you will join our quest to revolutionize the real estate industry while helping families in need. We offer a suite of benefits designed to help you thrive in all areas of life.

  • OneTeam Culture - We foster a culture of transparency, innovation, and inclusivity, where every voice is heard and every team member is valued. We believe in celebrating our successes, doing the right thing, and helping each other so we grow as a team and as individuals.
  • Generous Resources - We want to ensure you are set up to do your best work. In addition to a solid tech stack, and access to any WeWork location, you will receive a monthly cell and internet stipend.
  • Premium Healthcare - We offer comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family, which employees are eligible for on their first day.
  • Flexible PTO and Parental Leave - We offer a generous PTO and encourage employees to take time off to recharge. We're proud to offer a parental leave policy that allows you to welcome your new addition without worry.

We are a workforce composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds, abilities, minds, and identities. In keeping with our commitment to inclusion, we will ensure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are required when applying, interviewing, or performing the essential functions of this position, please contact People Operations, at .

raw.description:
Job Title: HEDIS Auditor Trainee
Job Types: Part-time, Seasonal.

Candidates must be able to commit to 20-40 hours per week during training and throughout the entire HEDIS season

Shift Hours: Applicant should be available to work from 6 AM to 6 PM EST.

This is a remote position available to candidates located within the United States. Applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.

Pay Structure:

  • The training pay rate is $25 per hour
  • Post Training completion, the pay rate increases to $30 per hour

HEDIS Auditor Trainee – Onshore

Remote position, reporting to HEDIS QA Manager during training phase.

HEDIS auditor trainee is responsible for learning and applying the concepts of HEDIS based on HEDIS Technical Specifications and client guidance as portrayed in Advantmed training material.

This role involves training on HEDIS measures, which includes all recorded measure trainings, recorded demo records to ensure an understanding on how to abstract in the tool, any recorded supplemental training, supplemental and measure training assessments, and test records in the training portal.

This role is a prerequisite for the auditor position where you will be providing knowledge transfer of the information you learned during training, to abstractors during their training phase and during the live season.

  • Must acquire a base score of 97.5% overall.
  • Complete all training in the defined timeline.
  • Must attempt all training as scheduled in the HEDIS training planner which will be provided on Day 1 of your training or communicate to HEDIS Manager with any changes in schedule.
  • Must have a professional attitude and willingness to learn.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2 years/seasons of experience in HEDIS Abstraction / Review
  • Medical Coder Certification: CPC, CCS, RHIT, RHIA through AAPC or AHIMA OR
  • Licensed Nurse: LPN, LVN, RN with an active license

raw.excerpt: Why MSI?  We thrive on solving challenges.  As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer and reinsurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs.
raw.description:
Why MSI? We thrive on solving challenges.


As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer and reinsurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs.


We have a passion for crafting solutions for the important risks facing individuals and businesses. We offer an expanding suite of products – from fully-digital embedded renters coverage to high-value homeowners insurance to sophisticated commercial coverages, such as cyber liability and habitational property – delivered through agents, brokers, wholesalers and other brand partners.


Our partners and customers count on us to deliver exceptional service through a dedicated team that makes rapid resolutions a priority. We simplify the insurance experience through our advanced technology platform that supports every phase of the policy lifecycle. Since its founding in 2015, MSI has grown to offer a wide range of insurance products across commercial, specialty, and personal lines and has reached over $1 billion of in-force premium in its nationwide portfolio.


Bring on your challenges and let us show you how we build insurance better.


As we expand our in-house renters claims handling capabilities, we’re seeking a Claims Examiner who is excited to be part of a growing team where renters claims experience is highly valued.


MSI handles third-party claims involving bodily injury and property damage under various homeowner’s insurance policies and renter’s insurance policies nationwide. We are looking for an experienced individual to join our Liability Claims Team as a Claims Examiner focused on Renters Liability Claims. The Claims Examiner will be managing insurance claims for our policyholders with low to moderate severity and complexity. The Claims Examiner must have the experience and technical knowledge to manage a caseload from inception to resolution while providing our customers and business partners with superior service at all times. The ability to build relationships and communicate effectively is a key factor in succeeding in this role. Having a strategic vision coupled with tactical execution to deliver results aligned with goals and objectives is critical to the overall success of this position. The Claims Examiner must be able to work with little to minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment. Previous renters' liability claim handling was a plus but not required.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Directly handles third-party bodily injury and property damage claims involving low to moderate complexity from initial assignment through to resolution of claim, including negotiating settlements.
  • Evaluates and analyzes insurance policies to make coverage determinations.
  • Drafts Reservation of Rights letters and coverage disclaimers as warranted.
  • Makes prompt contact with policyholders, claimants, and other appropriate parties to gather information, take recorded statements, and conduct thorough investigations.
  • Investigates claims to determine validity and the potential for liability against insureds.
  • Evaluates damages (both bodily injuries and property damages) to determine potential exposures and sets appropriate reserves.
  • Works a claim load efficiently and independently with little to no supervision.
  • Sets timely file reserves in compliance with the company’s reserving philosophy and continues to evaluate pending reserves throughout the life of the claim.
  • Manage defense counsel, which includes assisting in claim strategy, evaluating potential exposure, reviewing invoices, and attending mediations and settlement conferences as necessary.
  • Engages experts, as needed, to assist in the evaluation of the claim and monitors experts and vendors’ performance while controlling expenses.
  • Drafts reports for large losses and reports to leadership as required.
  • Evaluates, negotiates, and determines settlement values in settlement of claims.
  • Communicates with all interested parties throughout the life of the claim, including proactively discussing coverage decisions, the need for additional information, and settlement amounts with interested parties.
  • Establishes and maintains an organized diary system to ensure all claims are appropriately handled in a timely manner.
  • Adheres to all state/local regulations, including the NJ/PA Unfair Claims Practices and Guidelines.
  • Handles all claims in accordance with best practices and provides best-in-class customer service to insureds, agents, claimants, and business partners.
  • Responsible for monitoring and completing assigned claims inventory.
  • Acquires and maintains multiple state adjuster’s licenses and maintains continuing education requirements.
  • Develops and maintains relationships with external and internal stakeholders.
  • Identifies questionable risks, red flags, and fraud indicators and alerts the Special Investigation Unit when applicable.
  • Identifies opportunities for subrogation and ensures recovery interests are protected.
  • Acts as a mentor for less experienced Claims Examiners.
  • Updates and maintains well drafted claim file notes with proper documentation throughout the life of the file.
  • Assists with special projects when required.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and provide superior customer service over the phone and through written correspondence.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong writing skills.
  • Excellent analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, Teams, Word, Excel, and various other computer skills with the ability to learn and utilize new computer systems and other technologies.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of casualty claims adjusting experience
  • First-Party Property experience is a plus
  • Insurance designations preferred
  • Must have a State Adjuster License(s) (California, Florida, and Texas licenses are desirable) with willingness to expand licenses as needed

AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

The Director of Client Operations is responsible for the strategic leadership, organizational design, and financial stewardship of the Client Operations function within an assigned region. Reporting to the VP of Operations and aligned to the EVP of Sales, this leader ensures operational rigor, forecasting discipline, and margin protection across their regional sales segment.

In addition to regional accountability, each Director partners closely with peer Directors to ensure consistent governance standards, coverage models, and operational practices across the broader Client Operations organization. This role balances regional ownership with enterprise-wide functional alignment to support scalable growth and financial discipline.

Duties / Responsibilities

    Regional Leadership & Organizational Design

    • Lead and develop Senior Managers and Managers within the assigned region

    • Design and continuously refine regional coverage models aligned to revenue growth and segment complexity

    • Evaluate span-of-control, workload distribution, and structural alignment

    • Drive succession planning and leadership bench development

    • Partner with regional Sales Leadership to ensure operational alignment and execution readiness

    • Lead during periods of Financial Close, End of Month/Quarter/Year. Marshalling resources to achieve results during high stress, time constraint periods.

    Operational Governance, Forecast Discipline & Salesforce Integrity

    • Establish and maintain regional quote-to-cash governance standards aligned to enterprise frameworks

    • Ensure disciplined Salesforce hygiene standards are consistently reinforced across teams

    • Own regional oversight of month-end Salesforce activities, including opportunity updates, stage accuracy, close date integrity, and required documentation compliance

    • Ensure forecasting cadence and pipeline validation processes are consistently executed by Managers

    • Identify systemic forecast volatility, revenue timing risks, or margin exposure trends within the region

    • Escalate material operational or financial risks to leadership

    • Monitor recurring booking errors, documentation gaps, or process inefficiencies and drive structural corrective action

    • Sponsor regional and enterprise workflow improvements and system enhancements to increase scalability and execution consistency

    Sales Partnership & Cross-Functional Alignment

    • Serve as the senior Client Operations partner to regional Sales Leadership, including Managing Directors and EVP alignment

    • Maintain regular cadence with Sales Leadership regarding pipeline health, forecasting discipline, coverage effectiveness, and operational readiness

    • Provide structured operational insights to support Sales in achieving financial objectives

    • Oversee resolution of high-impact escalations related to opportunity management, forecasting integrity, booking compliance, product delivery coordination, AP/AR exposure, and revenue recognition considerations

    • Partner closely with Finance to ensure margin protection, compliance with revenue recognition standards, and financial stability

    • Partner with Alliances to interpret OEM, distributor, and partner program structures and translate program requirements into scalable operational processes and governance standards

    • Ensure partner program incentives, rebates, special pricing agreements, and funding mechanisms are operationalized in alignment with internal booking policies, margin guidelines, and revenue recognition standards

    • Partner with peer Directors to ensure consistent Client Operations standards and escalation frameworks across regions

    • *Other job duties as assigned

Education and Experience

    • Bachelor’s degree required

    • 7+ years in Sales Operations, Client Operations, Finance, or Sales Support

    • 4+ years people leadership experience preferred

    • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives or transformation efforts

    • Experience in technology reseller strongly preferred

Knowledge, Skills , Abilities

    • Strong people leadership and talent development capabilities

    • Organizational design and capacity planning expertise

    • Polished presentation and communication skills suitable for senior sales leadership engagement

    • Strong business and financial acumen

    • Systems thinking and operational governance mindset

    • Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

    • Experience leading change management initiatives

    • Strong analytical and reporting capability

    • Ability to operate effectively in high-pressure, sales-driven environments

Physical Requirements

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions, in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), the Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA), and other applicable federal, state, and local laws.

    • Work Environment: Ability to perform job duties at customer sites or in data center environments which may include:

    • Standing, walking, bending, and lifting or moving equipment weight up to fifty (50) pounds.

    • Working in areas with fluctuating temperatures, including warm and cold environments, both indoors and outdoors.

    • Exposure to production environments that may include higher noise levels, bright lighting, and varying airflow.

raw.description:
Every enterprise field sales team runs on a CRM or ERP that a partner implemented. Too often, those systems never reflect what actually happens in the field. Donna closes that gap, and partners choose Donna because it makes the technology they implement actually get used. That is why partnerships sit at the core of how we grow.

As our first Partnership Manager in the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), you’ll own that motion locally. You won’t start from scratch. You’ll build on an existing partner network, grow it, and win the systems integrators and technology partners who will carry Donna into the CRM and ERP projects of enterprise field sales teams. Then you’ll close deals with them, side by side.

You’ll report to our Head of Partnerships and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product and our GTM engineer, with a real say in how our partner program takes shape as Donna scales across Europe.

What you'll be doing

  • Source new partners. This is a big part of the job. Hunt for and win new systems integrators across the SAP, Salesforce and MS Dynamics ecosystems, and build a partner pipeline the way a sales team builds a customer pipeline.

  • Grow the partnerships we already have. Broaden the relationships with our existing partners. Attend events together, get more joint pipeline, and more live deals out of the partners already in place.

  • Onboard and enable partners. You’ll set Donna up in each partner’s own environment so they can demo it and run pilots themselves. You’ll also train their teams on Donna’s value and how to pitch it, supported by playbooks and joint messaging.

  • Close deals with partners. Co-sell through deal registration and joint account plans, and work with Sales and Solution Engineering to take partner deals to signature.

  • Go to market jointly. Build joint business plans with Tier 1 partners and a lighter program for Tier 2. That includes joint campaigns, webinars and events, and a presence at key conferences.

  • Automate and report. Use Claude and other AI tools to run campaigns and reporting, keep HubSpot accurate (with Donna doing some of the heavy lifting 🙋‍♀️), and feed partner insights back to Product and Sales.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in a commercial or partnership role in B2B SaaS or AI, with a track record of closing deals through partners.

  • Experience in co-selling with systems integrators or consultancies. SAP, Salesforce or Microsoft ecosystem experience is a big plus.

  • Native German and fluent English.

  • A builder who enjoys opening doors, is credible with executives and frontline sales teams, and who owns theirtargets, deals and calendar.

  • Hands-on with AI tools (like Claude), HubSpot and marketing automation, so you can set up and run campaigns yourself

  • Self-driven and at home working remotely, with regular trips to Ghent. Willing to travel regularly to conferences, partner events.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You know every existing partner in the region, you have a clear Tier 1 and Tier 2 plan, and your first partner-sourced opportunities are (getting) converted.

  • First 6 months: Your Tier 1 partners run joint business plans with certified consultants, new integrators have been signed and onboarded, and partners deliver a repeatable stream of sourced and influenced deals in the region.

What you can expect

  • A category in the making. Field AI is a new category of enterprise software, and you’ll define how it reaches the market in your region. The partner program you build becomes the blueprint for every region that follows.

  • Enterprise-grade partners and customers. You’ll work with leading systems integrators across the SAP, Salesforce and Microsoft ecosystems, bringing Donna to global companies in manufacturing, medtech, consumer goods, energy and more.

  • Room to grow as we scale. We’re a team of 40+, growing quickly across Europe and the US. As partnerships grow, so will your scope and your team.

  • People who have done this before. Our founders have built and exited enterprise software companies twice, and our leadership team has scaled fast-growing SaaS companies from the inside. You’ll work side by side with our Head of Partnerships and GTM leadership.

  • Remote in Germany, international by default. You’ll work remotely, with a German office on the way, alongside colleagues, partners and customers in Ghent, across Europe and in New York.

  • Rewards that reflect the stakes. A competitive salary and equity through our ESOP, so everyone shares in what we build.

  • A team that invests in itself. An annual company retreat and regular team events that bring the whole team together.

Highlights

Grow our partner network as Donna’s first Partnership Manager in DACH: win integrators across the SAP, Salesforce & Dynamics ecosystems and co-sell with them side by side.

raw.description:
SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst — Flosum

About Flosum

Flosum is a Salesforce-native platform company delivering enterprise-grade DevOps, data protection, and security solutions to some of the world's largest organizations. Our product portfolio spans Cloud DevOps, Data Migrator, Data Masking, Data Backup, Org Security, Cloud Trust Center, and Sandbox Synchronization — all built natively on the Salesforce platform. We serve enterprise customers across technology, energy, financial services, healthcare, and federal government. Flosum is a growth-stage company operating with the intensity and speed of a startup backed by the discipline of a mature operator.

The Role

We're hiring a SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst who will own the measurement layer of our entire business. You will be the person who knows every number — ARR, net retention, expansion, churn, pipeline conversion, cost of acquisition, gross margin by product line, services margin, cash flow, and everything in between. You'll work across Salesforce (our CRM and billing system of record) and QuickBooks (our financial system) to build a unified, always-current picture of company performance.

This is not a reporting role. This is an analytical role where you connect revenue operations data to financial outcomes and surface the insights that drive decisions at the CEO level.

What You'll Own

You will build and maintain our SaaS metrics infrastructure — ARR waterfall, cohort retention analysis, revenue recognition schedules, deferred revenue tracking, and unit economics by segment. You will reconcile Salesforce bookings data against QuickBooks revenue entries and ensure we have a single source of truth across both systems. You will produce monthly and quarterly financial and revenue packages for leadership, including variance analysis against plan. You will model scenarios for pricing changes, product bundling, geographic expansion, and headcount investment. You will monitor pipeline health and translate pipeline data into revenue forecasts with documented assumptions. You will own the data integrity between our CRM and accounting systems, flagging discrepancies before they compound. You will support board-level and investor-level reporting with clean, defensible metrics.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have three-plus years of experience in SaaS financial analysis, revenue operations, or FP&A at a B2B software company. You are deeply proficient in Salesforce — not as a user, but as someone who understands opportunity objects, product schedules, contract structures, and reporting at a data level. You are equally proficient in QuickBooks Online, including chart of accounts design, revenue categorization, journal entries, and reconciliation workflows. You understand ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and can apply them to a multi-product SaaS business with annual and multi-year contracts. You can build financial models from scratch in Excel or Google Sheets — not from templates, from logic. You think in terms of cohorts, not just totals. You understand the difference between bookings, billings, and revenue, and you can explain why each matters. You are precise, skeptical of your own numbers, and obsessive about data integrity.

Preferred

Experience at a company with a mix of subscription revenue and professional services. Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ or native Salesforce quoting and contract objects. Exposure to investor or board reporting at a growth-stage company. Experience with Marketo or HubSpot data as it relates to CAC and attribution modeling.

Why Flosum

You'll report directly into the CEO's operating rhythm. Your work will not sit in a queue — it will shape hiring plans, product investment, and go-to-market strategy in real time. Flosum is building the definitive platform for Salesforce lifecycle management, and we need someone who can measure every dimension of that growth with precision.

title: IT Audit Associate - Digital Risk Services
description: WHO WE AREElliott Davis pairs forward-thinking tax, assurance and consulting services with industry-leading workplace culture.

raw.title: IT Audit Associate - Digital Risk Services
raw.excerpt: WHO WE AREElliott Davis pairs forward-thinking tax, assurance and consulting services with industry-leading workplace culture.
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Elliott Davis pairs forward-thinking tax, assurance and consulting services with industry-leading workplace culture. Our nine offices — located in the fastest growing cities in the US — are built on a foundation of inclusivity, collaboration, and collective growth. We work daily to provide exceptional service to our people, customers, and our communities. Audit and assurance services are provided by Elliott Davis, LLC(doing business in NC and D.C. as Elliott Davis, PLLC), a licensed CPA firm.

The IT Audit Associate supports the execution of IT audit, technology risk, and assurance engagements. Working as part of an engagement team, the Associate assists in understanding technology environments, identifying and assessing technology risks, evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of controls, and documenting audit procedures and conclusions.


The Associate will gain hands-on experience with IT General Controls (ITGCs), automated and application controls, key reports, SOC reports, and other technology-dependent controls. This role provides opportunities to work directly with client personnel, develop technical and professional skills, and build a strong foundation in IT audit, technology risk, and assurance.


Key Responsibilities


IT Audit, Risk & Controls

  • Assist in the planning and execution of IT audit, technology risk, and assurance engagements, including IT General Controls (ITGCs), internal IT audits, SOX 404 support, SOC 1 and SOC 2 engagements, and other technology risk assessments.
  • Develop an understanding of clients' business processes, technology environments, systems, infrastructure, and relevant technology risks and controls.
  • Participate in process and control walkthroughs with client stakeholders to understand and document technology processes and control environments.
  • Assist in identifying technology risks and the controls designed to mitigate those risks, including their impact on business processes and the financial reporting control environment, as applicable.
  • Perform procedures to evaluate the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of technology controls under the guidance of senior engagement team members.
  • Test ITGCs across enterprise applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments, including relevant logical access, change management, and IT operations controls.
  • Assist with testing automated controls, application controls, key reports, interfaces, and other IT-dependent controls supporting business processes and audit objectives.
  • Review SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports for third-party service providers and assist in evaluating relevant control objectives, complementary user entity controls, exceptions, and their impact on the client's control environment.
  • Support technology advisory and risk engagements associated with system implementations, technology initiatives, and significant process or system changes.
  • Analyze audit evidence and assist in identifying potential control deficiencies, technology risks, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Assist the engagement team in developing practical recommendations to strengthen controls, mitigate risks, and improve processes.

Engagement Execution & Documentation

  • Prepare clear, accurate, and well-supported audit workpapers in accordance with applicable methodology, professional standards, and engagement requirements.
  • Obtain, organize, and evaluate client documentation and audit evidence for accuracy, completeness, and relevance.
  • Document walkthroughs, testing procedures, evidence obtained, results, and conclusions in a clear and concise manner.
  • Apply professional skepticism and sound judgment when performing assigned audit procedures.
  • Identify exceptions, unusual circumstances, or potential issues and communicate them promptly to senior engagement team members.
  • Develop working knowledge of relevant AICPA, PCAOB, and other applicable professional standards and guidance based on assigned engagements.
  • Incorporate review comments and feedback into workpapers and use feedback to continuously improve audit execution and documentation.
  • Complete assigned engagement responsibilities in accordance with established schedules, budgets, milestones, and quality expectations.

Client & Team Responsibilities

  • Develop effective professional relationships with client personnel and engagement team members.
  • Communicate professionally with client contacts when requesting documentation, scheduling walkthroughs, performing testing, and following up on outstanding items.
  • Provide timely updates on assigned responsibilities, potential issues, and engagement progress to Senior Associates, Managers, and other engagement leaders.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members and contribute to a positive, inclusive, and supportive team environment.
  • Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and consistently deliver on commitments to clients and colleagues.
  • Seek and apply coaching and feedback to strengthen technical, audit, documentation, project management, and client-service skills.
  • Participate in professional development, technical training, and other learning opportunities to expand knowledge of emerging technologies, risks, regulations, and professional standards.

Qualifications


Education

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Accounting Information Systems, Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • Master's degree in Information Systems, Accounting, Cybersecurity, or another relevant discipline.

For candidates completing their undergraduate degree, relevant internships or coursework in IT audit, information systems, cybersecurity, accounting, internal audit, or risk management are beneficial.


Experience

Required:

  • 0 to 2 years of professional experience in IT audit, technology risk, IT assurance, internal audit, public accounting, management consulting, cybersecurity, information technology, or a related field.
  • Foundational understanding of information technology, internal controls, information systems, or audit and risk concepts through professional experience, internships, or relevant academic coursework.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, written communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage assigned responsibilities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a team environment.

Preferred:

  • Internship or professional experience in public accounting, professional services, internal audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, or management consulting.
  • Exposure to ITGCs, including logical access, change management, and IT operations.
  • Familiarity with SOX 404 compliance and technology controls supporting financial reporting.
  • Exposure to automated controls, application controls, key reports, interfaces, or other IT-dependent controls.
  • Familiarity with enterprise applications, technology infrastructure, or cloud environments.
  • Exposure to SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports or third-party risk assessments.
  • Familiarity with AICPA or PCAOB auditing standards or other applicable professional standards.

Preferred Certifications

Professional certifications are not required upon entry. Candidates who have obtained or are actively pursuing relevant certifications are encouraged to apply. Relevant certifications include:

  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
  • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
  • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
  • Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
  • ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer
  • Other relevant technology, cybersecurity, audit, or risk certifications

Core Competencies

Successful IT Audit Associates will demonstrate:

  • Foundational understanding of technology, risk, internal controls, and audit concepts.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a desire to understand how technology supports business processes and introduces or mitigates risk.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Ability to learn new technologies, systems, methodologies, and concepts quickly.
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to ask thoughtful questions and appropriately escalate issues.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work both independently on assigned responsibilities and collaboratively within an engagement team.
  • Receptiveness to coaching and constructive feedback.
  • Professionalism and sound judgment when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Commitment to continuous learning as technologies, risks, regulations, and professional standards evolve.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US

We believe that when our employees are able to thrive in all facets of life, their work and impact are that much greater.
That's right – all aspects of life, not just your life as an employee, because we understand that there's life beyond your job. Here are some of the ways our work works for your life, your growth, and your well-being:
• generous time away and paid firm holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s

• flexible work schedules

• 16 weeks of paid maternity and adoption leave, 8 weeks of paid parental leave, 4 weeks of paid and caregiver leave (once eligible)
• first-class health and wellness benefits, including wellness coaching and mental health counseling
• one-on-one professional coaching
• Leadership and career development programs
• access to Beyond: a one-of-a kind program with experiences that help you expand your life, personally and professionally

NOTICE TO 3RD PARTY RECRUITERS
Notice to Recruiters and Agencies regarding unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions without prior express written approval. Resumes submitted or candidates referred to any employee of Elliott Davis by any external recruiter or recruitment agency by any means (including but not limited to via Internet, e-mail, fax, U.S. mail, and/or verbal communications) without a properly executed written contract for a specified position by an authorized member of the Talent Acquisition team become the property of Elliott Davis. Elliott Davis will not be responsible for, or owe any fees associated with, referrals of those candidates and/or for submission of any information, including resumes, associated with individuals.

ADA REQUIREMENTS
The physical and cognitive/mental requirements and the work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Requirements
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:
• Regularly required to remain in a stationary position; use hands repetitively to operate standard office equipment; and to talk or hear, both in person and by telephone
• Required to have specific vision abilities which include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Cognitive/Mental Requirements
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:
• Use written and oral communication skills.
• Read and interpret data, information, and documents.

• Observe and interpret situations.

• Work under deadlines with frequent interruptions; and
• Interact with internal and external customers and others in the course of work.

description: The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments is responsible for leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across insurance and investment businesses.

raw.title: The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments
raw.excerpt: The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments is responsible for leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across insurance and investment businesses.
raw.description:
The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments is responsible for leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across insurance and investment businesses. The role focuses on driving organizational change, digital transformation, operational modernization, business process optimization, and strategic growth. The CTO works closely with executive leadership to modernize business models, improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experience, and strengthen the organization's competitive position in the financial services industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Transformation Strategy: Develop and execute enterprise-wide transformation strategies aligned with corporate objectives and long-term business growth.
  • Digital Transformation: Lead digitalization initiatives, technology adoption, automation, AI integration, and modernization of insurance and investment platforms.
  • Business Process Optimization: Review and redesign operational processes across underwriting, claims, policy administration, investment operations, and customer service.
  • Organizational Transformation: Lead organizational restructuring, change management, workforce transformation, and cultural development initiatives.
  • Insurance Transformation: Modernize insurance distribution, product development, claims processing, underwriting workflows, and customer engagement.
  • Investment Transformation: Improve investment operations, portfolio administration, reporting systems, data analytics, and investment management processes.
  • Strategic Execution: Collaborate with the CEO, COO, CFO, CSO, and business unit heads to translate strategic priorities into transformation programs.
  • Technology & Innovation: Identify emerging technologies, fintech solutions, InsurTech platforms, and digital investment solutions to improve business performance.
  • Performance & Governance: Establish transformation KPIs, monitor project delivery, manage budgets, and ensure effective governance across transformation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management: Engage senior executives, technology partners, regulators, consultants, and external stakeholders to ensure successful transformation delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • MBA, master's degree in digital transformation, technology management, or business strategy preferred.
  • Typically 12–18+ years of experience in financial services, insurance, investments, digital transformation, or enterprise change management.
  • Significant executive leadership experience managing large-scale organizational or digital transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial technology, and digital business models.
  • Proven experience in business process reengineering, automation, technology implementation, and organizational restructuring.
  • Experience managing complex transformation portfolios, cross-functional teams, and multimillion-dollar initiatives.
  • Excellent strategic planning, change leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful delivery of enterprise transformation programs.
  • Operational efficiency and process improvement.
  • Digital adoption and automation rates.
  • Reduction in operational costs and processing time.
  • Improved customer experience and service delivery.
  • Technology modernization and system integration.
  • Transformation project delivery within budget and timelines.
  • Revenue growth and business performance improvements resulting from transformation initiatives.

Are you ready to unlock multi-million dollar opportunities across enterprise global accounts with an industry leader in digital transformation? Trimble is seeking an agile, strategic business development leader to bridge the global-to-regional divide, driving high-impact technology adoption across the Americas.



About Us Trimble is an industrial technology company transforming the way the world works by delivering solutions that enable our customers to thrive. We create technologies that connect the digital and physical worlds, helping our customers increase productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability. From purpose-built products to enterprise-level solutions, our technology empowers professionals in construction, geospatial, government, transportation, and more.

AECO: Trimble is empowering stakeholders through planning, design, construction and the entire asset lifecycle. The company’s innovative and connected ecosystem of solutions improves coordination and collaboration between teams, phases and processes. Automating work and transforming workflows, Trimble is enabling teams to deliver with confidence at every turn. For more information, visit: construction.trimble.com.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

description: WHO WE ARE: Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success.

raw.title: Affiliate Manager — TikTok Shop
raw.excerpt: WHO WE ARE: Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success.
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success. Through unmatched expertise and patented AI technology, we fuel growth for 5,300+ brands and sellers worldwide and manage an annual ad spend exceeding $2 billion. The award-winning platform covers major marketplaces and ad channels for optimal reach. The result is unprecedented granularity, smarter budgeting, and bespoke solutions for retailers.

Quartile is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with employees stemming from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. As a business, we value the enrichment that diversity brings to our organization and are committed to a culture that creates a sense of inclusion and belonging. We welcome new perspectives and affirm that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

OVERVIEW:

The Affiliate Program Lead will be responsible for developing and growing Quartile’s TikTok Shop affiliate creator network across multiple client brands.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the TikTok Shop affiliate ecosystem, knows how to identify and recruit high-potential creators, and can build lasting relationships that translate into product sales.

You’ll work closely with our TikTok Shop Strategists to connect the right creators with the right brands, execute targeted outreach campaigns, support creator activations, and continuously improve affiliate performance.

As our TikTok Shop business grows, this position will have the opportunity to develop processes, establish best practices, and eventually build and lead a dedicated affiliate team.

We’re looking for someone who wants to build something, not simply maintain an existing program.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 2–3+ years of experience in affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or social commerce.
  • Hands-on experience working within the TikTok Shop affiliate ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, recruit, and engage creators for product-based affiliate campaigns.
  • Understanding of how TikTok Shop affiliate content, product tagging, commissions, and creator relationships contribute to sales.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build authentic creator relationships.
  • Experience managing multiple campaigns, creator lists, or brand partnerships simultaneously.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing ongoing outreach and follow-up activity.
  • Comfortable using data and performance metrics to evaluate creator opportunities and improve results.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving, remote environment.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Existing relationships within the TikTok Shop affiliate creator community.
  • Experience using TikTok Shop Seller Center, Affiliate Center, or affiliate management platforms.
  • Familiarity with creator discovery and management tools such as Cruva, FastMoss, Kalodata, or similar platforms.
  • Experience managing creator sampling programs and affiliate commission-based partnerships.
  • Understanding of TikTok Shop GMV, creator conversion performance, and shoppable content strategies.
  • Experience implementing workflows, automation, or AI-powered tools to improve operational efficiency.
  • Previous experience developing or scaling an affiliate or creator community program.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Affiliate Recruitment & Creator Network Development

  • Identify, research, and recruit TikTok Shop affiliates who align with our clients’ products, categories, and target audiences.
  • Build and maintain a growing network of high-performing TikTok Shop creators across multiple consumer product categories.
  • Execute targeted affiliate outreach campaigns, including personalized invitations, follow-ups, and creator reactivation.
  • Identify emerging creators with strong sales potential, as well as established affiliates with proven conversion performance.
  • Develop relationships with creators that encourage repeat collaborations and long-term brand partnerships.
  • Help expand Quartile’s reputation as a trusted partner within the TikTok Shop creator community.

Creator Relationships & Activation

  • Serve as a primary relationship contact for affiliate creators participating in Quartile-managed brand programs.
  • Communicate product opportunities, commission structures, sampling availability, and campaign details to creators.
  • Coordinate with TikTok Shop Strategists to connect creators with approved products and brand opportunities.
  • Support creator onboarding and engagement through TikTok Shop messaging, creator communities, and affiliate communication platforms.
  • Encourage creators to produce high-quality, shoppable content and continue promoting products that demonstrate strong conversion potential.
  • Build relationships with top-performing affiliates and identify opportunities to expand successful partnerships.

Affiliate Campaign Execution & Performance

  • Execute affiliate recruitment initiatives aligned with each brand’s growth strategy and priority products.
  • Support product sampling campaigns through creator targeting, recruitment, and follow-up communications.
  • Track outreach effectiveness, creator participation, content publication, and resulting affiliate sales.
  • Identify high-performing creators and content trends to inform future recruitment and engagement efforts.
  • Partner with Strategists to identify opportunities for creator reactivation, additional product collaborations, and sustained affiliate activity.
  • Continuously test and improve outreach messaging, creator targeting, and engagement approaches.

Program Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Help establish scalable affiliate recruitment processes, outreach workflows, and creator communication standards.
  • Maintain organized creator databases, affiliate lists, and relationship management systems.
  • Collaborate with TikTok Shop Strategists, Operations, and leadership to align affiliate execution with client priorities.
  • Provide regular updates on affiliate recruitment, creator activation, and performance trends.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows through automation, AI, and affiliate management technology.
  • Contribute to the development of training materials, SOPs, and processes as the program expands.
  • Help shape the future structure of Quartile’s affiliate team, with opportunities to mentor and eventually manage additional team members.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

Success in this role goes beyond the number of creators contacted. We’re looking for someone who can build an engaged, productive affiliate network that contributes to meaningful brand growth.

Key performance indicators may include:

  • Growth of Quartile’s active TikTok Shop affiliate creator network.
  • Affiliate recruitment and outreach conversion rates.
  • Creator activation and sample-to-content publication rates.
  • Growth in the number of active, sales-generating affiliates.
  • Affiliate-attributed GMV and repeat creator performance.
  • Creator retention, reactivation, and ongoing engagement.
  • Development of scalable workflows that support an expanding portfolio of client brands.

GROWTH OPPORTUNITY:

This position is designed to grow alongside Quartile’s TikTok Shop Full-Service Partner Program.

Initially, the Affiliate Program Lead will be heavily involved in hands-on creator recruitment, outreach, and relationship management.

As our client portfolio and affiliate network expand, this individual will have the opportunity to help shape the department, establish processes, and build a team responsible for affiliate recruitment and creator relationship management at scale.

WHO WILL THRIVE HERE:
You’re someone who genuinely understands the creator economy and gets excited about connecting the right people with the right products.

You enjoy building relationships, finding creative ways to engage creators, and turning new opportunities into measurable business results.

You’re comfortable jumping into execution, experimenting with new approaches, and building processes where they don’t yet exist.

Most importantly, you’re excited to take ownership of a growing program and help establish Quartile as a leader in TikTok Shop affiliate marketing.

BENEFITS:

  • Comprehensive Insurance Coverage   
  • 401K Plan with Employer Match  
  • Generous Paid Time Off (24 Vacation days, 7 Sick days, 12 Company Holidays, Summer Fridays)  
  • Company Laptop + additional tech accessories  
  • The base pay for this position is targeted at $100,000 per year with bonus based on performance

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

The Team

Customer Success - Our Customer Success team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients after they have purchased our products. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign – it evolves. As threats and technology change, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.


Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Technical Account Manager to serve as a critical bridge between our internal teams and enterprise customers. In this role, you will act as the centerpoint connecting Customer Success, Engineering, Technical Assistance Center (TAC), and Consultation teams. As a leader in technical account management, you will guide, mentor, and train internal teams and customers to ensure seamless communication and successful product utilization. Your expertise will be vital in driving technical health and maximizing the value of our cybersecurity solutions.

Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

  • Take full ownership of the Technical Health and overall Technical Account Health across your portfolio, ensuring environments are optimized and stable.
  • Manage a demanding customer load, providing high-touch technical account management and strategic oversight for enterprise-level clients.
  • Work directly with district and regional management across Sales, TAC, and Customer Success to drive customer outcomes and lead QBRs.
  • Lead as a program manager, demonstrating exceptional training abilities to level up the internal team and our clients.
  • Regularly attend engineering status calls to stay aligned on product updates, advocate for customer needs, and track technical resolutions.
  • Assist in Root Cause Analysis (RCAs) to resolve high-priority escalations and improve future operational stability.
  • Foster a culture of excellence by mentoring and training staff in the core principles of high-level technical account management.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Customer Success Engineering, Security Operations, or a highly technical customer-facing role.
  • Proven leadership experience mentoring and training teams in the principles and procedures of high-level technical account management.
  • Strong background in program or project management with a demonstrated ability to design and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Experience acting as a cross-functional coordinator connecting Customer Success, Engineering, Support/TAC, and technical sales roles.
  • Deep understanding of technical troubleshooting and experience assisting with Root Cause Analysis (RCAs).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering with sales on Quarterly Business Reviews to articulate technical value and account health.
  • Excellent communication skills to regularly interface with engineering teams and translate complex technical topics to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks accordingly, and drive cross-departmental collaboration.

The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$142,200.00 - $229,900.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

About Us:

Foundation AI is the only AI Native documents intake automation platform serving the claims and litigation industries. Founded in 2019 by a team of lawyers and data scientists, Foundation AI processes millions of documents each month for hundreds of US law firms, including many of the largest and most respected plaintiff and injury law firms in the country. Find out more at www.foundationai.com.

Job Overview:

At Foundation AI, as a Data Verification Analyst, you will play a crucial role in validating and reviewing healthcare-related documents with a high degree of accuracy. You will be responsible for processing medical records and billing documents while ensuring data integrity and quality using our AI-powered platform. Your attention to detail and proficiency in software tools will be essential for successfully managing healthcare documentation and supporting document automation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Segregation and Review:

  • Process, segregate, review, and validate healthcare-related documents according to established quality standards and process requirements.
  • Review and validate healthcare documents including HCFA Bills, Non-HCFA Bills, UB-04 Bills, Medical Records, and Liens.
  • Utilize the AI application to tag, validate, and process healthcare documents accurately.
  • Identify and extract relevant information from healthcare documentation while maintaining high accuracy and productivity standards.

Data Capture and Formatting:

  • Prepare, compile, and organize healthcare documents for accurate data capture and validation.
  • Log and verify the receipt of data, maintaining an organized record of incoming information.
  • Transfer information from scanned files, including images, PDFs, and Microsoft files, into a standardized format.

Data Entry and Verification:

  • Conduct high-volume data entry using word processing, spreadsheet, database, or other software tools.
  • Compare data to source documents to ensure its integrity and accuracy.
  • Review data for errors, missing pages, or missing information, resolving any discrepancies encountered.

Document Management and Confidentiality:

  • Establish and maintain a filing system to efficiently manage data and documents. Safeguard confidential customer information and adhere to data privacy protocols.
  • Perform regular backups to ensure data preservation and prevent loss.

Data Retrieval and Reporting:

  • Respond to requests for data retrieval from the database or electronic filing system.
  • Generate reports and summaries based on processed data as required. Need to adhere and comply with the daily targets and monthly targets of productivity and quality.

Responsibilities may be tailored based on the candidate’s experience and proficiency.

Qualification & Skills:

  • 1–3 years of experience in the healthcare industry, with familiarity in healthcare documentation and medical records.
  • Experience reviewing or processing healthcare documents such as HCFA Bills, Non-HCFA Bills, UB-04 Bills, Medical Records, or similar documentation.
  • Excellent typing speed with a high level of data accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct thorough document reviews.
  • Proficiency in using software applications and the ability to quickly adapt to new technologies, including AI-powered platforms.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.
  • High level of accuracy while validating information against source documents.
  • Understanding of data privacy and confidentiality principles.
  • Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and respond to data requests.

Education:

A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification, (minimum 12+3 years of formal education) in any discipline, is required.

Our Commitment:

We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic. raw.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

The Sr. Analyst - Business Operations & Strategy (Property Care GTM Focus) is an integral role on the Revenue Strategy & Operations team, partnering directly with Sales, Onboarding, and GTM leadership to build the top of the funnel for ServiceTitan's Property Care business. The Strategy & Operations team builds and maintains the foundation that allows ServiceTitan to hit its goals in new customer acquisition, Customer Implementation, Gross and Net Revenue Retention, Adoption, and Sentiment.


This role focuses on the front half of the customer journey for Property Care: how pipeline is generated, forecasted, and converted, and how customers are handed off into Onboarding. As the Property Care sales team ramps and an outbound motion for trades customers is built from scratch, this role will provide the analytics, planning, and operating cadence that leaders rely on. You will also partner with Product, Marketing, RevOps, and Customer Success to keep the experience consistent from first touch through go-live.


What You'll Do

Pipeline Analytics and Forecasting

  • Use SQL / Tableau to build data sets and dashboards that give Sales, Onboarding, and GTM leadership a single view of pipeline health and its leading indicators
  • Connect pipeline to downstream outcomes (time to onboard, adoption, retention) to show which segments and deal types perform best
  • Own pipeline reporting and forecasting for Property Care Sales (coverage, conversion, velocity, forecast accuracy), and run the weekly and monthly forecast reviews with senior leadership

Value Story and Sales Enablement

  • Partner with Sales leadership, Product, and Marketing to articulate the Property Care value story for each segment and trade, grounded in customer data and ROI analysis
  • Build the business cases and proof points reps need in the field, such as routing efficiency, adoption benchmarks, and migration outcomes
  • Synthesize win/loss and customer feedback into clear inputs for messaging, pricing, packaging, and the product roadmap

GTM Leadership Partnership

  • Work with GTM leaders as the sales team ramps: territory and segment design, capacity and quota planning, rep ramp tracking, and target setting
  • Maintain the Property Care GTM operating cadence, including planning inputs, decision tracking, and alignment across Sales, Onboarding, Product, and RevOps
  • Identify friction in the Sales-to-Onboarding handoff and design the process fixes that improve time to value

Outbound Motion with the SDR Organization

  • Partner with SDR leadership to design and stand up an outbound sales motion for Property Care trades, including target account lists, ICP definition, sequencing, and lead routing
  • Define the metrics, dashboards, and experiments that show what is working from outreach to meetings booked to qualified pipeline
  • Iterate on the motion with SDR and Sales based on conversion data, and document the playbook so it can scale

Special Projects

  • Fully own high-impact initiatives from opportunity identification through ongoing execution and iteration

What You'll Bring

  • 2-4+ years of work experience in a combination of high growth tech companies and/or management consulting
  • Proficient with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) to run faster end-to-end analyses and build/test solutions independently
  • Functional experience in revenue operations / business operations / sales operations within the SaaS space is preferred
  • Experience with pipeline management and sales forecasting, working alongside Sales and/or SDR teams, and using a CRM such as Salesforce (sales engagement or outbound tooling a plus)
  • Experience running quantitative analyses and publishing findings in dashboard format (e.g. strong experience with Excel/GSheets, Tableau, SQL)
  • Proven track record of using analytics to drive results and inform strategic decisions
  • Ability to turn data into a clear customer value narrative and concrete action plans, and to manage execution
  • To be energized by ambiguity and dynamic environments, including building a new sales motion from scratch, while moving fast
  • Detail-oriented with strong storytelling skills, able to present findings and recommendations clearly and simplify complex problems for cross-functional stakeholders at all levels

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role isZone 1: $111,800 USD - $167,600 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WAZone 2: $104,500 USD - $156,700 USD Applicable for: All other US locations.International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.
