raw.description:
PSI is seeking a Medical Monitor (Oncology) to join our international Medical Monitoring team.

In this role, you will provide medical oversight and expertise across global clinical trials, working closely with study sponsors, investigators, sites, project teams, and other clinical research professionals. Your contribution will help protect participant safety, maintain scientific and medical quality, and support the successful delivery of oncology studies.

This is an opportunity to apply your clinical oncology experience to international research and contribute directly to the development of new treatments for patients who need them.

Full-time employment

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as primary medical point of contact for clinical trial sponsors, internal project teams, investigators and trial sites for medical matters related to the conduct of clinical trials per protocol and per GCP guidelines
  • Provide medical oversight throughout the conduct of clinical trials, in accordance with the protocol, applicable regulations, and ICH-GCP requirements
  • Respond to medical questions from investigators, sites, sponsors, project teams, and third-party vendors
  • Provide medical input into eligibility assessments, protocol deviations, participant safety issues, and other trial-specific medical matters
  • Contribute medical expertise to clinical development plans, protocols, investigator brochures, informed consent documents, annual reports, clinical study reports, patient narratives, and scientific presentations
  • Review and assess clinical and safety data to support participant safety and identify medically relevant trends, risks, or quality concerns
  • Prepares and delivers medical training and/therapeutic area training to investigators and study teams
  • Support medical data review activities and contribute to the assessment of aggregated clinical trial data
  • Participate in bid defense meetings and proposal activities
  • Provide support with Pharmacovigilance activities
  • Identify medical trial risks, and collaborate with relevant functions to define appropriate mitigation and escalation measures
  • Support or participate in advisory boards, safety monitoring boards, and other medical or scientific committees, as applicable.
  • Help ensure that trial conduct and medical oversight activities comply with the approved protocol, applicable regulatory requirements, and quality standards

You will be a strong fit for this role if you have

  • Medical Doctor degree
  • Board certification in Oncology
  • Previous experience as a practicing Oncologist
  • Previous experience in clinical research or the pharmaceutical or CRO industry is a plus
  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English
  • Strong medical judgement, analytical thinking, and attention to detail
  • Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex medical information to different stakeholders
  • A collaborative and solution-oriented approach to working within international, cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and confidence working with clinical trial systems and digital collaboration tools.

As part of PSI's Medical Monitoring team, you will become part of an international team of medical professionals working at the frontline of clinical research. You will have the opportunity to apply your oncology expertise across global studies, collaborate with experienced colleagues, and contribute to bringing new treatment options to patients.

PSI is a leading Contract Research Organization (CRO) with 30 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. Originated in Switzerland, PSI is a privately owned, full-service CRO with a global reach, supporting clinical trials across multiple countries and continents. Our reputation for being highly selective about the projects we undertake highlights our commitment to delivering high-quality, timely services across a broad spectrum of therapeutic indications.

At PSI, we foster an environment where a diverse range of colleagues feel welcomed and valued. Our inclusive culture is a cornerstone of our success, enabling us to attract and retain top talent globally.

We are not just about conducting clinical trials; we are about building a community where every team member has the opportunity to thrive and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in the pharmaceutical industry.

About Multiplayer

We are Multiplayer! We design and build products that work for people, so people can do their best work.

We design product experiences that bring purpose and delight to everyday tasks. Working side by side with our clients, we help rapidly build their internal design capabilities. And we’re dedicated to fostering happiness in our own culture and in every client relationship.

We believe happiness is good business. When people are happier at work, they perform better, think smarter, and achieve more. This belief powers our approach, which we call Happiness by Design.

Let’s build a happier way to work—together.

The person we're looking for

We're seeking a Senior Design Technology Lead tolead and unite our growing technology practice. This is an in-agency role that will work closely with our development partners to ensure alignment across every engagement. Internally, we have a team of technologists and web developers who would report directly into this role, so the ideal candidate is someone who can bring our tech people together in a meaningful way, shape the department's direction, and lead both the delivery and technical strategy that connects design and engineering across everything we do.

Job Overview

Some things you will be responsible for:

Delivery & Operational Leadership

  • Shape how your team works and grows. Coach direct reports through goal-setting conversations, build a culture where engineers and designers thrive together, and hold the bar on Multiplayer's quality across workstreams.

  • Stay informed on emerging technologies, engineering practices, AI capabilities, and industry trends, introducing improvements where they provide measurable value.
  • Ensure Multiplayer’s quality standards are consistently upheld across every engagement, from technical execution through final delivery.

Technical Leadership

raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Vulnerability Management Lead to join our Team. This person will be responsible for overseeing and advancing the organization’s vulnerability management program to identify, assess, prioritize, and drive remediation of security vulnerabilities across enterprise infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, and systems. This role provides strategic and technical leadership in vulnerability identification, risk-based prioritization, remediation coordination, and continuous monitoring to reduce the organization’s attack surface and overall cybersecurity risk. The Vulnerability Management Lead partners closely with security operations, infrastructure, cloud, application development, and business teams to establish effective remediation processes, enforce security standards, and improve vulnerability management maturity. The role also drives automation, reporting, and performance measurement while providing actionable risk insights to technical teams and senior leadership to support informed decision-making and strengthen the organization’s overall security posture.

Work Location: This is a remote position, but candidate must be willing to work during the hours of 8am - 5pm EST

What You Will Do:

  • Lead vulnerability management activities across enterprise infrastructure, applications, and cloud environments, ensuring vulnerabilities are identified, assessed, prioritized, tracked, and remediated in accordance with organizational security requirements.
  • Manage and maintain Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), tracking remediation progress, documenting security findings, and coordinating with stakeholders to ensure timely closure of identified weaknesses.
  • Support Authorization to Operate (ATO) processes by providing vulnerability assessment results, remediation evidence, risk assessments, and supporting documentation required for security authorization and compliance activities.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and management reports to communicate vulnerability trends, remediation status, risk exposure, compliance posture, and program effectiveness to technical teams and senior leadership.
  • Collaborate with Information System Owners (ISOs), Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), compliance teams, and engineering stakeholders to coordinate remediation efforts, resolve technical challenges, and ensure alignment with security policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Administer, maintain, and optimize vulnerability management tools, including Tenable and Aqua Security (AquaSec), to improve vulnerability visibility, assessment coverage, and remediation workflows.
  • Support the integration of vulnerability management data with the Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) program and associated tools to improve enterprise-wide visibility, reporting, and continuous monitoring capabilities.
  • Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, such as vulnerability remediation timelines, risk reduction, overdue findings, and remediation compliance, to drive accountability and continuous program improvement.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
  • Bachelors Degree and 12 years of experience, a Masters Degree and 10 years of experience, an Associates Degree and 14 years, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 16 years of experience
  • One (or more) of the following certifications: GCIH, CISSP, CISM or CRISC
  • Demonstrated experience managing vulnerability management programs, including vulnerability identification, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and tracking Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) to support vulnerability remediation and security compliance.
  • Working knowledge of continuous monitoring processes, security control assessments, and Authorization to Operate (ATO) support activities.
  • Experience using vulnerability management tools such as Tenable and cloud security platforms such as Aqua Security to identify, assess, and track security vulnerabilities.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) programs, tool integrations, and enterprise vulnerability reporting requirements.
  • Experience developing dashboards, metrics, and reports to communicate vulnerability trends, remediation progress, risk exposure, and compliance status.
  • Ability to coordinate remediation activities with Information System Owners (ISOs), Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), compliance teams, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity policies, security assessment processes, and applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Job Description Summary

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

The Supplier Quality Engineer for Polymer Matrix Composites is an individual who can apply knowledge of RCCA and/or problem solving to lead supplier quality improvement of complex cross functional challenges. In this role, you will drive GE Aerospace quality standards for assigned suppliers, support customer disruption RCCA and Defect tracking, drive resolution to actions identified during problem solving, own supplier results, coordinate with customers on corrective action results from suppliers, and drive improvements utilizing supplier scorecards. In addition, you must demonstrate an in-depth understanding of key business drivers; use this understanding to accomplish their own work, as well have an in-depth understanding of how the work of their own team integrates with other teams and contributes to GE Aerospace, as a business.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversight and responsibility for supplier processes & product conformity, from initial qualification, maintenance, and necessary improvements driven by Quality and Business needs.
  • Position includes regular supplier audits and system assessments for quality preparedness and process controls to remain adherent to GE process specifications and agency regulations.
  • Lead GE Aerospace supplier root cause and corrective actions to reduce systemic, product specific, and process related defects.
  • Requires specialized knowledge within the function. Influence the development of strategy for the area of responsibility, including control of resources and the influence of policy formulation.
  • Interpret internal and external business challenges and recommend best practices to improve products, processes, or services. Stays informed of industry trends that may inform work.
  • Uses high level of judgment to make decisions and handle complex tasks or problems in areas of operational, product management, manufacturing, technology, or engineering. Has ability to assess quality of information given and ask pertinent questions to stakeholders. Able to offer new solutions to problems outside of set parameters and can construct and provide recommendations. Uses multiple internal and some external sources outside of own function to help arrive at a decision.
  • May lead functional teams or projects with minimal resource requirements, risk, and/or complexity. Communicates difficult concepts and may influence others' options on specific topics. May guide others to consider a different point of view.
  • Travel fluctuates between 25% to 50% depending on the needs of the business

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Engineering, Material Science or related fields (or a high school diploma/GED with a minimum of 4 years quality engineering experience)

Desired Characteristics

  • Demonstrated experience working with Composites materials
  • Demonstrated experience in manufacturing, supplier quality, statistical analysis, or customer quality
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
  • Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
  • Established project management skills.
  • Demonstrated history of problem solving, root cause and corrective action methodology, data analysis and quality experience
  • Demonstrated experience in assembly, composites and/or systems engineering
  • Demonstrated, applicable, aerospace industry experience
  • Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn
  • Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively
  • Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed
  • Leadership ability: strong communicator, decisionmaker, collaborative
  • Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker

Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.

No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.

The base pay range for this position is 100,000.00 - 133,000.00. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 11, 2026.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Additional Information

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.

The Director, Planning serves as an essential strategic and operational lead within a planning pod. In this role, you bridge high-level strategy and flawless execution, leading the development of integrated media recommendations while managing day-to-day client relationships.

You are responsible for translating strategic direction into actionable, audience-first plans that tightly align media placement with creative messaging. Operating with a blend of analytical rigor and creative problem-solving, you coach and manage junior planning talent, elevate team output, and ensure operational and financial discipline across assigned accounts.

Qualities

Here’s what it takes to be successful in the role:

  • Curiosity and Skepticism: You are always asking, “WHY?” You have an internal drive to learn more and expand your knowledge. You consider situations from multiple perspectives, and use that to gain alignment to your recommendations.
  • Strategic, Creative Problem-Solving: You are analytical and enjoy working with data to derive insights. You use insights and knowledge to develop robust strategies and visions for success. You love coming up with creative solutions to new and old problems alike.
  • Initiative & Accountability: You are a gritty self-starter driven to find answers, solve tough problems, and overcome challenges. You proactively bring solutions to challenges, and help coach your teams through challenging internal and external situations. You are able to manage client business autonomously and support your team in navigating multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Communication & Storytelling: You can easily communicate complex information or nuanced situations. You know what details are necessary and what details to leave behind. You can marry data and storytelling to articulate a compelling vision.You confidently represent a clear media POV in both internal and external rooms.
  • Adaptability: You can comfortably adjust in evolving or ambiguous situations. You use creativity to tackle new and existing challenges. You have a firm grasp on changes in the media landscape, and you use that to bring forward new, interesting ways-in for clients.
  • Self-Development: You’re reflective and self-aware. You seek opportunities to learn and develop yourself and others. You identify gaps in individual performance, and put together goals for individuals to help grow their experience and skillset.

Requirements:

  • Manage day-to-day of all media planning work across the team, delegating when possible to ensure even workload across team and allow for individual growth.
  • Acts as a reviewer and approver of all work the team completes, getting VP feedback/approval as necessary.
  • Ownership of key client list, leading client communication on key media projects and acting as a key point of integration across other departments internally (such as Data & Analytics, CRM, Strategy, Creative, PR.)
  • Acts as a strategic lead across clients, bringing a keen eye for how to showcase the strategic direction of media, and ensuring tactical recommendations clearly align.
  • Generates creative, ownable ideas to create break-through audience moments that go beyond standard media opportunities, and pushes team to think more creatively on how they approach media recommendations.
  • Manages a team, and will balance the need for delegation with support for the projects and plans they’ve been assigned
  • Leads team training on trending media topics, media planning approach, process, and tools.
  • Coaches team on media deliverables, ways of working, competencies and soft skills to continually improve the client experience and grow team members.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal teams, including client experience, activation, data & analytics, CRM, strategy, and finance
  • Translate audiences identified by client and Strategy teams into strategic media audiences through the use of 3rd party syndicated audience tools (MRI-Simmons, Resonate, YouGov Profiles), and support teams in creating a clear picture of who the audience is, driving the direction for a strategic media approach
  • Use competitive intelligence tools to identify category white space and drive the direction of a media strategy, and identify unique ways to illustrate competitive impact on media.
  • Oversee the flawless management of client media budgets, including reviewing and approving media flowcharts and authorizations for Activation teams to purchase as needed.
  • Support the team in client billing, including partnership with Activation and Finance teams to improve billing process and solution for any challenges that arise.
  • Identifying new opportunities for POVs, both internal and external, based on trending topics impacting the media landscape, category or market trends, and crafting them to clearly articulate the anticipated impact to clients.
  • Ensuring media reports have a clear POV based on performance trends and implications, and learnings are applied to future media strategies and recommendations.
  • Read industry trades and engage with the Media Team to stay current on all media trends, and how those trends present opportunities for clients.
  • Has thorough knowledge of key media planning tools, such as Vivvix, Pathmatics, MRI-Simmons, SRDS, SQAD, Nielsen NMI/IMS, Guideline Planning, and others.
  • Identifies the need for, and leads the development of, strategic analyses on audience, geography/market approach, media vendor information necessary to develop the media plan recommendation that best delivers upon the client’s goals and objectives.
  • Identifies the need for and prepares non-media projects and recommendations, including but not limited to competitive audits, target audience profiles, geographic analyses, etc.
  • Identifies potential organic growth opportunities across Media, Data & Analytics, and CRM, and crafting a strategic approach to growth with Leadership.
  • Maintains a positive rapport with media vendor partners, keeping up to date with the latest trends in the marketplace.
  • Works closely with the Activation team to ensure flawless implementation of all approved media recommendations. Integral lead in key client communication.
  • Present at all key client presentations.
  • Leads the team to prepare budget recommendations based on client goals and objectives.
  • Demonstrates a complete understanding of the client’s business, maintaining familiarity with the history, present organization and procedures of the client, as well as conditions of the industry.
  • Provides an energy level that brings new and exciting ideas, motivating other team members.
  • Keeps a pulse on all active campaigns, identifying opportunities to optimize for maximum performance.
  • Helps evaluate current processes, workflows and resources and is responsible for elevating to the VP, Planning when there are any additional needs or issues.
  • Evaluates current Planning resources and proactively bring proposals to VP, Planning for any additional tools needed to stay on top of current trends, and ensure we’re delivering best-in-class recommendations to clients.
  • Updates VP, Planning on status of current accounts on an ongoing basis, elevating key issues or concerns as they arise.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field 6+ years of media planning experience required
  • Able to apply a strategic filter to solve client challenges
  • Strong knowledge of traditional media channels with an understanding of digital is preferred, but not a requirement
  • Ability to think critically and apply a strategic approach to all plans or projects
  • Ability to work effectively with a variety of internal teams and business groups, including Creative, Media, Data & Measurement, Project Management and Finance
  • Ability to communicate effectively within a team environment as well as with outside media sales reps
  • Displays a passion for media and advertising
  • Strong organizational and mathematical skills (including basic media math)

The annual gross base salary range is $100,000 - $150,000 USD. This range represents the anticipated target salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and geographic location. Salary is one component of BarkleyOKRP's total compensation package, which includes multiple health insurance options, flexible PTO, life insurance, and 401K.

raw.description:
The Advertising Operations Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting Sage's global advertising sales business by ensuring the accurate execution, placement, and delivery of digital advertisements across assigned journal portfolios. This position serves as a key operational link between advertisers, sales teams, society partners, and internal stakeholders, helping safeguard advertising revenue through effective campaign management, quality control, and exceptional customer service.

Scope & Responsibility

The Advertising Operations Coordinator provides administrative support to the advertising sales operations of the global Commercial Sales department. This position ensures Sage's profitable growth by coordinating digital advertising in assigned journals and supporting the work of the Account Executives through administrative activities, providing customer service to internal and external stakeholders, and conducting quality reviews to ensure digital advertisements are executed accurately and without errors.

Key Responsibilities

Advertising Operations & Campaign Management

  • Receive, review, process, and traffic digital advertising artwork across assigned journals and platforms.

  • Ensure all advertising materials meet technical specifications, quality standards, and publication requirements before deployment.

  • Coordinate advertisement scheduling and placement to ensure campaigns are delivered accurately and on time.

  • Monitor advertising campaigns and resolve any placement, delivery, or technical issues promptly.

Quality Assurance & Revenue Protection

  • Conduct thorough quality checks on advertising artwork, links, creative assets, and campaign configurations.

  • Review live advertisements to verify correct placement, functionality, and adherence to client requirements.

  • Identify and escalate discrepancies, ensuring corrective actions are implemented in a timely manner.

  • Support revenue protection efforts by minimizing campaign errors, missed placements, and delivery issues.

Stakeholder & Customer Support

  • Serve as a point of contact for advertisers, Account Executives, and internal stakeholders regarding campaign execution and artwork requirements.

  • Provide responsive and professional customer service to internal and external customers.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Advertising Operations, and Production teams to ensure smooth campaign delivery.

  • Maintain strong working relationships with society partners, advertisers, and global commercial teams.

Administrative & Reporting Support

  • Maintain accurate campaign records and documentation within relevant systems.

  • Assist with reporting, data validation, and operational tracking activities.

  • Support sales teams with administrative tasks related to advertising campaign execution and management.

  • Contribute to process improvements aimed at enhancing efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.

Key Stakeholders

The Advertising Operations Coordinator works closely with:

  • Advertising Operations Supervisor

  • Senior Advertising Coordinator

  • Account Executives

  • Advertising Manager

  • Digital Advertising Operations Manager

  • Journal Advertisers

  • Society Partners

  • Commercial Sales Teams (US & UK)

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Strong customer service and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.

  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach.

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment.

Desired Experience

  • Experience in advertising operations, campaign management, digital publishing, customer support, sales operations, or related administrative roles.

  • Exposure to digital advertising platforms, content management systems, or campaign trafficking processes is preferred.

  • Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholders and managing competing priorities.

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

Impact of the Role

This role has a direct impact on advertising revenue and client satisfaction by ensuring digital advertisements are executed accurately, delivered on time, and displayed as intended. Effective performance in this position minimizes revenue leakage, enhances operational efficiency, and supports the continued growth of Sage's global advertising business.

All other content can remain unchanged unless you'd like the JD further modernized and made more candidate-friendly.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.  As a business and as an organization with an increasingly agile workforce, we're open to flexible working arrangements where appropriate.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Platform
description: About ENSEK ENSEK builds the cloud‑native SaaS software that’s transforming how energy retailers operate, innovate and manage at scale.

raw.title: Staff Software Engineer - Platform
raw.excerpt: About ENSEK ENSEK builds the cloud‑native SaaS software that’s transforming how energy retailers operate, innovate and manage at scale.
raw.description:
About ENSEK

ENSEK builds the cloud‑native SaaS software that’s transforming how energy retailers operate, innovate and manage at scale.

We help retailers lower operating costs, improve billing accuracy for consumers, and enhance customer experience through automation and AI‑driven insight, all underpinned by modern, cloud‑native architecture.

ENSEK is at an exciting inflection point as we scale at pace towards new international horizons. If you’re driven by solving complex, real‑world problems and want to build modern technology that accelerates the global energy transition, you’ll feel right at home with us.

About the role

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership within our Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll lead one or more engineering teams responsible for the shared capabilities that power ENSEK's products and customer experiences. These include public and partner APIs, authentication and access management, platform configuration, and customer onboarding services.

You'll combine deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership, helping shape architecture, drive engineering excellence, and mentor those around you. Working closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers and fellow Staff and Principal Engineers, you'll play a key role in ensuring the ENSEK platform can scale to support new customers, products and international markets.

Key responsibilities:

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will:

  • Lead the technical direction and architecture of your team's domain, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term platform scalability and maintainability.

  • Drive architectural decision-making through design reviews, technical proposals and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

  • Design, build and evolve secure, scalable APIs and shared platform services used by customers, partners and internal engineering teams.

  • Establish and champion authentication and authorisation patterns using industry standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, API Keys and mutual TLS (mTLS).

  • Remain hands-on in the code, contributing to the design and delivery of critical platform capabilities.

  • Support the evolution of foundational services that enable customer onboarding, configuration management and platform extensibility.

  • Raise engineering standards for software quality, testing, observability, security and operational excellence.

  • Partner with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Developer Experience teams to improve reliability, deployment processes and developer productivity.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Technical Authors to turn customer and business requirements into clear technical solutions.

  • Mentor engineers across multiple levels, fostering a strong engineering culture built on learning, ownership and technical excellence.

  • Lead by example through code reviews, technical coaching and cross-team collaboration.

Key outcomes:

You'll know you're making an impact when:

  • Your team has a clear and well-understood technical roadmap that aligns with ENSEK's wider platform strategy.

  • Core platform capabilities such as APIs, authentication services, onboarding and configuration management are secure, reliable and easy to consume.

  • Internal and external consumers can integrate with the platform through well-documented, self-service capabilities with minimal bespoke support.

  • Delivery performance improves through reduced lead times, more frequent deployments and higher engineering confidence.

  • Reliability metrics improve through fewer incidents, faster recovery times and improved operational visibility.

  • Technical knowledge is shared effectively, reducing dependency on individuals and strengthening long-term team ownership.

  • Engineers around you continue to grow through mentorship, coaching and exposure to strong engineering practices.

  • The wider engineering organisation benefits from improved standards, better technical decision-making and stronger collaboration between teams.

Experience required:

We're looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while helping others do their best work.

You'll bring:

  • Significant commercial software engineering experience, including experience operating as a Senior Engineer, Technical Lead or Staff Engineer.

  • A proven track record of influencing technical direction beyond a single team or product area.

  • Deep expertise designing, building and operating distributed systems and APIs in production environments.

  • Strong experience working with relational databases, particularly SQL Server or similar enterprise-scale database platforms.

  • Strong understanding of API design principles, including RESTful APIs, OpenAPI specifications, API versioning and developer experience considerations.

  • Experience implementing modern identity and access management standards, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and related authentication mechanisms.

  • Hands-on experience building and operating cloud-native services on AWS.

  • Strong knowledge of containers and orchestration technologies, including Docker, ECS and/or EKS.

  • Experience with AWS services such as API Gateway, IAM and cloud-native security patterns.

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code, automated testing strategies and modern CI/CD pipelines.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards through technical leadership.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working within multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

  • Experience in Energy, Utilities or other highly regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience building developer platforms or internal engineering tooling.

  • Exposure to platform security, identity management or customer onboarding systems at scale.

Company Benefits

  • 25 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Option to buy or sell 5 extra annual leave days per year

  • Vitality Health Insurance, including private healthcare, virtual GP access, mental‑health support and wellbeing perks (50% off gym memberships-Virgin Active, Nuffield, PureGym)

  • Pensionwith5% matched contribution

  • Regular team‑wide and company‑wide events

  • 2 volunteering days per year to give back

  • Remote‑first working environment with offices in London and Nottingham

ENSEK is at an exciting inflection point as we scale at pace towards new international horizons. If you’re driven by solving complex, real‑world problems and want to build modern technology that accelerates the global energy transition, you’ll feel right at home with us.

About the role

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership within our Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll lead one or more engineering teams responsible for the shared capabilities that power ENSEK's products and customer experiences. These include public and partner APIs, authentication and access management, platform configuration, and customer onboarding services.

You'll combine deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership, helping shape architecture, drive engineering excellence, and mentor those around you. Working closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers and fellow Staff and Principal Engineers, you'll play a key role in ensuring the ENSEK platform can scale to support new customers, products and international markets.

Key responsibilities:

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will:

  • Lead the technical direction and architecture of your team's domain, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term platform scalability and maintainability.

  • Drive architectural decision-making through design reviews, technical proposals and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

  • Design, build and evolve secure, scalable APIs and shared platform services used by customers, partners and internal engineering teams.

  • Establish and champion authentication and authorisation patterns using industry standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, API Keys and mutual TLS (mTLS).

  • Remain hands-on in the code, contributing to the design and delivery of critical platform capabilities.

  • Support the evolution of foundational services that enable customer onboarding, configuration management and platform extensibility.

  • Raise engineering standards for software quality, testing, observability, security and operational excellence.

  • Partner with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Developer Experience teams to improve reliability, deployment processes and developer productivity.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Technical Authors to turn customer and business requirements into clear technical solutions.

  • Mentor engineers across multiple levels, fostering a strong engineering culture built on learning, ownership and technical excellence.

  • Lead by example through code reviews, technical coaching and cross-team collaboration.

Key outcomes:

You'll know you're making an impact when:

  • Your team has a clear and well-understood technical roadmap that aligns with ENSEK's wider platform strategy.

  • Core platform capabilities such as APIs, authentication services, onboarding and configuration management are secure, reliable and easy to consume.

  • Internal and external consumers can integrate with the platform through well-documented, self-service capabilities with minimal bespoke support.

  • Delivery performance improves through reduced lead times, more frequent deployments and higher engineering confidence.

  • Reliability metrics improve through fewer incidents, faster recovery times and improved operational visibility.

  • Technical knowledge is shared effectively, reducing dependency on individuals and strengthening long-term team ownership.

  • Engineers around you continue to grow through mentorship, coaching and exposure to strong engineering practices.

  • The wider engineering organisation benefits from improved standards, better technical decision-making and stronger collaboration between teams.

Experience required:

We're looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while helping others do their best work.

You'll bring:

  • Significant commercial software engineering experience, including experience operating as a Senior Engineer, Technical Lead or Staff Engineer.

  • A proven track record of influencing technical direction beyond a single team or product area.

  • Deep expertise designing, building and operating distributed systems and APIs in production environments.

  • Strong experience working with relational databases, particularly SQL Server or similar enterprise-scale database platforms.

  • Strong understanding of API design principles, including RESTful APIs, OpenAPI specifications, API versioning and developer experience considerations.

  • Experience implementing modern identity and access management standards, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and related authentication mechanisms.

  • Hands-on experience building and operating cloud-native services on AWS.

  • Strong knowledge of containers and orchestration technologies, including Docker, ECS and/or EKS.

  • Experience with AWS services such as API Gateway, IAM and cloud-native security patterns.

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code, automated testing strategies and modern CI/CD pipelines.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards through technical leadership.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working within multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

  • Experience in Energy, Utilities or other highly regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience building developer platforms or internal engineering tooling.

  • Exposure to platform security, identity management or customer onboarding systems at scale.

Programme Manager

PMO | United Kingdom (Remote) | Full-Time | EMEA

Who We Are: Front Office Transformation Experts

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.

What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office

We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.

The Role

You'll run one or two of our biggest client programmes, each with several workstreams moving at once across Adobe, Salesforce, data and AI. You go deep on a single client, owning the operational relationship and the programme's delivery end to end. You're the client's single point of operational accountability, working alongside a commercial partner who owns the account. You'll report into our PMO and Program Lead, with room to shape how each programme runs. Deliver it well and the account grows with you.

What you'll do

  • Own delivery across every workstream, keeping them aligned to one plan and one outcome for the client.
  • Run programme governance, from steering committees to cross-workstream dependencies and escalation.
  • Be the client's go-to for delivery, giving executive stakeholders honest status and clear sight of risk.
  • Run programme operations, from resourcing and financials to cross-workstream reporting.
  • Manage third-party vendors and partners, holding them to scope, timelines and cost so everyone delivers as one programme.
  • Keep the programme on margin day to day, feeding budget and revenue reporting into the account's commercials.
  • Spot where the client needs more and bring those opportunities to the account team.
  • Plan ahead for continuity so the programme keeps momentum as workstreams close and new ones start.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in programme or senior project management, running enterprise programmes with several workstreams at once.
  • Consultancy or agency delivery experience, working directly with senior client stakeholders.
  • Front-office technology exposure, ideally across platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce, data or AI.
  • Sharp commercial sense:
    you've managed programme budgets, forecasts and margin, and you know what moves them.
  • Calm governance under pressure, running steering committees and handling escalations without losing the room.
  • Honest, clear communication that keeps executives informed and delivery teams pulling in the same direction.
  • Equally at home in strategy and tech, able to connect a boardroom conversation about business outcomes with the technical detail of how the workstreams will deliver them.

Why this role, why now

BPX is growing fast, and our client programmes now span more of the front office at once. This seat owns some of our largest programmes, and you'll have a real say in how we run them as we scale.

Additional information

This is a full-time, remote role based in the United Kingdom.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process.

While teamwork is expected, the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment is crucial.

Job Description
The Redesign Group is seeking a Solution Engineer with a specialty and obsession with Palo Alto Networks and the products within the Palo Alto family. We are looking for an engineer who has developed genuine depth across the product family and who is prepared to serve as the senior technical authority for Palo Alto delivery at Redesign.

This position also carries a practice development mandate. The Solution Engineer will advance the maturity of the Redesign Palo Alto practice through the development of delivery standards and reference architectures, the training and mentorship of fellow engineers, the creation of new service offerings, and the achievement of partner level certifications that support the firm's standing within the Palo Alto Networks partner ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Implementation and Delivery

  • Design, implement, and migrate Palo Alto Networks solutions for enterprise and data center customers, encompassing PA Series hardware next generation firewalls, VM Series and CN Series software firewalls, Cloud NGFW, and centralized management through Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager.
  • Deploy and optimize the broader Palo Alto product family, including Cloud Delivered Security Services (Advanced Threat Prevention, Advanced WildFire, Advanced URL Filtering, and Advanced DNS Security), Enterprise Data Loss Prevention, IoT and OT Security, GlobalProtect, SSL and TLS decryption, and the App ID, User ID, Content ID, and Device ID technologies.
  • Execute data center scale implementations, including high availability configurations, multiple virtual systems, virtual wire and Layer 3 deployments, zone based segmentation, dynamic routing integration, and east to west inspection across virtualized and containerized workloads.
  • Lead migrations from legacy and competitive firewall platforms to Palo Alto Networks, including rule base conversion, policy optimization, cutover planning, and documented rollback procedures.
  • Extend engagements into adjacent portfolio areas as customer requirements dictate, including Prisma Access and Prisma SD WAN for secure access service edge outcomes, and the Cortex platform for security operations integration.

Project and Customer Ownership

  • Assume end to end ownership of assigned projects, covering scope definition, design documentation, build, test planning, implementation, validation, and knowledge transfer.
  • Own project timelines and milestones, managing schedules proactively, escalating risk in advance of impact, and maintaining delivery commitments with limited oversight.
  • Serve as the primary customer facing technical lead, conducting design workshops and technical discovery sessions, presenting recommendations to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders, and translating business and security requirements into defensible Palo Alto architectures.
  • Produce complete engagement documentation, including high level and low level designs, as built records, validation and test results, and operational runbooks suitable for customer handover.
  • Support pre sales activity as required, contributing to scoping, level of effort estimation, bill of materials validation, and technical responses to customer inquiries.

Practice Maturity and Development

  • Advance the maturity of the Redesign Palo Alto practice through the development of delivery standards, reference architectures, deployment templates, configuration baselines, and repeatable service offerings.
  • Train and mentor Redesign engineers across Palo Alto technologies, delivering internal enablement sessions and maintaining lab environments that support hands on skill development.
  • Develop new Palo Alto based service offerings as the vendor portfolio evolves, with particular attention to opportunities beyond the firewall in secure access service edge, cloud security, and security operations.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery methodology by capturing lessons learned from each engagement and incorporating them into practice standards.

Partner Certification and Ecosystem Engagement

  • Achieve and maintain Palo Alto Networks partner level certifications in support of Redesign's NextWave partner standing and specialization attainment.
  • Establish and maintain working relationships with Palo Alto Networks systems engineers, channel teams, and distribution partners.
  • Monitor PAN OS releases, new product introductions, end of life announcements, and portfolio changes, communicating relevant developments to the practice and to customers.

Required Experience and Background
You will bring hands on delivery experience with the Palo Alto Networks platform:

  • A minimum of five years of experience in network security engineering, including at least three years with Palo Alto Networks as the primary platform. Partner, reseller, MSSP, or consulting experience is strongly preferred.
  • A demonstrated record of multiple full lifecycle Palo Alto Networks deployments in enterprise and data center environments.
  • Comprehensive PAN OS proficiency, including security and NAT policy, decryption, App ID and User ID, threat prevention tuning, high availability design, upgrades, and command line troubleshooting.
  • Experience administering Panorama at scale, including templates, device groups, and policy hierarchy. Familiarity with Strata Cloud Manager is expected.
  • Strong underlying data center networking fundamentals, including BGP and OSPF, VLAN and VRF design, and virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere, NSX, and Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated migration experience from Cisco, Check Point, Fortinet, and Juniper, improving the rule base rather than copying it.
  • Proven customer facing capability, including presenting and defending designs to experienced network and security teams.
  • Evidence of sustained professional investment in the platform, such as a home lab, active certification pursuit, or community participation.
  • Palo Alto Networks Certifications, Current Role Based Program
    Palo Alto Networks transitioned to a role based certification framework during 2024 and 2025, comprising four levels (Foundational, Professional, Specialist, and Architect) across the Network Security, Security Operations, and Cloud Security tracks. Credentials at the Specialist level or above are strongly preferred.
  • Palo Alto Networks Certifications, Legacy Program
    Candidates holding the retired product coded credentials are encouraged to apply. These certifications remain credible evidence of platform depth, and Redesign will support transition to the current framework.

Complementary Technical Qualifications

  • Networking certification at the CCNP Security, CCNP Enterprise, or CCIE level, or equivalent demonstrated routing and switching expertise.
  • Security certification such as CISSP, GIAC credentials including GCFW, GCIA, or GSEC, or CompTIA Security Plus.
  • Cloud certification at the associate level or relevant to VM Series, Cloud NGFW, and Prisma Cloud deployments.
  • Automation and application programming interface proficiency, such as the PAN OS APIs, Python, Ansible, or Terraform.
  • Working familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, NIST 800 53, or CMMC.
  • Prior experience within a NextWave partner organization.

Professional Qualifications

  • Strong technical writing ability, producing design documentation and as built records that customer operations teams can use directly.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or delivering formal technical training.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Demonstrated experience is weighted more heavily than formal education.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package which may include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match (annual dollar cap applied)
  • Flexible time off plan
  • 15 paid holidays
  • Sick leave (amount varies by state requirements and is at least the minimum required by any state)
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Life insurance
  • Paid parental leave

We’re an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We consider qualified candidates without regard to any legally protected status. This role is subject to applicable employment laws based on work location. In compliance with pay transparency laws, the compensation range for this role is included, with final pay based on experience, skills, and location. We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process—just let us know how we can help.

raw.description:
The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments is responsible for leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across insurance and investment businesses. The role focuses on driving organizational change, digital transformation, operational modernization, business process optimization, and strategic growth. The CTO works closely with executive leadership to modernize business models, improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experience, and strengthen the organization's competitive position in the financial services industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Transformation Strategy: Develop and execute enterprise-wide transformation strategies aligned with corporate objectives and long-term business growth.
  • Digital Transformation: Lead digitalization initiatives, technology adoption, automation, AI integration, and modernization of insurance and investment platforms.
  • Business Process Optimization: Review and redesign operational processes across underwriting, claims, policy administration, investment operations, and customer service.
  • Organizational Transformation: Lead organizational restructuring, change management, workforce transformation, and cultural development initiatives.
  • Insurance Transformation: Modernize insurance distribution, product development, claims processing, underwriting workflows, and customer engagement.
  • Investment Transformation: Improve investment operations, portfolio administration, reporting systems, data analytics, and investment management processes.
  • Strategic Execution: Collaborate with the CEO, COO, CFO, CSO, and business unit heads to translate strategic priorities into transformation programs.
  • Technology & Innovation: Identify emerging technologies, fintech solutions, InsurTech platforms, and digital investment solutions to improve business performance.
  • Performance & Governance: Establish transformation KPIs, monitor project delivery, manage budgets, and ensure effective governance across transformation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management: Engage senior executives, technology partners, regulators, consultants, and external stakeholders to ensure successful transformation delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • MBA, master's degree in digital transformation, technology management, or business strategy preferred.
  • Typically 12–18+ years of experience in financial services, insurance, investments, digital transformation, or enterprise change management.
  • Significant executive leadership experience managing large-scale organizational or digital transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial technology, and digital business models.
  • Proven experience in business process reengineering, automation, technology implementation, and organizational restructuring.
  • Experience managing complex transformation portfolios, cross-functional teams, and multimillion-dollar initiatives.
  • Excellent strategic planning, change leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful delivery of enterprise transformation programs.
  • Operational efficiency and process improvement.
  • Digital adoption and automation rates.
  • Reduction in operational costs and processing time.
  • Improved customer experience and service delivery.
  • Technology modernization and system integration.
  • Transformation project delivery within budget and timelines.
  • Revenue growth and business performance improvements resulting from transformation initiatives.

Accenture is seeking an AI Content Transformation Manager to help Life Sciences clients assess, design, and implement AI-enabled content supply chain solutions.


This role combines industry expertise, AI innovation, and delivery leadership. You will work with commercial, marketing, medical, content, operations, and technology teams to identify transformation opportunities, define future-state solutions, and lead implementation efforts that create measurable business value.


You will help clients determine not only where AI can drive impact, but also what process, content, data, metadata, governance, and technology foundations are required to support successful adoption.

AI-Enabled Content Transformation

  • Shape and deliver AI-led transformation initiatives across content operations and content supply chains.

raw.title: Customer Success Manager (AI Success Architect)
raw.excerpt: Customers are no longer asking whether AI works—they’re asking what it will change about how they operate.
raw.description:
Customers are no longer asking whether AI works—they’re asking what it will change about how they operate. As an AI Success Architect, you’ll help enterprise customers answer that question and turn Asana’s AI capabilities into measurable business results. You’ll own the post-sales relationship for a portfolio of ~50 enterprise accounts, acting as a strategic advisor with accountability for AI adoption, consumption, and commercial outcomes. In this advisory role, you’ll diagnose where AI changes how work gets done and guide the organizational change that makes it stick.

This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Serve as the trusted advisor and point of accountability for a portfolio of enterprise accounts across the customer lifecycle.

  • Build joint success plans that connect strategic customer goals to measurable results, leading business reviews focused on outcomes and value rather than just usage.

  • Diagnose customer workflows and map them to Asana’s AI capabilities (AI Studio, AI Teammates, and integrations built on the Model Context Protocol, or MCP) to replace manual effort and accelerate decision-making.

  • Assess how customers structure their work in Asana, guiding them to establish habits and governance that supply AI models with rich, consistent context.

  • Lead change management and enablement programs that build internal champions and ensure long-term, sustained adoption.

  • Track AI consumption and adoption against clear baselines and 30/60/90-day benchmarks, translating usage data into a compelling business story.

  • Identify expansion readiness for new AI use cases, products, or broader deployments, initiating conversations and partnering with the account team once validated.

  • Monitor account health, engagement, and sentiment to proactively mitigate risks well ahead of renewals.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, and Sales, while sharing structured customer insights with Product and Customer Success leadership.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • 5+ years of experience in customer success, strategic account management, or enterprise technology, with a track record of driving delivery and adoption for complex, high-value accounts.

  • Proven background managing enterprise relationships across both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Solid understanding of how AI agents function, workflow automation principles, and where AI provides substantial versus incremental impact.

  • Comfort discussing pricing, ROI, and commercial outcomes with senior executives, ideally within consumption-based models.

  • Strong competency in change management and program management across concurrent, long-term initiatives.

  • Effective communication skills across audiences, from executive presentations to tactical working sessions with operations teams.

  • Ability to navigate fast-paced, ambiguous environments with sound judgment.

  • Willingness to travel up to 20% to customer sites as needed.

  • Experience with enterprise AI, automation, or workflow platforms (or familiarity with MCP) is a plus.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $116,800 - $148,800. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

  • Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
  • Career coaching & support
  • Inclusive family building benefits
  • Long-term savings or retirement plans
  • In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.
