While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.


If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!

About Quantiphi:

Quantiphi is an award-winning, AI-First global digital engineering company that helps the world’s leading Fortune 1000 organizations transform bold ideas into measurable business impact. We go beyond building innovative AI technologies, we solve the problems that matter most to our clients.

Since our founding in 2013, Quantiphi has built a proven track record of turning complex challenges into meaningful outcomes across industries.

Headquartered in Boston, with more than 4,000 professionals worldwide, we partner with global enterprises to deliver large-scale digital, cloud, and AI-driven transformation. #SolvingWhatMatters


We are an Elite and Premier partner to Google Cloud, AWS, NVIDIA, Snowflake, and other leading technology platforms, and our work has been recognized across the industry, including:

  • 21 Google Cloud Partner of the Year awards in the past 10 years
  • 3 AWS AI/ML Partner of the Year awards
  • 3 NVIDIA Partner of the Year awards
  • 3 Snowflake Partner of the Year awards
  • Rated Leaders by Gartner, Forrester, IDC, ISG, Everest Group and other leading analyst firms

Quantiphi delivers First-in-class AI solutions across Life Sciences, Healthcare, Banking, Financial Services, CPG, Manufacturing, Energy, High-Tech, Telecommunications, etc., powered by cutting-edge Generative AI and Agentic AI accelerators.


We are also proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work, reflecting our commitment to our people and our culture.


For more details, visit:Websiteor LinkedIn Page.


Experience Level:10+ years of experience


Work Location:East Coast - US


About the Role:

Quantiphi is looking for a channel sales leader to help build and scale our co-sell motion with OpenAI, Anthropic, and LangChain. You will develop relationships with Partner Account Executives and Sales Leaders, uncover customer demand, and bring together the right Quantiphi GTM team to win the deal. You should combine a hunter’s instinct for opening doors with the patience and discipline to build relationships that generate repeat business. You will be supported by a Solutions Architect who leads technical discovery, solution design, and technical validation. You will own partner engagement, opportunity development, pursuit coordination, and commercial momentum.


Key Responsibilities:

Build relationships with partner sellers

  • Establish productive relationships with account executives, sales managers, solutions engineers, and alliance teams at priority partners.
  • Understand their territories, account priorities, sales objectives, and customer challenges.
  • Earn their confidence by bringing relevant opportunities, differentiated expertise, responsive support, and dependable execution.
  • Develop advocates within partner sales teams who repeatedly bring Quantiphi into customer pursuits.

Hunt for joint opportunities

  • Proactively map accounts, secure introductions, and identify opportunities across partner and Quantiphi customer portfolios.
  • Create opportunities through targeted outreach, account intelligence, partner referrals, and direct customer engagement.
  • Identify where customers need implementation expertise, domain knowledge, or delivery capacity to adopt and expand AI products.
  • Qualify the business problem, customer sponsor, urgency, funding path, and services opportunity.

Mobilize the team and drive deals to closure

  • Bring together Quantiphi account executives, the supporting Solutions Architect, industry specialists, delivery leaders, and partner teams around a clear pursuit strategy.
  • Coordinate discovery sessions, demonstrations, proposals, statements of work, and commercial discussions.
  • Establish mutual action plans with clear responsibilities, milestones, and next steps.
  • Maintain momentum through persistent follow-up, timely escalation, and effective stakeholder management.
  • Work with account and delivery teams to identify expansion opportunities after the initial engagement.

Run a disciplined co-sell motion

  • Lead joint account planning, pipeline reviews, and opportunity reviews with partner sales teams.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity records, forecasts, attribution, and follow-up actions.
  • Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, services bookings, conversion, and expansion.
  • Turn successful pursuits into repeatable sales plays, customer references, and stronger partner relationships.

Understand and communicate our differentiation

  • Develop a practical understanding of the products and enterprise value propositions of OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, and the broader AI ecosystem.
  • Work with the Solutions Architect to connect customer needs with Quantiphi’s capabilities in AI applications, agent workflows, evaluations, observability, integration, and production deployment.
  • Explain why a partner seller should choose Quantiphi for a specific account or customer problem.
  • Understand how hands-on deployment support helps customers move from experimentation to production, and translate that need into a commercially sound services engagement.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, business development, or alliances, including 5+ years in partner sales or alliance roles at a services firm, systems integrator, consultancy, or technology provider.
  • A proven record in enterprise sales, partner sales, or alliances, with personal ownership of opportunity creation and revenue outcomes.
  • Direct experience co-selling with vendor account executives, including account mapping, joint discovery, pursuit planning, and commercial closure.
  • Recent experience selling AI implementation, agent development, AI platforms, or related technical services, with examples of customers progressing beyond demonstrations into production.
  • Experience building relationships across both partner leadership and field sales organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, navigate complex accounts, and coordinate multidisciplinary teams through a sales cycle.
  • Strong follow-through: organized account plans, clear communication, reliable commitments, and persistent pursuit of next steps.
  • Commercial judgment around services scope, presales investment, procurement, and delivery handoffs.
  • Curiosity and sufficient technical fluency to engage credibly with AI sellers and customers while working closely with a Solutions Architect.

Relevant Partner Experience: We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked directly with the sales or partnership teams at OpenAI, Anthropic, or LangChain, either within those companies or while representing a consulting, implementation, or technology partner. Relevant experience may also include co-selling production AI solutions with Microsoft’s Azure AI teams, AWS’s Bedrock and AI/ML teams, Google Cloud’s AI teams, Databricks, or other enterprise AI software providers. Candidates from these ecosystems should demonstrate specific AI customer wins, their personal contribution to the pursuit, and the relationships they built with vendor sellers. Experience in cloud migration, data modernization, or application modernization should be complemented by a clear record of AI solution selling and deployment-led growth.


Other Qualifications:
  • Experience working with frontier AI model providers, AI infrastructure platforms, or emerging enterprise AI ecosystems, including building sales motions within evolving partner programs.
  • Experience developing joint AI solutions, coordinating partner enablement, or supporting industry-focused go-to-market initiatives.
  • Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus.

What’s in it for YOU at Quantiphi:

  • Make an impact at one of the world’s fastest-growing AI-first digital engineering companies.
  • Upskill and discover your potential as you solve complex challenges in cutting-edge areas of technology alongside passionate, talented colleagues.
  • Work where innovation happens - work with disruptive innovators in a research-focused organization with 60+ patents filed across various disciplines.
  • Stay ahead of the curve—immerse yourself in breakthrough AI, ML, data, and cloud technologies and gain exposure working with Fortune 500 companies.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Sr. Planner, Supply Chain

Maryland Heights, MO

Spartech offers a competitive salary, incentives, and benefit programs!

Spartech, LLC, headquartered in Maryland Heights, Missouri, has over a dozen locations throughout the United States. We have a broad customer base with extensive product offerings and technologies. Many of our materials are used in products you might see every day - for example if you start your morning with a single serve yogurt, the container you ate from may be made from one of Spartech’s products or the refrigerator where the yogurt was stored could have Spartech products in its interior features. More unique uses of our products can be seen in military or security applications, for example in fighter jet canopies or bullet resistant windows. From routine daily-life to life-saving applications—we make a difference. Our broad scope of products and services keep our environment interesting and challenging with a culture focused on success. If you want to make a difference in a fast-paced environment with a company large enough to offer you room to grow but not so large that you become “just a number”, Spartech might be the ideal company for you.

General Summary and Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

The Sr. Supply Chain Planner position has broad responsibilities for managing the overall flow of finished goods material from order entry through conversion and delivery to the customer. Responsibilities range from planning production, procuring raw materials, ensuring schedule data integrity and managing inventory levels to meet customer service levels and working capital targets for the business. In addition, the incumbent in this position is expected to make critical decisions based on the best information at hand and take a leadership role in building consensus among several parties to resolve problems.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

  • Forecasting demand for vendors, executing purchase orders and being responsible for inventory levels and service to the manufacturing plants.
  • Executing the purchasing transactions for certain manufacturing locations, as well as being the point person on raw material changes and inventory levels.
  • Help manage the overall master data regarding MRP information for resin and raw materials.
  • Interact with production planners and plant schedulers to resolve issues and build consensus on supply strategy.
  • Communicate process and service issues to Business Management, Manufacturing, Sales, Customer Service, Production Planning and Technical Service.
  • Balance supply with demand on a short term and long-term basis.
  • Manage inventory investment throughout the chain to minimize working capital investment.
  • Analyze data to create information on safety stock levels, ERQ’s and forecasting requirements.
  • Provide data to support manufacturing and business projects.
  • Work with transportation and business teams to identify and implement optimization opportunities within the supply chain focused on reducing costs and increasing service levels.

Education & Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelors - Business Administration or equivalent experience.
  • Masters - Operations Management or equivalent experience.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • 5 years' experience - manufacturing.
  • 5 years' experience - data management.
  • 5 years' experience - purchasing and materials within a manufacturing environment.
  • 5 years' experience - supply chain planning.

Benefits

We offer competitive salary, incentives, and benefit programs. – Most Benefits Start Day ONE!

Benefits include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision.
  • Flexible Spending Accounts.
  • Company paid Life & Long-term/Short-term disability programs.
  • 401(k) with strong company match.
  • 120 hours Paid Time Off (pro-rated based on hire date).
  • 11 paid holidays.

Spartech, LLC provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status, or other legally protected classification in the state in which a person is seeking employment. Spartech will use E-Verify to ensure employment eligibility of newly hired employees where required.

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, we are seeking an Engagement Manager to lead the implementation of AI-driven initiatives powered by QVAC, Tether’s SDK for local AI and delegated inference. The role focuses on orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder deployments of decentralized AI solutions across enterprise, government, and institutional environments.

This position combines client engagement, technical coordination, and delivery oversight to ensure successful onboarding and execution of AI use cases, ranging from edge AI deployments to privacy-preserving inference systems. The Engagement Manager plays a central role in aligning client objectives with product capabilities, coordinating internal and external stakeholders, and driving implementations from initial scoping through production rollout.

Responsibilities

Client & Partner Engagement

  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients and partners during AI implementation initiatives, ensuring clear communication, expectation alignment, and structured execution.

  • Guide clients in translating business requirements into AI deployment strategies leveraging QVAC capabilities (local inference, delegated compute, privacy-preserving architectures).

  • Support Expansion team in shaping AI-related opportunities by providing input on feasibility, integration complexity, and delivery approach.

  • Identify opportunities to extend implementations across additional use cases, geographies, or Tether technologies.

Implementations Oversight

  • Lead end-to-end coordination of QVAC-based implementations from kickoff through production deployment.

  • Define implementation roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies across AI models, infrastructure, and integration layers.

  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and actual product capabilities, avoiding scope drift or mispositioning.

  • Track progress across multiple concurrent AI deployments, ensuring timely delivery and readiness for production environments.

Cross-functional Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with product, engineering, and research teams to align on QVAC capabilities, limitations, and roadmap evolution.

  • Facilitate integration between client systems and QVAC components, including model deployment pipelines, APIs, and compute environments.

  • Work with legal and compliance teams where required, particularly in sensitive AI deployments involving data locality or privacy constraints.

  • Maintain structured communication flows across all stakeholders involved in the implementation lifecycle.

Governance & Reporting

  • Establish and maintain governance frameworks including implementation plans, risk tracking, and decision logs.

  • Produce executive-level updates summarizing progress, risks, blockers, and next steps.

  • Ensure documentation of implementation architectures, deployment patterns, and key learnings for reuse across future projects.

  • Support escalation management and ensure timely resolution of technical or operational challenges.

Requirements

Core Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, technical account management, or delivery roles within AI, data infrastructure, or complex technology environments.

  • Proven experience managing cross-functional implementations involving multiple stakeholders (internal teams, clients, external partners).

  • Strong ability to operate at the intersection of technical and business domains.

Technical Understanding

  • Familiarity with AI/ML deployment concepts, including model inference, edge/local AI, and distributed compute architectures.

  • Understanding of APIs, SDK integrations, and system architecture patterns.

  • Ability to engage in technical discussions with engineering teams while maintaining business-level clarity with clients.

Communication & Execution

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with enterprise or government entities.

  • Structured approach to project tracking, documentation, and governance.

  • Ability to manage ambiguity and operate in fast-evolving, early-stage environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with decentralized technologies, blockchain, or privacy-preserving systems.

  • Exposure to AI infrastructure tooling or MLOps workflows.

  • Experience in regulated industries or public sector projects.

  • Basic familiarity with programming or scripting environments (Python, APIs, CLI tools).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the role:

Talent Map Global BPO, Inc. is a global talent solutions and business process outsourcing company connecting skilled professionals in the Philippines with growing North American businesses. We build dedicated offshore teams across technology, finance and accounting, marketing, and enterprise operations.

Our people-first culture is grounded in collaboration, integrity, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Team members gain meaningful exposure to international clients while building long-term careers in a supportive, performance-focused environment.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The ideal candidate combines advanced TypeScript and React development with strong user-interface architecture, automated testing, accessibility, visualization, and API-integration skills. You should be comfortable independently executing complex assignments, building configuration-driven and AI-enabled user experiences, reviewing code, mentoring less-experienced engineers, resolving integration issues, and preparing complete, well-tested software for review and promotion. You will succeed in this role if you advocate for accessible and intuitive user experiences while maintaining rigorous technical, security, and engineering-quality standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Frontenatd and Full-Stack Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain user-interface capabilities using TypeScript, React 18, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Integrate applications with approved REST and JSON interface contracts and collaborate with back-end engineers to resolve integration issues.

  • Configuration-Driven AI Experiences: Build reusable interfaces that render agents, features, navigation, and application behavior from approved configuration manifests. Develop AI-enabled experiences for agent interaction, tool activity, approval requests, markdown context authoring, response presentation, and execution history.

  • Dashboard and Data Visualization: Develop operational and analytical dashboards using React and legacy technologies such as Jinja2, HTML, and CSS. Create responsive and accessible charts and visualizations using Chart.js, D3, or comparable technologies.

  • Accessibility and Section 508: Incorporate accessibility throughout design and development. Ensure applications meet applicable Section 508 and WCAG requirements through semantic structure, keyboard navigation, screen-reader compatibility, accessible forms, focus management, and appropriate visual treatments.

  • Authenticion and Authorization: Implement secure session authentication and role-based access controls. Ensure navigation, actions, data visibility, and application behavior reflect approved user permissions.

  • Testing and Engineering Quality: Develop automated tests using Vitest, Testing Library, and related technologies, including unit, component, integration, behavior-driven, end-to-end, regression, accessibility, and performance testing. Apply secure-development and front-end quality practices.

  • Troubleshooting and Root-Cause Analysis: Diagnose complex user-interface, API-contract, state-management, authentication, authorization, accessibility, visualization, performance, and browser-compatibility issues.

  • Code Review, Mentoring, and Innovation: Participate in design and merge-request reviews, developer pairing, and demonstrations. Mentor less-experienced engineers, evaluate emerging technologies, develop assigned prototypes, and present recommendations that may improve usability, accessibility, performance, maintainability, security, or mission value.

  • Governance and Delivery Readiness: Follow established technical, security, review, and promotion controls. Promptly elevate unclear requirements, unresolved decisions, security concerns, access limitations, and proposed deviations from approved direction. Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.


Job Description

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?


THE OPPORTUNITY

Silvus is seeking a Competitive Intelligence Specialist within our International Business Development team who will report to the Senior Director, Strategy & Growth International. The successful individual in this role will serve as a primary authority on competitor strategy, product offerings, pricing models, and tactical operations. Core responsibilities include analyzing market trends, synthesizing field observations into strategic briefings, and guiding product strategy and major program captures. Working closely with cross-functional partners, regional sales leadership, and technical teams, the individual empowers executive decision-making across global markets.


This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location.


The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Market & Competitor Strategy

  • Analyze competitor baseline success, regional win rates, and operational alignment to identify how rivals respond to customer specifications.
  • Observe market developments using automated tools and structured intelligence to maintain standardized competitor profile files.
  • Synthesize frontline customer feedback and field observations across global regions into actionable intelligence briefings.

Field Intelligence & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Establish an internal intelligence framework to routinely interview and debrief customer-facing sales directors, field application engineers, and regional support teams.
  • Observe competitor product launches, messaging, and technology roadmaps during industry trade shows and field exercises.
  • Facilitate regular syncs with regional leads to analyze shifting customer sentiment, competitor pitches, and localized pricing strategies.

Technical Analysis & Pricing Intelligence

  • Generate estimated Bill of Materials (BOM) models for expected competitive radio hardware, systems, and accessories on major tenders.
  • Coordinate physical and virtual hardware teardowns with internal R&D to help to validate cost structures and manufacturing methodologies.
  • Manage a structured pricing database to capture historical competitor pricing, volume discount brackets, and external partner networks.
  • Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.
  • Travel requirements – 50%; frequent travel for meetings, events, and demonstrations.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of professional experience; OR High School Diploma/GED with 11+ years of professional experience in wireless communications, defense, aerospace, or related industry.
  • 3+ years of experience focused in competitive intelligence, counterintelligence operations, market research, or business strategy.

Technical Expertise

  • Market Intelligence Systems: Experience monitoring competitor activity, configuring keyword frameworks, and maintaining structured competitor databases.
  • Technical Estimation & BOM Modeling: Demonstrated ability to reverse-engineer competitor hardware, system requirements, and RF accessory configurations in cooperation with our engineering and product team.
  • Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT): Proficiency utilizing OSINT methodologies to analyze patent filings, regulatory agency approvals (such as FCC records), and government procurement databases.
  • Data Visualization & Analysis: Capability to transform complex field data into executive dashboards, threat maps, and strategic summaries.

Professional Experience

  • Primary Field Research: Experience gathering operational intelligence at trade shows, industry conferences, and operational environments.
  • Internal Stakeholder Engagement: Excellent track record conducting structuredinterviews and debriefs across cross-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and distributor networks.
  • Pricing & Partner Analysis: Experience evaluating historical competitor pricing, volume discounts, and regional distribution channels.
  • Governance & Ethical Practices: Ability to ensure all primary and secondary research strictly complies with corporate rules, FAR guidelines, and SCIP ethical standards.
  • Security Clearance: Active U.S. Government SECRET clearance or the ability to obtain one within 15 months of hire.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen due to clients under U.S. government contracts.
  • All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Exposure to tactical communications, radio systems, RF accessories, and defense industry CONOPS.
  • Prior military service with direct experience in counterintelligence operations, analysis, or investigative support.
  • Familiarity with public sector procurement database mining (e.g., SAM.gov) and sub-tier supplier mapping.
  • Academic background or professional experience in international business and global markets.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Trade shows.
  • Outdoor environment for demonstrations.
  • Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in the field.

raw.title: Staff Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: Method is a global design and engineering consultancy founded in 1999.
raw.description:
Method is a global design and engineering consultancy founded in 1999. We believe that innovation should be meaningful, beautiful, and human. We craft practical, powerful digital experiences that improve lives and transform businesses. Our teams [based in New York, Charlotte, Atlanta, Tokyo, London, Bengaluru, and remote] work with a wide range of organizations in many industries, including Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, Automotive, Aviation, and Professional Services.

Method is part of Hitachi Digital, a digital product engineering company. Hitachi Digital integrates experience design and complex engineering to help our clients imagine what’s possible and accelerate their transition into tomorrow’s digital businesses. Hitachi Digital is a Hitachi Group Company.

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our team working with a client in the energy sector. Our client is a non-profit organization that plans for and coordinates the electrical grid across its region. It doesn’t own any part of the grid. Our team builds the software that helps them make the best decisions they can about how that grid grows.

This is a complicated domain, and the software is more complicated still. You will crunch large volumes of planning data, build and secure APIs, and work through authentication and access across many systems. The people you build for are electrical engineers, not software engineers, so much of the job is translation. You’ll need to understand what they’re asking, go to them with your own questions, and turn the answers into working software.

You don’t need to arrive knowing how transmission planning works. You do need to want to find out. The people who do well here watch the YouTube videos, ask the LLMs, read the documentation, and come back with better questions. If Ohm’s Law makes you curious rather than nervous, that’s a good sign.

From a technology side, the client is building APIs with Java and Spring Boot, with some existing code in Python and front ends in React and TypeScript. Java is the core of the work, but we care more about how you learn than what you already know. Use AI to write code where it helps, provided you can read it, validate it, and stand behind it. Method has a core value centered on learning, so if you wonder if you’re qualified (or need to learn one of the tech stacks), please apply and we can decide together if this opportunity is a good fit for you.

At Method, we strive to work in a collaborative and supportive environment, and we look for people who can work flexibly and enjoy working as part of a team. In this role, you will be part of a small, dedicated team contributing to the day-to-day delivery of a key work stream, working alongside engineers in parallel workstreams to keep cross-team dependencies aligned. Strategic thinking and creative problem solving are key skills to have at Method, as well as the love of continuously learning and sharing knowledge.

Travel for team and client meetings may be required, typically up to 15%.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain APIs and back-end services in Java and Spring Boot that support the client’s transmission planning work.
  • Process, validate, and move large volumes of grid and planning data between systems, including batch job orchestration.
  • Design and implement security, authentication, and access control across services.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines, environments, and deployments, and keep systems observable through logging and metrics.
  • Work directly with the client’s electrical engineers to understand their problems, ask the questions that matter, and translate domain needs into technical requirements.
  • Work problems through on your own first, then bring options and a recommendation to the team.
  • Help the team prioritize when there is more to build than time to build it, and be clear about the trade-offs.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to raise delivery speed, and review and test what they produce before it ships.
  • Mentor teammates and share what you learn about the domain so the whole team gets sharper.

Qualifications

You will succeed in this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience building back-end systems and APIs, with Java and Spring Boot strongly preferred.
  • A track record of learning new languages, codebases, and domains quickly and becoming productive in them.
  • Curiosity about how complex systems work, shown in what you’ve chosen to learn on your own.
  • Strong problem-solving skills. You figure things out yourself first, and you know when to ask.
  • Strong communication skills, including explaining technical ideas to experts from other fields and drawing out what they need.
  • Comfort reaching out to the client directly, without waiting for someone to do it for you.
  • Broad technical range across APIs, data, security, and infrastructure, rather than depth in a single layer.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful principles, with experience using OpenAPI standards, Swagger, and Postman to design, document, and test APIs.
  • Experience with API security, authentication, and authorization (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, role-based access control).
  • Experience working with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle) and data-heavy workloads.
  • DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), cloud platforms, logging, and metrics.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools, with the judgment to validate their output.
  • Experience in agile development methodologies and tools for version control (i.e., Git, Bitbucket), continuous integration, and deployment.
  • Experience leading pieces of work and mentoring other engineers.

Beneficial Qualities

  • Experience in the energy or utility industry
  • Familiarity with power systems or electrical grid concepts such as transmission planning, power flow, or generation interconnection
  • Proficiency with Python
  • Experience with React and TypeScript for building user interfaces that consume APIs
  • Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Work well with others
  • You love the journey as much as the destination

Why Method?

We look for individuals who are smart, kind and brave. Curious people with a natural ability to think on their feet, learn fast, and develop points-of-view for a constantly changing world find Method an exciting place to work. Our employees are excited to collaborate with dispersed and diverse teams that bring together the best in thinking and making. We champion the ability to listen, and believe that critique and dissonance lead to better outcomes. We believe everyone has the capacity to lead and look for proactive individuals who can take and give direction, lead by example, enjoy the making as much as they do the thinking, especially at senior and leadership levels.

We believe in work/life balance. Seriously. We offer a ton of competitive perks, including:

  • Continuing education opportunities
  • Flexible PTO and work-from-home policies
  • 401K matching
  • Health, Dental and Vision benefits, starting on day 1
  • Company lunches, company outings, along with a lot of snacks
  • Health and wellness programs
  • Other location specific perks (just ask!)

Next Steps

If Method sounds like the place for you, please submit an application. Also, let us know if you have a presence online with a portfolio, GitHub, Dribbble or other platform.

For information on how we process your personal data please see Privacy.

If you are a California resident, more details on how we process your personal information can be found in the CCPA Recruitment Privacy Notice.

At SpeakrBrand, we’re the Growth Partner for Thought Leaders – the people with ideas worth spreading and stories worth scaling.

We’re a rapidly growing team that delivers white-glove service and creative excellence for every client we serve.

Job Description

The Brand Strategist manages the marketing and content growth of our clients’ personal brands. This includes developing content strategy, creating thought leadership content, and executing social media and newsletter marketing that drives visibility and engagement.

You’ll translate each client’s unique story and expertise into content that positions them as an authority in their space — focused on social media, LinkedIn, newsletters, and creative production.

raw.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Benelux)
raw.excerpt: Lateral stands for technology excellence.  We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses.
raw.description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Frontend Engineer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.

  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale (and writing tests to prevent regressions

  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.

Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

  • You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

  • Proven ability tocraft, polish, delight, sweat the details.
    You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. ￼ Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments ￼. Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about being kind, open, and constructive, so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

01. Your work
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

02. Lateral team fit
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

03. Work trial

You’ll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

04.Engineering deep dive
A collaborative session with our engineers.

05. Project fit
An interview focussed on prioritization, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the "messy middle".

Anticipated Contract End Date/Length: Initial 3-month contract, with a potential 6-month extension
Work set up: Remote

Responsibilities

Salesforce Administration and CRM Management

  • Maintain and update contact records, campaign information, and event-related data within Salesforce.
  • Create and update contacts, manage attendance statuses, and ensure records are accurate and complete.
  • Maintain event campaign records and ensure attendee information is correctly captured.
  • Update post-event attendance records to trigger automated follow-up communications.
  • Identify and correct duplicate, outdated, or incomplete records.
  • Investigate missing information and ensure CRM records meet internal data quality requirements.
  • Support the consistent use of Salesforce processes and workflows across the programme.

Shared Inbox and Enquiry Management

  • Monitor and manage the programme's shared inbox, responding to enquiries in a timely and professional manner.
  • Handle event registration queries, access requests, attendee questions, and general programme enquiries.
  • Manage incoming requests efficiently and escalate more complex matters to the relevant team members.
  • Maintain clear records of enquiries and follow-up actions where required.
  • Ensure communications are accurate, helpful, and aligned with the organisation's standards.
  • Help manage fluctuations in inbox volume around busy event periods.

Event Administration and Post-Event Processes

  • Provide back-office administrative support across a busy calendar of virtual and in-person events.
  • Update attendee and attendance records following events.
  • Ensure post-event data is processed promptly so automated follow-up communications can be triggered correctly.
  • Support registration administration and maintain accurate event records.
  • Coordinate with the programme team to ensure all relevant event administration is completed within agreed timelines.
  • Help maintain consistent processes across the annual event schedule.

CRM Data Quality and Audience Management

  • Review and clean existing CRM records to improve data accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify missing consent information and support the appropriate review and updating of records in line with internal procedures.
  • Assist with maintaining audience databases and ensure contact information remains up to date.
  • Support the identification and review of potential Non-Executive Director contacts who are not currently engaged with the programme.
  • Help organise and maintain audience information to support future engagement activity.
  • Handle contact data carefully and follow applicable data protection and confidentiality requirements.

Programme Operations and Team Support

  • Provide dependable operational support to the existing NED programme team.
  • Help relieve administrative pressure so the team can focus on event delivery, stakeholder relationships, and programme development.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and follow established processes.
  • Identify recurring administrative challenges and suggest practical improvements.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues to prioritise tasks and manage competing deadlines.
  • Provide updates on workload, outstanding actions, and any issues requiring attention.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Proven, hands-on Salesforce experience is essential. Candidates must be comfortable working directly within Salesforce rather than having only general CRM exposure.
  • Experience maintaining CRM records, updating contact information, and managing campaign or event-related data.
  • Strong administrative and organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Experience managing a shared inbox, handling enquiries, and responding professionally to stakeholders.
  • Ability to work accurately with large volumes of contact and event data.
  • Confidence in identifying data discrepancies, correcting records, and following established processes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
  • A proactive, reliable, and solutions-focused approach.
  • Capacity to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a wider team.
  • Professional handling of confidential information and awareness of data protection requirements.

Desirable Experience

  • Background supporting corporate programmes, event teams, or senior stakeholder engagement initiatives.
  • Experience using Salesforce campaigns, event attendance tracking, and automated communications workflows.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation tools and event registration platforms.
  • Experience maintaining consent records and supporting CRM data cleansing activities.
  • Previous experience within professional services, financial services, or a large corporate environment.
  • Experience supporting Non-Executive Directors, senior executives, or other professional audiences.

Previous event management experience is not essential. This is an operational support role, and strong Salesforce capability is the priority.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a highly organised, service-oriented professional who enjoys working with systems, maintaining accurate data, and ensuring administrative processes run smoothly.

They will be comfortable managing a busy shared inbox, working through CRM records methodically, and following up on outstanding queries without requiring constant supervision. Dependability, attention to detail, and confidence in following established processes while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency are essential. The ability to handle sensitive information appropriately and communicate professionally with senior stakeholders is also important.

Above all, the successful candidate must have practical Salesforce experience and be ready to contribute quickly within an established team.

Why This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to support a high-profile executive engagement programme within a leading professional services environment.

The role will contribute directly to improving operational efficiency, maintaining reliable CRM data, and ensuring enquiries and event administration are handled effectively. This support will enable the wider team to focus on delivering valuable events and building meaningful relationships with senior business leaders.

Interested? If you have strong Salesforce experience, excellent administrative skills, and enjoy keeping systems, data, and communications organised, we would love to hear from you.

Candidates must be legally authorized to live and work in the country where the position is based, without requiring employer sponsorship.

HelloKindred is committed to fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring practices. We assess candidates based on skills, experience, and role-related requirements.

We appreciate your interest in this opportunity. While we review every application carefully, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

HelloKindred is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Who is HelloKindred?

HelloKindred are specialists in staffing marketing, creative and technology roles, offering a range of talent solutions that can be delivered on-site, remotely or hybrid.

Our vision is to make work accessible and people’s lives better. We do this by disrupting traditional employment barriers – connecting ambitious talent to flexible opportunities with trusted brands.

Principal Analytics Engineer - Global Reporting & Analytics


About the Team

The Global Reporting and Analytics team sits within the Clinical Solutions Platform organization. We turn client data and usage into validated, reusable, enterprise-grade reporting — building the capabilities the business needs to deliver customer value and growth. We go beyond usage dashboards, running impact and outcomes analyses that connect product usage to real value for clinicians, and we work problem-first, partnering closely with product, marketing, and account management teams to give our people the data-driven insights they need to create better experiences for our customers, faster.


About the Role

As Principal Analytics Engineer, you'll be the technical lead within the Global Reporting and Analytics team, reporting to the Director of Global Reporting and Analytics, and owning technical execution from discovery to production. You'll work closely with both our analytics team and our engineering/development partners, providing the technical depth and context each side needs from the other.

You bring strong software engineering depth, deep comfort with SQL and Snowflake, and a genuine affinity for analytics — with the curiosity to build real fluency in our analytics domain over time, to the point where you can represent it confidently and independently in technical conversations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical liaison between the analytics team and engineering/development partners — translating analytics needs into clear requirements, specifications, and development tickets.
  • Provide hands-on technical depth for the team: deep Snowflake fluency (data engineering experience a plus), excellent SQL, and code review across SQL, Python, and JavaScript (Highcharts), contributing code directly where useful.
  • Coach and mentor analysts on technical concepts and coding, building technical fluency and elevating capability across the team over time.
  • Champion opportunities to bring more coding, automation, and AI tooling into the analytics team's work — prototyping new approaches and driving innovation in how the team operates.
  • Explore how AI could shape the next generation of our reporting — new kinds of insights and experiences we could offer customers and stakeholders.
  • Act as a technical thought partner as new products, features, and initiatives are planned across the business — helping ensure analytics needs are considered from the start.
  • Contribute to the technical design of our reporting and analytics platform — data model choices, performance trade-offs, and level of detail — and help determine how reporting and AI-enabled work should integrate with broader enterprise systems, partnering with engineering on execution.
  • Contribute to improving data quality, alerting for potential issues, and regression testing to catch problems before they reach production.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise non-negotiables: security, compliance, data governance, data residency, PHI/PII handling, and central technology infrastructure standards.

Requirements

  • Engineering experience: 10+ years in software engineering, with experience in data engineering or building analytics data pipelines.
  • Education: BS in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; advanced degree preferred.
  • Snowflake: Deep, hands-on experience with Snowflake; data engineering experience with Snowflake strongly preferred.
  • Languages: Excellent SQL, strong Python, strong comfort with JSON, and working knowledge of JavaScript.
  • Data modeling: Strong grounding in data modeling concepts, comfortable making and explaining recommendations on structure, performance trade-offs, and level of detail in reporting.
  • BI platforms: Working familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau — enough to engage confidently in analytics discussions and help identify opportunities to move calculations and data manipulation upstream, out of the BI layer. Hands-on Tableau experience is a plus.
  • AI & tooling: Comfortable using AI to accelerate coding and everyday work. Experience creating reusable tools or workflows that help scale technical knowledge across a team is a plus.
  • AI / LLM familiarity: Working knowledge of concepts like LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented approaches — enough to lead a project in this space, representing the analytics needs and collaborating with architecture and engineering partners on design and implementation.
  • Communication & mentoring: Exceptional at explaining technical concepts to audiences with a wide range of technical backgrounds, and comfortable coaching less technical colleagues with patience and care — a distinguishing strength for this role.
  • Leadership and delivery management: Plans and sequences work, manages scope, dependencies, and priorities, removes blockers, and drives delivery to keep innovation and reporting modernization moving.

Work in a Way That Works for You
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.


Working Pattern
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


About the Business
A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world

Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates.This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus.If performed in any following locations: Home Based - Ireland, Ireland - Limerick (Red Church), the base pay range is €71,700 - €119,500.

Quer fazer parte de um time que cria oportunidades e potencializa a evolução?

Como alcançamos tudo isso?

Através de um ecossistema de mais de 12 mil pessoas inconformadas que, juntas, oferecem soluções, produtos e educam o mercado. Atuamos como uma Única TOTVS, integrando diferentes soluções e expertises para educar o mercado e simplificar o mundo dos negócios. Para nós, a evolução é constante e acontece de gente para gente: usamos nossa inquietude para antecipar tendências e transformar o crescimento real da tecnologia.


Nosso jeito de ser:

🤖IH + IA (Inteligência Humana + Inteligência Artificial): Acreditamos que a tecnologia potencializa, mas as pessoas direcionam. Aqui, a IA nos dá escala e eficiência, enquanto a nossa Inteligência Humana traz a estratégia, o contexto e o cuidado. É essa combinação que nos permite criar soluções inovadoras com um propósito real.

🚀Protagonismo e Evolução: Somos movidos pelo aprendizado contínuo e pela coragem de assumir o comando da própria carreira. Aqui, incentivamos a inquietude e oferecemos o ambiente fértil para quem quer crescer, criar e se transformar.

Resultado Responsável: Valorizamos a liberdade para agir e a responsabilidade com o todo. Aqui, você tem voz para desafiar o status quo e autonomia para buscar resultados que gerem valor real para nossos clientes e para a sociedade.

🧘🏼‍♀️Bem-Estar Integral: Cuidamos de quem faz a evolução acontecer. Buscamos o bem-estar integral de cada pessoa colaboradora, por meio de ações e benefícios que viabilizam recursos de autocuidado através de 5 pilares: Emocional, Financeiro, Físico, Ocupacional e Social.

🫂Pluralidade e Pertencimento: A diversidade é o que nos torna potentes. Promovemos a inclusão e o pertencimento de forma ativa, garantindo que a TOTVS seja um lugar onde você pode ser quem você é. Nossa expertise é humana e viva: acolhemos as diferenças para empoderar negócios dentro e fora da empresa. Conheça nossos grupos abaixo:

♿ Valorizamos a diversidade em nosso time, e desde 2017 nosso coletivo RDSum lidera ações afirmativas para inclusão, acolhimento e equidade de pessoas com deficiência na RD.

✊🏾 Valorizamos a inclusão racial e apoiamos iniciativas de enfrentamento ao racismo estrutural. Desde 2017, nosso coletivo Preto no Preto lidera ações afirmativas antirracistas de conscientização e equidade racial!

👩🏽‍💻Valorizamos e apoiamos a profissional mulher e mãe: somos uma das melhores empresas do país para mulheres trabalharem (ranking GPTW) e temos os grupos SER e Tech Ladies destinados ao empoderamento feminino.

🔒Alerta de segurança

Nossas oportunidades de emprego são divulgadas exclusivamente em nosso Trabalhe Conosco e espelhadas somente em nossas páginas oficiais da TOTVS no LinkedIn, Glassdoor e Indeed. A participação em nossos processos seletivos é 100% gratuita e nossas comunicações são enviadas apenas pelos domínios @rdstation.com, @totvs.com.br ou @carreiras.totvs.com.br.

Não solicitamos nenhum tipo de pagamento ou compra de cursos para sua participação. Caso você tenha recebido qualquer contato suspeito, reporte para nossa equipe.

Seu desafio no time:O time de Product Design da RD Station está vivendo um momento estratégico de evolução. Como Designer de Interação Pleno, você atuará na construção da visão de experiência do RD Station Conversas, com autonomia para simplificar jornadas complexas, fortalecer a influência de Design na squad e criar experiências rápidas e resolutivas para operações de atendimento.

Você será responsável por arquitetar experiências para funcionalidades essenciais do produto, eliminando atritos críticos na rotina das pessoas usuárias e contribuindo para a evolução do roadmap. Esperamos que você proponha visões de UI e UX para os domínios, equilibrando necessidades do negócio, excelência em experiência e priorização de débitos técnicos de Design.

Também fará parte do desafio fortalecer jornadas essenciais para o sucesso das pessoas clientes, reduzir pontos de atrito na percepção de valor do produto e reforçar a proposta de valor de recursos estratégicos. O sucesso da sua atuação será percebido pela melhoria da experiência, refletida em indicadores como NPS, redução de tickets relacionados a dificuldades de uso, identificação de oportunidades e aumento da adoção de funcionalidades do domínio.

Suas principais entregas:

  • Liderar o processo de Design, adaptando as etapas de Discovery e Delivery às necessidades da squad e promovendo a melhoria contínua dos métodos de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com Product Managers e Engenharia na estruturação de hipóteses e na influência do roadmap, priorizando usabilidade, redução de complexidade e evolução da experiência;
  • Propor soluções Lean e iterativas, utilizando aprendizados de testes e pesquisas para evoluir rapidamente da exploração à entrega final;
  • Conectar métricas de uso, adoção, engajamento e conversão às decisões de Design, acompanhando o impacto das soluções em produção;
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e não técnicas, conduzindo pesquisas, workshops e discussões que apoiem decisões compartilhadas e fortaleçam a cultura de pesquisa.

Perfil que buscamos:

  • Atuação como Product Designer, com domínio de Figma e de ferramentas de prototipagem;
  • Conhecimento em pesquisa estratégica, análise de dados, pesquisas de usabilidade e benchmark de produtos;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de informação para sistemas complexos, mapeamento de jornadas e Service Design;
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções viáveis, utilizando pensamento Lean, visão sistêmica e autonomia no dia a dia;
  • Habilidade de comunicar e defender decisões de Design com base em dados, negociar entregas e colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com produtos voltados para atendimento, comunicação, dados ou integrações;
  • Conhecimento sobre como produtos digitais são desenvolvidos e como decisões de Design impactam a arquitetura técnica;
  • Experiência na facilitação de workshops e dinâmicas colaborativas com diferentes áreas;
  • Vivência na condução de pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas em parceria com áreas como Customer Success e Vendas;
  • Interesse por tecnologia, inteligência artificial e aprendizado contínuo.

Etapas do processo seletivo:

  • Aplicação - Envio da inscrição;
  • Mindsight – Teste de estilo de trabalho;
  • Entrevista DigAí - Conversa inicial com a nossa ferramenta de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Talent Acquisition - Entrevista por competência com o time de recrutamento;
  • Entrevista Técnica - Entrevista técnica para discussão de requisitos da vaga;
  • Entrevista Final - Conversa final com a gerência para alinhamento;
  • Offer - Fase de conclusão do processo seletivo, com a apresentação da proposta de trabalho.

Obs: Podem ter etapas complementares e/ou alterações, de acordo com a necessidade do processo.

🔒 Nos comprometemos com a segurança dos seus dados! Em nosso Aviso de Privacidade, descrevemos quais dados coletamos, como são consumidos e armazenados, em conformidade com a LGPD.

Se você é uma pessoa movida por desafios, criatividade e impacto genuíno, avance conosco nessa jornada de evolução!

Faça parte do nosso time!

raw.description:
Partner One is a fast-growing investment group that acquires and operates industry leading software companies. Our mission is to build strong, sustainable organizations by empowering exceptional people and driving operational excellence across our portfolio. We maintain a decentralized model that allows each business unit to operate with agility while being supported by a global shared services infrastructure.

Description

We are seeking a Business Unit Controller to oversee the financial operations and performance of one or more software business units within the Partner One group. This role will serve as a strategic finance partner to business leadership and report directly to the CFO, playing a key role in ensuring accurate financial reporting, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate is hands-on, analytical, and results-oriented, with deep experience in accounting, financial planning, and operational finance within the software industry and complex, multi-entity environments. You will work closely with the CFO and senior leadership to drive financial performance, ensure operational excellence, and contribute to Partner One’s continued global growth and success.

Responsibilities

  • An Ideal candidate that can move comfortably between big picture ideas, and the tactics and action steps needed to flawlessly execute them.
  • Oversee all accounting and financial reporting activities for the assigned business unit(s), ensuring compliance with Partner One policies and relevant accounting standards (US GAAP).
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, including revenue recognition, accruals, reconciliations, and preparation of financial statements.
  • Monitor performance of the business unit(s) against targets, providing detailed variance analyses and insights to drive informed business decisions.
  • Develop and maintain key financial and operational metrics, including ARR, churn, deferred revenue, and EBITDA.
  • Partner with business leaders and the CFO to embed a cost-conscious culture focused on accountability, transparency, and value-driven decision-making.
  • Strengthen internal controls, streamline accounting workflows, and ensure financial integrity across systems and processes.
  • Collaborate with centralized finance teams (payroll, tax, treasury, AP/AR) to support efficient end-to-end operations.
  • Contribute to M&A integration efforts, including purchase accounting, opening balance sheets, and system transitions.
  • Manage audits, statutory filings, and compliance with local and international financial regulations.
  • Prioritize mentorship, team building, and coaching to local finance and accounting personnel

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA or equivalent professional designation preferred).
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in accounting or financial management, with at least 3 years in the software industry or a complex, multi-entity corporate environment.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS financial metrics and revenue recognition principles.
  • Proven experience with financial reporting, consolidation, budgeting, and analysis.
  • Proficiency in accounting systems such as Sage Intacct or NetSuite, and strong Excel and financial modeling skills.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote, and international work environment.
  • An ideal candidate must have demonstrated success in building teams and developing staff.
  • A candidate who is obsessed with process improvement, automation, and finding efficiencies in on-going operations

The estimated compensation range for this role is $110,000–$140,000 USD. Actual compensation will be based on the candidate’s country of residence, local market benchmarks, and relevant experience. Where required by local law, region‑specific pay ranges will be provided automatically on job boards or shared directly with applicants
