raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

The ideal candidate will containerize services using Docker, manage build, compilation, and publishing workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, and design robust multi-language build pipelines leveraging CMake or similar build tools.

The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.

  • Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.

  • Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.

  • Oversee the build, packaging, and publishing lifecycle for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, including versioning, semantic tagging, and NPM or internal registry publication.

  • Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

  • Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

  • Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

  • Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation.

  • Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

  • Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM.

  • In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

  • Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications

  • Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking.

  • Experience working in high-availability, security-sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts.

  • Experience deploying and managing blockchain-based applications.

  • Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

raw.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
raw.excerpt: About Us We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability.
raw.description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Description

Bueno (BUilt ENvironment Optimization) is a division of Copeland and a leader in Smart Building Analytics. The Bueno Platform and services connect to building equipment to identify issues, reduce energy consumption and optimize operations, helping businesses decarbonize their buildings.

At Bueno, listening and caring about our clients and partners is at the heart of what we do. We work in a complex ecosystem of stakeholders, incentives and constraints, and we give our teams the knowledge, tools and supportive environment to bring their true selves to work every day.


The Bueno and Verdant Partnership

Verdant by Copeland is a plug-and-play energy management offering that combines occupancy and thermal sensing, network connectivity and real-time analytics to cut heating and cooling waste in vacant rooms and shared spaces while preserving guest comfort. It serves hotels, senior living, student housing and multifamily properties, with more than 7,000 installed properties in North America (Copeland). Bueno and Verdant are building a joint offering for the hotel and hospitality market. This hire is the dedicated Customer Success lead for that partnership: the person who makes sure it works for hospitality customers, for Verdant's teams and for Bueno.


This role owns the success of Bueno's partnership with Verdant, another Copeland entity, and the hotel and hospitality customers that partnership serves. You will turn the Bueno Platform into a measurable part of how hotel owners, operators and management companies cut energy use, avoid equipment failures and hit sustainability targets, and you will be the day-to-day bridge between Bueno and Verdant teams.

As the Senior Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Own the Verdant Partnership: Act as the primary Bueno counterpart for Verdant. Build a joint success plan, run regular working sessions with Verdant leadership, sales and delivery teams, and keep both organizations aligned on priorities, pipeline, deployments and outcomes.
  • Build Strong Hospitality Relationships: Develop trusted relationships with hotel owners, asset managers, management companies and brand-level stakeholders, as well as general managers, chief engineers and facilities teams on property. Understand each group's goals, from guest comfort and operating cost to brand sustainability standards, and position Bueno as part of the solution.
  • Create Seamless Onboarding Experiences: Lead onboarding of new hospitality portfolios and properties, working with sales, product, services and Verdant to move from signed agreement to live, valuable analytics quickly and with minimal disruption to hotel operations.
  • Deliver Tailored Services and Support: Understand each property's equipment, operations and occupancy patterns, and deliver engineering analysis and reporting that solves real problems, such as HVAC and refrigeration faults, guest-room and central-plant energy waste, kitchen and cold-storage performance, and comfort complaints.
  • Plan for Customer and Partner Success: Develop and execute success plans aligned with client and partner objectives. Identify adoption, expansion and cross-sell opportunities across portfolios, hand them to the account management team, and consistently demonstrate the value delivered.
  • Provide Responsive Issue Support: Serve as the escalation point for client and partner questions and issues beyond what our monitoring and support teams handle, and work across Bueno and Verdant to resolve them promptly.
  • Empower with Training and Education: Train property engineering teams, operators and Verdant staff on Bueno's features and best practices so insights turn into action on site.
  • Advocate with Customer Feedback: Gather feedback from hospitality clients and Verdant, and bring hospitality-specific requirements and pain points to account management and product teams to shape the roadmap and the joint offering.
  • Track and Report Performance: Monitor adoption (MAU), retention (NRR), satisfaction (NPS), realized energy savings and partnership health. Prepare reports and executive summaries for Bueno and Verdant leadership.
  • Help Scale Bueno in the US: Improve tools and processes, build repeatable playbooks for hospitality and partner-led deployments, and take on new responsibilities as the team grows.

Required education, experiences & skills:

  • 5+ years in customer success, account management or client-facing delivery for B2B software or services, ideally in the hospitality, hotel, commercial real estate or building technology space
  • 3+ years managing complex, multi-level stakeholder relationships, including executives, operators and technical teams
  • Experience managing or growing a strategic partnership or channel relationship, including working across organizations that have different priorities and ways of working
  • Working knowledge of HVAC, refrigeration and other building systems, energy efficiency, energy calculations, and measurement and verification (M&V)
  • Strong understanding of the built environment and building services, and how commercial buildings are operated and maintained
  • Strong ability to work in cross-functional remote teams
  • Excellent project and task management skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, including executive-level presentations
  • Demonstrated proactiveness and ability to self-manage
  • Must be authorized to work full time in the US
  • The ability to travel up to 20%

Highly Desired

We will give strong preference to candidates with hotel and hospitality experience, including:

  • Direct experience working with hotel owners, operators, management companies or brands, and an understanding of how decisions are made across ownership, management and property levels
  • Familiarity with hotel operations and engineering, including central plants, guest-room HVAC, kitchens and cold storage, laundry and pools, and the trade-off between energy savings and guest comfort
  • Knowledge of hospitality sustainability and energy programs, such as brand ESG commitments, benchmarking and certification schemes (for example ENERGY STAR, LEED or Green Key), and utility and decarbonization reporting
  • Experience with hospitality technology such as building management systems, guest-room management systems and property management systems
  • Experience selling or delivering energy services, efficiency or smart building solutions through a partner, such as an OEM, service provider or technology alliance
  • Experience in rapidly scaling, mission-driven teams where you have built processes and playbooks from scratch

raw.excerpt: Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.
raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

About our team:

Cortex XCOR is Palo Alto Networks' observability platform optimized for containerized environments. It optimizes costs, reduces data complexity by up to 89%, and enables faster issue remediation for industry leaders like DoorDash, Affirm, and Zillow.


XCOR Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM) directly connects end-user experience insights with underlying backend observability, answering a question infrastructure dashboards cannot: are my users having a good experience? A slow service stops being a one dimensional chart and becomes a representation of a slow path through checkout: from the user who experienced it, to the service, the deploy, and the query responsible. By integrating synthetic and real-user data into the broader service stack, XCOR allows teams, from SREs to executives, to trace user-impacting issues from symptom to root cause seamlessly.

DEM has two sides. Real user monitoring tells you what your customers experienced on their device, their network, their browser, in the moment it mattered. Synthetic monitoring tells you whether the journeys you care most about work right now, tested deliberately and continuously, from the places your customers are, whether or not anyone happens to be using them.


Job Summary

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own synthetic monitoring for Cortex XCOR. You will translate front-end testing requirements from SREs and frontend developers (browser click-paths, multi-step API journeys, and underlying protocol checks) into a unified product that can be defined as code and executed globally or within customer networks.


In collaboration with the RUM team, you will unify synthetic and real-user monitoring data so that synthetic failures seamlessly correlate with affected user cohorts.


This is an early-stage build role where you will drive the core decisions defining the product.

Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct primary research with SREs, front-end developers, and platform teams to understand current journey-testing workflows and pain points.
  • Maintain close contact with customers, design partners, and field teams through discovery calls and interviews.
  • Participate in sales calls where synthetic coverage is critical, gathering feedback to inform roadmap prioritization.
  • Partner with engineers and technical stakeholders to articulate, scope, and deliver one coherent product.
  • Build on XCOR's industry-leading observability platform so that synthetic results arrive as OpenTelemetry-native signals and correlate with the metrics, traces, and logs teams already have.
  • Own the execution model: how tests are scheduled, where they run, what a customer is charged for, and how they keep control of it.
  • Partner with the RUM product team to integrate synthetic and real user data into unified customer workflows.
  • Set KPIs to articulate and measure intended value and impact for customers.
  • Own the roadmap end to end: build it, sequence it, communicate it, and keep the team and the business aligned on its evolution.
  • Lead across teams to ensure cohesive features and workflows are seamless across the platform.
  • Partner with product marketing on positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.

What you will achieve

You are joining while the product is still being designed. That is the point of the role, and it sets the pace.

In your first 30 days, you will analyze the market, engage in active design discussions, meet with customers, and identify key gaps to establish ownership of the product strategy.

Within six months, you will establish a competitive product offering, defining key performance metrics, addressing critical competitive gaps, and delivering a sequenced plan for the team to build against.

This suits someone who is energized by an empty page and a short runway, and who can hold a strong opinion about a product that does not exist yet.


Qualifications

You'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience as a product manager, with deep knowledge of enterprise software.
  • Experience with monitoring, testing, or developer infrastructure products such as synthetic monitoring, end-to-end browser testing, API testing, or CI/CD tooling.
  • Working knowledge of how modern web applications are tested end to end: browser automation (Playwright, Selenium, Cypress), HTTP and API testing, and the protocol layer underneath (DNS, TCP, TLS).
  • A track record of taking a product from zero to one
  • The presence to carry this in the room. You'll present to the customer's senior leadership and to our own executives, and be the one answering the hard questions.
  • A history of shipping with agile processes and tight feedback loops.
  • An obsession with getting the little details right.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI in the Product Development Lifecycle for everything from document writing to prototyping while ensuring your own thoughts and ideas are well represented in content. Agents are used to reduce toil, not as a replacement for critical thinking skills.

Helpful, not required:

  • Familiarity with observability in general, OpenTelemetry specifically and how telemetry data is collected, correlated, and stored.
  • Experience building AI Native products with knowledge around building and/or maintaining MCP server(s).
  • Familiarity with the digital experience monitoring category and how real user and synthetic data get used together. Core Web Vitals, user journeys, JavaScript exceptions and what each one can and cannot tell you.
  • Comfort with test-as-code and infrastructure-as-code workflows, and with the CI/CD pipelines engineering teams run them in.
  • Experience building and operating software as a service, including the unit economics of running customer workloads.
  • Experience with design-led product development principles and best practices

Location

US - Remote

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$176,800.00 - $286,000.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About the Company

Our client is a performance-focused digital growth agency specializing in paid media and customer acquisition for e-commerce brands. The team helps ambitious businesses scale through strategic advertising, data-driven experimentation, and a strong focus on measurable commercial outcomes.

They are looking for an experienced Google Ads specialist who understands how to scale advertising campaigns profitably, manage substantial media budgets, and turn performance data into actionable growth strategies.

Job Summary

We are hiring a Senior Media Buyer / Paid Search & YouTube Specialist to manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns for established e-commerce brands.

You'll take ownership of the day-to-day execution across approximately four client accounts, working with significant advertising budgets and focusing on profitable customer acquisition.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused position for someone who is highly proficient in Google Ads, understands e-commerce unit economics, and can independently launch, test, troubleshoot, and optimize campaigns.

The ideal candidate has experience managing brands spending high five to six figures per month on paid advertising and knows how to drive results beyond surface-level metrics like clicks and impressions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Google Ads Management: Execute and optimize campaigns across Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max (PMax), Demand Gen, and YouTube Ads.
  • E-commerce Growth: Manage paid media performance with a focus on purchases, customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS), and profitability.
  • Campaign Execution: Build, launch, monitor, and continuously improve campaigns across approximately four client accounts.
  • Testing & Experimentation: Develop and execute structured testing strategies covering creative assets, audiences, bidding strategies, campaign structures, and landing pages.
  • Budget Optimization: Allocate and adjust advertising spend to maximize efficiency, conversion volume, and profitable growth.
  • Attribution & Analytics: Analyze performance using Google Ads, GA4, and third-party attribution platforms to inform optimization decisions.
  • Performance Reporting: Prepare clear, insightful weekly written performance reports highlighting results, trends, challenges, and next steps.
  • Problem-Solving: Identify underperforming campaigns, diagnose performance issues, and implement effective solutions.
  • Collaboration: Communicate clearly with internal stakeholders and contribute to performance discussions and growth initiatives.

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns for e-commerce businesses.
  • Advanced proficiency across Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen, and YouTube advertising.
  • Proven experience working with e-commerce brands spending high five to six figures per month on paid media.
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize for purchases, CAC, ROAS, and business profitability rather than traffic or engagement metrics alone.
  • Experience managing multiple advertising accounts simultaneously while maintaining high execution standards.
  • Familiarity with attribution platforms such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Rockerbox, or similar solutions.
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence interpreting campaign performance, conversion data, and attribution insights.
  • Ability to independently manage campaign launches, testing, ongoing optimization, and performance reporting.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate complex performance insights clearly.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Availability for significant working-hour overlap with the US Eastern time zone.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).
  • Experience scaling e-commerce brands with substantial monthly advertising budgets.
  • Advanced knowledge of GA4, conversion tracking, and attribution methodologies.
  • Experience working within a performance marketing agency or managing multiple e-commerce clients.
  • Experience developing or optimizing YouTube and Demand Gen creative testing strategies.

Benefits

🌎 100% Remote: Work from anywhere while collaborating with international teams.

💰 Competitive Compensation: Salary based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

🚀 Career Growth: Opportunities to develop your expertise and take ownership of high-impact performance marketing campaigns.

📈 International Exposure: Work with growing businesses and marketing teams across global markets.

🎯 Meaningful Impact: Directly influence campaign performance, lead generation, and revenue growth.

🤝 Collaborative Environment: Join a supportive team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

💻 Long-Term Opportunity: Build your career with an ambitious, growth-focused company.

raw.description:
About Re:Build

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)

Who we are looking for

Re:Build Manufacturing is growing, and we’re looking for a Director of Campaigns to help shape how we go to market. Reporting to the Vice President of Demand Generation, you’ll own the strategy, planning, and execution of integrated campaigns that drive measurable pipeline across our portfolio of businesses and offerings.

You know how to turn business priorities into a focused campaign roadmap and bring marketing teams together to execute it. You’ve worked in complex, multi-product environments where audiences, buying cycles, and value propositions vary, and you can translate that complexity into clear messages and coordinated programs.

You’re comfortable turning ambiguity into action, staying close to the work, and building the processes that help teams scale. You bring a clear, calm leadership style, set direction without adding noise, and make it easier for the people around you to do their best work.

What you get to do

  • Own the integrated campaign roadmap, prioritizing audiences, offerings, and programs based on business goals, pipeline opportunity, and available resources.
  • Lead campaign strategy, planning, and execution across Re:Build’s businesses and offerings, keeping teams aligned on priorities and responsibilities.
  • Translate complex capabilities and value propositions into clear, compelling campaign messaging that speaks to distinct audiences and moves them toward a decision.
  • Partner with marketing teams across Re:Build’s businesses to develop campaigns that reflect customer needs, support different buying cycles, and align with shared pipeline goals.
  • Coordinate content, channels, and campaign timing so programs reinforce one another and create a consistent experience for prospective customers.
  • Partner with marketing teams to build generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) practices into campaign content and planning.
  • Own campaign performance against agreed pipeline goals, using results to recommend where to invest, adjust, or stop activity.
  • Build repeatable planning and execution processes that give teams clarity and help campaigns scale.

What you bring to the Team

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in B2B campaign marketing.
  • Proven success building and managing integrated campaigns in complex, multi-product environments.
  • A track record of owning a campaign roadmap and connecting campaign activity to measurable pipeline outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex value propositions into clear, compelling messaging for distinct audiences.
  • Hands-on experience with GEO and AEO, including developing content for AI-powered search and answer engines.
  • Experience working across a matrixed organization and aligning marketing teams around shared campaign priorities.
  • Strong planning and execution skills, with the ability to keep the bigger picture in view while making sure the details get done right.
  • A clear, calm leadership style that builds trust and brings focus to fast-moving teams.
  • Experience marketing in the manufacturing industry preferred.

Compensation (Exempt)

The base salary range for this position is $120,000 –180,000 per year. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.

The BIG payoff

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate. Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate

Re:Build Manufacturing is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at or you may call us at 617.909.6275.

Agentur für Haushaltshilfe

Die Nr. 1 für professionelle Haushaltshilfe und Alltagsbegleitung in Deutschland.

Unser Ziel ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass hilfsbedürftige Menschen da leben können, wo sie sich am wohlsten fühlen - und das ist in ihrem Zuhause. Seit 2018 sind wir binnen 8 Jahren zum führenden Anbieter für Haushaltshilfe und Alltagsbegleitung in Deutschland gewachsen. Mit mehr als 14.000 Mitarbeitern betreuen wir deutschlandweit über 114.000 Kunden. Du möchtest etwas Sinnvolles tun? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Unser Spirit

  • Wir haben Teamgeist und wissen, dass man die besten Ergebnisse gemeinsam erzielt

  • Wir bauen auf Wertschätzung, Respekt, Motivation, Vertrauen & Verantwortung

  • Wir kommunizieren offen, ehrlich & fair

  • Wir machen Fehler, doch wir lernen daraus

  • Wir fördern individuelle Talente

  • Wir sind interkulturell

Das bieten wir dir

  • Flexible (familienfreundliche) Arbeitszeiten – Montag-Freitag, Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (min. 30 Std./Woche)

  • Eigenständiges Arbeiten – mit unbefristeter Festanstellung in einer Branche mit Zukunft

  • Individuelle Schulungen und Begleitung durch unsere Teamkoordinatoren

  • Corporate Benefits – Mitarbeiterrabatte mit exklusiven Vergünstigungen

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel – Diensthandy & Laptop

  • Team-Events – wie Sommerfest und Weihnachtsfeier

Nach der Probezeit:

  • Betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung – Gesundheitsbudget von 600€ pro Jahr

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – plus Arbeitgeberzuschuss

  • TOP Dienstwagen mit Tankkarte – zur vollen privaten Nutzung (nach bestimmten Kriterien)

  • Deutschlandticket – als Jobticket (bezuschusst)

  • Jobbike

Requirements

Deine Rolle

  • Du bist das Gesicht der Agentur für Haushaltshilfe in deiner Region

  • Marketing- und Vertriebsmaßnahmen – Aufbau deines eigenen Teams aus Haushaltshilfen und Kunden

  • Koordinierung deines Teams – Betreuung aller hilfsbedürftigen Kunden in deinem Bezirk sicherstellen

  • Ansprechpartner für deinen Bezirk – du vertrittst deinen Bezirk bei allen Anliegen und Entscheidungen gegenüber der Zentrale

Selbstverständlich bist du nicht allein. Unser Team in der Zentrale hält dir den Rücken frei und unterstützt dich tatkräftig beim Ausbau deines Bezirks und beim Führen deines Teams.

Das bringst du mit

  • Eigenverantwortliches und selbstständiges Handeln

  • Kontaktfreudig, kommunikativ und schaffst gerne Verbindungen zwischen Menschen

  • Sorgfältige, nachhaltige und gründliche Arbeitsweise

  • Stehst gern im Mittelpunkt und machst dich in deiner Region bekannt

  • Du möchtest dich beruflich umorientieren? Werde Teil des Teams, Quereinsteiger sind bei uns willkommen!

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1)

Jetzt bewerben und Leben verändern!

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Program Manager with a solid background in the mining industry to lead and coordinate strategic initiatives in Central America. The role oversees the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple interrelated mining projects: spanning exploration, development, operations readiness, stakeholder engagement, and institutional relations and also ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, regulatory requirements, and local community expectations.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end program management for mining initiatives in Central America, integrating exploration, technical studies, permitting, and operational readiness workstreams.

  • Define program scope, objectives, milestones, budgets, and resource plans, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (geology, engineering, environmental, legal, finance, community relations) and external consultants.

  • Manage relationships with government authorities, regulators, and local institutions to advance permits, concessions, and policy engagement.

  • Drive community and stakeholder engagement programs aligned with social license and ESG commitments.

  • Monitor program risks, dependencies, and critical path; implement mitigation plans and escalate issues to the steering committee.

  • Establish governance, reporting cadences, and KPIs across projects; produce executive-level updates.

  • Oversee program budgets, capital expenditure tracking, and vendor/contract management.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, international mining standards, and HSE requirements.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in Project/Program Management, Business, or related field preferred.

  • Solid understanding of the mining lifecycle: exploration, feasibility, permitting, construction, and operations.

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in the mining industry, with at least 3-5 years managing complex programs or multi-project portfolios.

  • Program/project management certification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience working with government authorities, regulators, and local communities, ideally in Latin America.

  • Track record managing budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams in greenfield or brownfield mining environments.

  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural communication skills.

  • Excellent planning, organizational, and risk-management capabilities.

  • Proficiency in program management tools (MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and reporting platforms.

  • Strong written and verbal communication in Spanish and English.

  • Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and resilience in complex, high-visibility environments.

Preferred / Advantageous

  • Prior experience operating in Central America.

  • Familiarity with ESG frameworks, social performance standards (IFC PS, ICMM), and community development programs.

  • Experience interacting with public-sector counterparts and multilateral institutions.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

raw.description:
Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

By embodying our core purpose of customer obsession, new ideas, and driving innovation, and delivering excellence, you will help ensure that every touchpoint is meaningful and contributes to our mission of redefining the possible healthcare.

The Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Ingestion serves as the primary delivery owner and client-facing point of contact for a portfolio of complex, interconnected data ingestion and integration initiatives. This role independently leads programs across multiple clients, platforms, engineering teams, and operational workstreams from intake through production readiness and stabilization, with accountability for technical roadmaps, scope, schedules, releases, risks, dependencies, change control, governance, and delivery outcomes. The Senior Technical Program Manager partners with data engineering, product, operations, security, infrastructure, architecture, and business stakeholders to translate business objectives into technical program requirements, assess feasibility and sequencing, resolve cross-project issues, and recommend delivery tradeoffs and corrective actions. Although this role does not perform the technical build directly, it applies strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations and data integration concepts—including file feeds, interfaces, APIs, data pipelines, validation, and production readiness—to challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and deliver measurable client and operational outcomes.


II. Job Competencies


Collaboration - Works cooperatively within teams and partners with others, both internally and externally as needed, to achieve success; focuses on the results of the team, not the achievements of one person. It's "All for One and One for All."


Communication – Communicates clearly, professionally, and effectively with internal and external stakeholders; listens actively, shares information in a timely manner, and adapts messaging to the audience.


Time Management - Effectively manages personal time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently across multiple concurrent client projects.


Accountability - Accepts personal responsibility and/or consequences of failure and successes, delivering on commitments and refocusing effort when needed.


Developing Trust - Gains others' confidence by acting with integrity and following through on commitments; treats others and their ideas with respect and supports them in the face of challenges.


Takes Initiative - Takes prompt action to accomplish goals and achieve results beyond what is required; is proactive and pursues relentlessly.


Technical Program Management - Independently leads a portfolio of complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from strategy and intake through release, production stabilization, and outcome realization; establishes program governance and owns roadmaps, scope, schedules, resources, risks, dependencies, change control, executive communication, and delivery tradeo

ffs.


III. Essential Job Functions


Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.


Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.


Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our "Best in KLAS" Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.


Serve as the primary program delivery owner and client-facing point of contact for a portfolio of complex, interconnected data ingestion and integration initiatives spanning multiple clients, platforms, engineering teams, and operational workstreams.


Develop and manage integrated technical program roadmaps, milestone plans, release schedules, status dashboards, and governance routines that align cross-project scope, sequencing, resources, deliverables, timelines, and expected outcomes.


Lead cross-functional delivery across clients, data engineering, product, operations, security, infrastructure, architecture, and business teams; coordinate resources, manage technical and operational dependencies, remove blockers, and drive timely decisions without performing the technical build directly.


Establish and lead program governance, operating rhythms, stakeholder forums, and executive steering updates; document decisions and action items and ensure accountable owners complete commitments within agreed timelines.


Translate business objectives into technical program requirements and acceptance criteria for client interfaces, flat file feeds, APIs, data pipelines, validation, security, and production readiness, ensuring alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Lead intake, technical feasibility assessment, prioritization, and change control for new initiatives and change requests; evaluate architecture, integration, security, infrastructure, resource, and sequencing impacts and facilitate portfolio-level tradeoff decisions.


Apply knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations and technical delivery practices to assess client priorities, translate business needs into actionable program requirements, and communicate the operational and client impact of engineering decisions.


Own cross-project RAID management and escalation plans; proactively evaluate risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints across the program and recommend mitigation, contingency, recovery, or reprioritization actions to clients and senior leadership.


Define and monitor program metrics for delivery predictability, implementation timeliness, production readiness, data quality, defect reduction, client satisfaction, and post-launch operational stability; provide executive-level reporting on performance, decisions, variances, resource needs, and recovery plans.


Drive coordinated releases across ingestion workstreams through requirements confirmation, design readiness, testing, validation, production deployment, and stabilization, ensuring technical dependencies are resolved and agreed quality and acceptance criteria are met.


Establish and continuously improve technical program delivery standards, templates, controls, metrics, and governance; promote consistent Agile and software delivery lifecycle practices and provide guidance to project coordinators or less experienced program team members as needed.


Consistently leverage generative AI and productivity tools to streamline coordination, documentation, and communication tasks.


This document is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, or working conditions associated with the job. Associates may be required to perform other job related duties as required by their supervisor, subject to reasonable accommodation.


IV. Employment Qualifications


5+ years of progressive experience leading technical programs, project portfolios, implementations, client delivery, or data integration initiatives, in healthcare or healthcare technology.


Demonstrated success independently leading enterprise-scale, cross-functional technical programs or portfolios with accountability for integrated roadmaps, releases, governance, scope, schedules, resources, risks, dependencies, change control, and measurable delivery outcomes.


Working knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations (Nice to have), Agile delivery, the software development lifecycle, and data integration concepts, including HL7, flat file feeds, interfaces, APIs, cloud platforms, data pipelines, testing, validation, security considerations, and production readiness; deep coding expertise is not required.


Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and executive-level communication skills, with demonstrated ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences, present recommendations to senior leadership, influence priorities and tradeoff decisions, and manage client escalations.

👉 About the job

At Enertis Applus+, we are looking for a Renewable Energy Consultant to join our Consulting team in Poland. In this role, you will support the technical assessment of renewable energy projects across Poland and Eastern Europe, delivering feasibility studies and technical due diligence for solar PV, wind and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). You will work closely with developers, investors and financial institutions, providing technical expertise throughout the project development and investment process.

🛠️ What will you do?

Your main responsibilities will include: Conduct feasibility studies and technical due diligence for renewable energy projects. Assess project sites, identifying technical, environmental and permitting constraints. Review permits, licenses, authorizations and regulatory documentation. Evaluate grid connection agreements and coordinate technical discussions with TSOs and DSOs. Review engineering documentation at conceptual, basic and detailed design stages. Identify technical risks and recommend mitigation measures. Prepare high-quality technical reports and client deliverables in English. Support commercial proposals, tenders and client presentations. Contribute to business development activities across the Polish and Eastern European markets.

🎯 What are we looking for?

We are looking for talent, not perfection. If you believe you can contribute to the team, even if your profile does not fit 100%, we want to hear from you.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another STEM discipline. 5+ years of experience in renewable energy development, engineering or consultancy. Experience with Solar PV, Wind and/or BESS projects. Strong knowledge of the Polish renewable energy market, permitting processes, grid connection and applicable regulations. Experience preparing technical due diligence or feasibility studies. Strong analytical, reporting and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and client management abilities. Fluent Polish and good command of English. Spanish is considered a plus.

🌍 What do we offer?

Opportunity to work on renewable energy projects across Poland and Eastern Europe. The opportunity to join a consolidated technical team that is a benchmark in the sector. Professional growth opportunities with a well-defined career plan. Be part of a company in constant expansion. Flexible work arrangement with remote working from Poland. Full-time or part-time collaboration under an Employment Contract or B2B agreement. International and multidisciplinary working environment.

raw.description:
Work Flexibility: Remote or Hybrid or Onsite

It's Time to Join Stryker!


Location: Weston, FL (Preferred) | Kalamazoo, MI (Considered) | Remote/Hybrid Flexibility Subject to Approval


Are you passionate about designing intuitive, high-quality software experiences that make a meaningful impact? Join Stryker's Mako Robotics team and help shape the user interfaces that support robotic-assisted orthopedic surgery.


As a Staff level User Interface and Experience Designer, you'll play a key role in developing the software experiences used in Mako's hip replacement applications. You'll combine strong visual and interaction design expertise with hands-on technical execution, translating complex workflows into intuitive interfaces and detailed, production-ready design specifications.


This is an opportunity to contribute to both current and next-generation Mako technologies. You'll help deliver critical UI designs for existing applications while collaborating across engineering, product development, and design teams to influence the future of robotic-assisted surgery.


You'll join a collaborative, geographically distributed team that values creativity, attention to detail, technical excellence, and the ability to take ownership of your work.


What You Will Do

User Interface Design & Development

  • Design and develop intuitive, visually consistent software interfaces for Mako robotic-assisted surgery applications, with an initial focus on Total Hip Arthroplasty (THA).
  • Create high-fidelity interface designs, screen layouts, interactive prototypes, and reusable UI components using Figma and established design systems.
  • Translate complex clinical workflows, product requirements, and user needs into clear, functional, and accessible software experiences.
  • Apply visual and interaction design principles, including typography, color, layout, navigation, messaging, component states, and user feedback.
  • Develop detailed, production-ready UI specifications that accurately communicate design intent to software development teams.
  • Create and manage design assets, component libraries, naming conventions, documentation, and version-controlled design deliverables.

User Experience & Product Development

  • Contribute to the development of next-generation Mako applications through workflow analysis, concept exploration, prototyping, and iterative design.
  • Collaborate with UX researchers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to incorporate user feedback, clinical insights, and usability considerations into design solutions.
  • Support design reviews, usability evaluations, and voice-of-customer activities to refine interfaces and improve the overall user experience.
  • Balance user needs, technical feasibility, design consistency, and product requirements throughout the development process.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Design Ownership

  • Partner closely with software engineers, scrum teams, product owners, systems engineers, and other designers to support successful implementation of UI designs.
  • Collaborate with design teams across Mako's hip, knee, and shoulder applications to maintain consistency within shared software platforms and design systems.
  • Independently manage assigned design activities, proactively resolve challenges, and drive deliverables from concept through implementation.
  • Communicate design decisions, technical specifications, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of design processes, documentation standards, tools, and team practices.
  • Support applicable medical device design controls, usability, and quality requirements throughout product development.

What You Will Need


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in User Interface Design, User Experience Design, Interaction Design, Industrial Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience is required.
  • 4 or more years of professional experience in UI/UX design, software product design, interaction design, or a closely related field is required.
  • Proficiency with Figma, including experience working with shared design systems, component libraries, and high-fidelity interface designs is required.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator and Photoshop is required.

Preferred Qualifications (You do not need to all of these)

  • Experience designing software interfaces, creating interactive prototypes, and applying established visual and interaction design principles.
  • A portfolio or representative work samples demonstrating relevant user interface design capabilities.
  • Experience developing detailed UI specifications, design documentation, component definitions, and production-ready assets for software development teams.
  • Strong visual design, graphic design, and illustration skills, including creating instructional graphics, icons, and informational illustrations.
  • Experience with complex software applications, technical systems, or products requiring highly detailed and consistent user interfaces.
  • Experience with 3D modeling or rendering tools such as KeyShot, SolidWorks, or similar applications.
  • Experience designing software for medical devices, surgical systems, robotics, or other regulated or safety-critical industries.
  • Familiarity with usability engineering, accessibility principles, human factors, and user-centered design methodologies.
  • Experience collaborating with software development teams in Agile or Scrum environments.
  • Understanding of software development practices and how UI designs are translated into functional applications.
  • Experience collaborating across distributed teams and working independently within a matrixed organization.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, proactive communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Job Title: Azure Virtual Desktop and Mobility AdministratorJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI’s EITaaS Program is a Department of the Air Force (DAF) initiative, which includes the Air Force and Space Force. EITaaS will transform the Dept. of the Air Force IT services from an in-house, base-centric delivery model to an advanced enterprise service delivery model. CACI will provide an enhanced IT management system, IT storefront, enterprise help desk, local field services, and life cycle support for end-user devices.

CACI’s innovative approach to enterprise technology infuses contemporary technologies with industry best practices to deliver commercial-style services that will improve customer experience and productivity for the Dept. of the Air Force’s global workforce. CACI and its partners will equip Airmen and Guardians with state-of-the-art services and automated capabilities that enable access to the tools they need to perform their mission efficiently and effectively when they need it, where they need it.

Responsibilities:

The Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and Mobility Administrator will serve on the Mobility and Remote Access Services (MRAS) team to support the DAF in operating, sustaining, and improving enterprise Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) and mobility capabilities. The administrator will support the delivery of secure remote access and virtual desktop services, including Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft Intune, for the EITaaS program, and users across 187 bases.

Working with the Team Lead and engineering teams, the AVD and Mobility Administrator will also support the transition of new capabilities from engineering into operations, including operational hand-off and post-deployment monitoring.

More About the Role:

  • Responsible for working with Team Lead in administrating and maintaining Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) and Mobile Device Management (MDM) technologies based on Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft Intune.
  • Support project activities and client contact that addresses the operational transition, deployment, and retirement services.
  • Support the execution of PowerShell scripts and other deployment capabilities to automate Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) functionality and operations.
  • Triage and troubleshoot AVD and mobility user and system issues, providing remediation steps to resolve them.
  • Support Windows Zero Touch Implementation (ZTI) processes for AVD solutions.
  • Support the management and maintenance of Azure AVD resources and OS images; deploy monthly OS and application patches to existing AVD VMs.

raw.description:
About CoVet

At CoVet, we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.

Veterinary teams are stretched thin. Long hours, administrative burden, and burnout are challenges across the industry. We're on a mission to change that. Our AI copilot helps veterinary professionals save time, improve workflows, and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care.

We're a globally distributed team united by a shared mission to support veterinary professionals through thoughtful technology. We move quickly, collaborate openly, and believe great ideas can come from anyone.

If you're excited by the opportunity to shape the future of veterinary medicine while working alongside an ambitious and supportive team, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

We operate across around 20 markets and 12 languages, and our paid media, content and campaign activity is growing fast.

Great creative is what makes that activity work. As our marketing programme scales, we need more high-quality creative, made faster, across more markets and formats, while keeping a consistent and recognisable brand.

What you'll do

We are hiring a Designer to create marketing creative across paid media, web, social, events and sales materials.

This is a hands-on, high-output role for a designer who enjoys variety and pace. You will work closely with performance marketing to produce and iterate ad creative, and with content, product marketing and events teams on everything from landing pages to presentations.

You will create and adapt creative across formats, including:

  • Static and motion ad creative for paid social and display, with variants for testing
  • Landing pages and website visuals
  • Social media graphics and short-form video assets
  • Email and lifecycle campaign visuals
  • presentation decks for sales, partnerships, events and leadership
  • Event materials, print collateral and booth graphics
  • Localised versions of creative for markets across North America, Europe and Oceania

You will also:

  • Apply and help evolve the CoVet brand system across every touchpoint
  • Use performance data to learn what creative works and feed it into the next round
  • Build reusable templates and work with design automation tools to increase speed and volume
  • Manage your own workload across several requesters and seasonal peaks

Cross-functional collaboration

This role will work closely with:

  • Performance Marketing: to brief, produce and iterate ad creative against test results
  • Content and Community: to create visuals for articles, social, case studies and campaigns
  • Product Marketing: to support launches, feature announcements and in-app messaging
  • Events and Sales: to produce event collateral, presentations and sales enablement materials

What success looks like

raw.title: Inbound Account Executive
raw.excerpt: Who we arePhorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.
raw.description:
Who we are

Phorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.

Today, we're a SaaS company and a trusted partner to over 155,000 hair, beauty and medspa professionals worldwide. Our all-in-one software and AI-driven tools help them manage bookings, take payments, market their services, grow their client base and get the best from their teams.

Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive.

We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of the company is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that

The Opportunity

We're looking for a driven, commercially minded Inbound Account Executive to join our growing North American Sales team at Phorest.

At Phorest, we help salon, spa and beauty business owners do what they love while giving them the tools to run and grow successful businesses.

As an Inbound Account Executive, you'll play a key role in that journey. You'll work with business owners who have already expressed an interest in Phorest, understanding their challenges, demonstrating how our software can make a difference and helping them make the right decision for their business.

You'll own the full sales cycle, from initial discovery and product demonstrations through to negotiation and closing. You'll be managing a steady flow of inbound opportunities, so the ability to move quickly, prioritise effectively and convert interest into new business while delivering a great customer experience will be key.

Our core focus is the salon and spa industry, but as we continue to grow in the MedSpa market, experience in medical aesthetics or the wider beauty and wellness space would be a real bonus.

If you love sales, enjoy building relationships with business owners and thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle: Manage inbound opportunities from qualification and discovery through to product demonstrations, negotiation and closing.

  • Convert inbound interest into new business: Respond quickly to prospective customers, qualify opportunities and keep momentum throughout the sales process.

  • Lead great discovery conversations: Get to know salon and spa owners, understand their business challenges and goals, and identify where Phorest can add real value.

  • Bring Phorest to life: Deliver engaging, tailored software demonstrations that show customers how our platform can help them save time, grow revenue and improve their client experience.

  • Sell on value: Clearly communicate the benefits of Phorest's software, including appointment management, integrated payments, marketing automation and client retention tools.

  • Manage a busy pipeline: Balance multiple opportunities, prioritise effectively and follow up consistently to maximise conversion without compromising the customer experience.

  • Own your numbers: Take accountability for your performance, maintain accurate CRM records and forecasts, and consistently work towards achieving your sales targets.

  • Build strong relationships: Establish trust with business owners and decision-makers, helping them feel confident in choosing Phorest.

  • Work as one team: Partner with Marketing, Sales Development, Onboarding and Customer Success to deliver a great experience from first conversation through to becoming a customer.

  • Embrace technology: Use sales tools, data and AI to work smarter, improve productivity and make the most of every opportunity.

  • Keep learning: Stay curious about our products, competitors and the wider beauty and wellness industry, always looking for ways to improve.

Who You Are

  • Ideally 3–5 years of full-cycle sales experience, preferably in SaaS, B2B technology or a similar environment. We're equally interested in candidates who can demonstrate strong sales performance and potential.

  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets, converting opportunities and closing new business.

  • Experience managing a high volume of sales opportunities, with the ability to balance speed, quality and conversion.

  • A consultative approach to selling. You ask good questions, listen carefully and focus on finding the right solution rather than simply delivering a pitch.

  • Confidence leading discovery calls, delivering product demonstrations, handling objections and negotiating deals.

  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to understand what matters to a business owner.

  • Excellent organisation and time management skills, with a disciplined approach to pipeline management and follow-up.

  • Experience using a CRM, such as Salesforce, to manage opportunities and track performance.

  • An interest in technology and AI, with a willingness to explore new tools and ways of working.

  • A self-motivated, proactive approach. You're comfortable taking ownership of your results and working towards ambitious goals.

  • A growth mindset. You're open to feedback, keen to develop and always looking to sharpen your sales skills.

  • A genuine interest in helping small and medium-sized businesses succeed.

Benefits

🧘 Phorest currently offers a range of fully employer-paid benefits including Medical, Dental, Life, AD&D, Short Term Disability, an EAP, and wellness perks.

💰 Employees also have access to optional extras, such as a 401(k) and a range of upgraded insurance options.

🤓 Career development is important to us. We even have our own in-house Learning and Development/Business coach and many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

😎 We like to have fun, build camaraderie through regular social events.

👯 Phorest also encourages Employee Resource Groups, you will have the opportunity to join or champion a club, society, or group.

Phorest is an equal opportunities employer. We value diversity at our company and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Information Systems Engineer 1 — User Access & Identity Operations

About the Role & Team

As an IT Support Specialist 1, you will be part of our central nearshore engineering hub in Brazil supporting global User Access Provisioning (UAP) and Identity Management platforms. In this role, you will handle frontline access lifecycle management, leverage AI-driven diagnostic tools for rapid ticket triage, and execute automated onboarding and offboarding workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Access Lifecycle Operations: Execute routine identity provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement modifications across enterprise systems including Okta, Active Directory, and SailPoint IIQ.
  • AI & Automated Triage: Utilize generative AI tools and intelligent ticketing agents to summarize, categorize, and resolve incoming access requests and security incidents efficiently.
  • SOP & Knowledge Execution: Follow and contribute to standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and knowledge articles to maintain operational consistency.
  • Compliance & Auditing: Maintain strict adherence to SOX controls, security policies, and SLA targets for ticket resolution times.
  • Process Enhancement: Identify repetitive manual tasks and collaborate with senior specialists to submit candidates for workflow automation and scripting.

Qualifications & Key Skills

  • Experience in IT support, service desk, or identity management operations.
  • Technical Domain: Basic understanding of Active Directory, Okta, SSO/MFA concepts, and RBAC (Role-Based Access Control).
  • Automation & AI Aptitude: Familiarity with leveraging AI assistants (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT) for troubleshooting, documentation, and basic query drafting.
  • Process Mindset: High attention to detail regarding access security, compliance standards, and user validation.
  • Languages: Fluent English (written and verbal) for seamless cross-geographic collaboration.
