title: Internationaal Product Support medewerker
description: Heb jij affiniteit met- en een passie voor agrotechniek en ben jij op zoek naar een avontuurlijke baan?

raw.title: Internationaal Product Support medewerker
raw.excerpt: Heb jij affiniteit met- en een passie voor agrotechniek en ben jij op zoek naar een avontuurlijke baan?
raw.description:
Heb jij affiniteit met- en een passie voor agrotechniek en ben jij op zoek naar een avontuurlijke baan? In ons team is ruimte voor een Product Support medewerker. In deze functie reis je de wereld over, verricht je technische werkzaamheden en werk je aan de nieuwste landbouwmachines, die vaak nog op de markt moeten komen. Ook vind je het leuk om opgedane kennis te delen en word je ingezet om bijvoorbeeld operators in het veld op te leiden of door technische trainingen te verzorgen op locatie.

Gaat dit over jou?

Draag jij met jouw technische expertise graag bij aan de ontwikkelingen in de sector? Als Product Support medewerker zet je jouw technische kennis niet alleen praktisch in, maar word je ook ingezet op projecten om je kennis over te dragen. Je maakt onderdeel uit van ons team die bestaat uit technisch specialisten met allen een passie voor landbouw en werktuigbouwkunde. Je voert wereldwijd maatwerkprojecten uit voor fabrikanten en dealers van landbouwmachines, akkerbouwbedrijven en startups, gericht op technische ondersteuning en advies.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Technische ondersteuning
    Je voert technische werkzaamheden uit aan met name nieuwe landbouwvoertuigen, waaronder tractoren, maaidorsers en hakselaars

  • Technische problemen oplossen
    Met je technische expertise diagnosticeer je problemen en los je ze op, zodat de machine optimaal presteert

  • Inbedrijfstelling en testen
    Ook projecten als het inbedrijfstellen, testen in het veld en het verzorgen van demo-tours van nieuwe machines op locatie behoren tot je werkzaamheden

  • Project management
    De opdrachten zijn divers en bestaan uit werkzaamheden aan een breed scala aan machines. Je houdt overzicht in het project en je werkt samen met externe teams en klanten om de beste resultaten te bereiken.

  • Kennis overdracht
    Je wordt ook ingezet op projecten om bijvoorbeeld operators te trainen of om technische trainingen te verzorgen op locatie bij dealers in het buitenland.

  • Training en ontwikkeling
    Je neemt regelmatig deel aan interne en externe trainingen, zodat je op de hoogte blijft van de technische ontwikkelingen in de agrarische sector

Requirements

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt brede technische kennis en een passie voor de agrarische sector. Je houdt van avontuur en afwisseling in je werkzaamheden en je bent bereid om te reizen en langere periodes van huis te zijn (in ieder geval een paar weken aaneengesloten). Je hebt lef, ziet wat er moet gebeuren en je vindt het leuk om opgedane kennis over te dragen.

  • Ervaring
    Bij voorkeur heb je een afgeronde Mbo niveau 4 of Hbo-opleiding in de agrarische/technische richting

  • Talenkennis
    Je hebt goede beheersing van in ieder geval de Engelse taal is vereist; kennis van meerdere talen is een plus.

  • Werkethiek
    Je kunt je houden aan de protocollen zoals deze in andere landen op de werkvloer gelden

  • Competenties
    Je bent zelfstandig en je hebt een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en je denkt in mogelijkheden

Wat bieden wij jou?

Wij bieden jou een unieke kans om de wereld rond te reizen, nieuwe uitdagingen aan te gaan in een diversiteit aan projecten. In de functie Product Support medewerker heb je de mogelijkheid om je te specialiseren in werkzaamheden.

  • Een salaris tussen de €2.500,- en €3.800,- bruto per maand op basis van een 40-urige werkweek, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring

  • Bovenop je salaris ontvang je een dagvergoeding wanneer je in het buitenland verblijft en uiteraard worden werk gerelateerde onkosten vergoed.

  • Een contract op basis van een bepaald aantal projecturen op jaarbasis.

  • Trainingen gericht op de ontwikkelingen in de sector.

  • Scholingsbudget om je persoonlijk verder te kunnen ontwikkelen

HuizingHarvest heeft alles in huis voor een avontuurlijke carrière in de agrotechniek. We kijken er naar uit om een toegewijde Product Support medewerker te verwelkomen in ons internationale team. Let’s make it work!

Kennismaken?

Spreekt de functie Product Support medewerker bij HuizingHarvest jou aan? Wij maken graag kennis met je. Bel of WhatsApp Erik Kramer +31 (0)6 255 63 999 of stuur een e-mail .

raw.description:
Job Summary:

The Strategic Solutions & Story Architecture Lead partners with Business Development, Proposal Management, Clinical Operations, Medical, Biometrics, and Subject Matter Experts to shape compelling customer-facing narratives for clinical development opportunities. The role acts as the story architect for priority pursuits, translating complex scientific, operational, and commercial inputs into a clear, differentiated storyline that connects the sponsor's challenge, the proposed solution, and the organization's value.

This role owns the narrative architecture of bid defense presentations and other strategic pursuit materials. It establishes the central story, message hierarchy, evidence, flow, and audience experience, then guides cross-functional contributors in bringing that story to life. The role combines strategic thinking, clinical development knowledge, storytelling, presentation design, facilitation, and commercial acumen to strengthen customer engagement, improve bid defense performance, and increase win rates.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Lead cross-functional story architecture sessions for priority opportunities, bringing together Business Development, Operations, Medical, Biometrics, Proposal Management, and relevant SMEs.
  • Partner with the BD Lead to define sponsor priorities, evaluation criteria, decision drivers, competitive hot buttons, and the central question the pursuit must answer.
  • Set the win strategy, overarching story, strategic themes, and message hierarchy for each pursuit.
  • Translate complex scientific, operational, and commercial information into clear, sponsor-focused messages that are persuasive and memorable.
  • Develop storyboards that connect sponsor needs with the proposed solution, delivery model, differentiators, proof points, and expected value.
  • Create executive-ready bid defense presentations and reusable narrative frameworks, messaging templates, and story structures.
  • Ensure each slide has a clear purpose and advances a coherent end-to-end audience journey.
  • Build differentiated value messages supported by relevant evidence, case studies, and proof points.
  • Coordinate slide ownership and content development across contributors while maintaining a consistent voice, storyline, and level of quality.
  • Maintain alignment across the written proposal, operational strategy, executive messaging, bid defense deck, and follow-up materials.
  • Coach presenters on message clarity, narrative delivery, transitions, consistency, and audience engagement.
  • Use competitive intelligence and market insight to sharpen positioning and strengthen the pursuit narrative.
  • Partner with creative and presentation teams so visual design reinforces the narrative and improves comprehension.
  • Capture lessons learned and maintain a library of validated narratives, proof points, and best practices to improve future pursuits.

Minimum Education & Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in CRO, pharmaceutical, biotech, proposal development, commercial strategy, clinical operations, business development, strategic communications, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting RFPs, proposals, bid defenses, capture planning, or strategic sales pursuits.
  • Proven ability to turn complex information into clear, audience-centered strategic narratives.
  • Advanced PowerPoint and executive presentation development skills, including storyboarding and message hierarchy.
  • Excellent storytelling, writing, facilitation, coaching, and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to identify and articulate meaningful differentiation.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to manage multiple high-priority pursuits in a deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Education & Experience (optional):

  • CRO proposal management or bid defense leadership.
  • Operational strategy, clinical project management, or solution design.
  • Business development enablement, capture management, or win strategy.
  • Executive communications, presentation coaching, or strategic storytelling.
  • Experience developing reusable narrative frameworks, content libraries, or AI-enabled knowledge assets.
  • Experience working with design teams or applying visual storytelling principles.

Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Strategic pursuit storytelling with the ability to develop compelling, client-centric narratives that clearly articulate solution value, win themes, and competitive differentiation.
  • Executive communication and presentation excellence, including the creation of executive-ready storyboards, presentations, and messaging that resonate with senior decision-makers and stakeholders.
  • Solution positioning and differentiation expertise, with the ability to identify, shape, and communicate strategic differentiators, proof points, and value propositions that strengthen pursuit competitiveness.
  • Stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with a proven ability to build alignment and commitment among sponsors, pursuit leaders, subject matter experts, and executive stakeholders.
  • Facilitation and presentation coaching capability, including leading workshops, guiding strategic discussions, and preparing presenters to deliver confident, consistent, and impactful messages.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to align pursuit messaging and strategy to client priorities, business objectives, market dynamics, and growth opportunities.
  • Advanced content development and quality management skills, ensuring the delivery of clear, coherent, accurate, and high-quality pursuit materials with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to changing requirements, and deliver high-quality outputs within compressed timelines.
  • Knowledge management and continuous improvement capability, including the capture, curation, and reuse of lessons learned, best practices, and proven narrative assets to improve pursuit effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Collaborative and results-oriented approach, demonstrating the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams while driving measurable business outcomes, stakeholder satisfaction, and pursuit success.

raw.description:
1. Role Summary

The Chief Experience Officer (CXO) is responsible for developing and executing the organization's overall experience strategy across customer, client, employee, and stakeholder touchpoints. The role focuses on building a customer-centric culture, improving service quality, strengthening customer relationships, and ensuring consistent, seamless, and positive experiences across all insurance and investment products and services.

The CXO will lead customer experience (CX), service delivery, customer engagement, and experience transformation initiatives. The position will work closely with business, operations, technology, sales, marketing, claims, underwriting, and investment teams to improve satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and long-term business performance.

2. Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience Strategy

  • Develop and implement an enterprise-wide customer experience strategy aligned with the organization's business objectives.
  • Establish a customer-first culture across insurance, investment, and financial service operations.
  • Define customer experience standards, service principles, and performance benchmarks.
  • Identify opportunities to differentiate the organization through superior customer service and engagement.

Customer Journey Management

  • Map and optimize end-to-end customer journeys across product discovery, onboarding, policy issuance, premium payments, claims, renewals, investment services, and account management.
  • Identify service gaps, customer pain points, and process inefficiencies.
  • Simplify customer interactions and reduce friction across digital and traditional service channels.
  • Ensure consistent experiences across branches, call centres, websites, mobile applications, and relationship management teams.

Customer Satisfaction and Retention

  • Develop initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Monitor customer feedback, complaints, service requests, and customer sentiment.
  • Establish customer feedback mechanisms, including surveys, NPS, CSAT, and customer interviews.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce customer attrition and improve policy renewal and investment account retention rates.

Digital Experience and Innovation

  • Collaborate with technology and digital teams to improve online platforms, mobile applications, customer portals, and self-service solutions.
  • Drive digital adoption and improve accessibility of insurance and investment services.
  • Leverage customer analytics, automation, AI, and CRM platforms to personalize customer interactions.
  • Champion innovative solutions that improve customer convenience and operational efficiency.

Customer Service and Relationship Management

  • Oversee customer service standards and service excellence initiatives.
  • Ensure timely resolution of customer inquiries, complaints, claims-related concerns, and investment service requests.
  • Strengthen relationship management practices for individual, corporate, institutional, and high-net-worth clients.
  • Establish service-level agreements (SLAs) and escalation procedures across customer-facing departments.

Employee Experience and Organizational Culture

  • Develop initiatives that improve employee engagement and internal service culture.
  • Promote collaboration between departments to deliver consistent customer experiences.
  • Support employee training and development in customer service, communication, relationship management, and service excellence.
  • Align employee experience initiatives with customer experience objectives.

Governance, Risk and Compliance

  • Ensure customer experience practices comply with applicable insurance, investment, consumer protection, data privacy, and financial services regulations.
  • Work with compliance and risk teams to address customer-related regulatory concerns.
  • Promote transparent communication, fair treatment, responsible product information, and ethical customer engagement.
  • Establish processes for monitoring and resolving customer complaints and service-related risks.

Leadership and Performance Management

  • Lead and develop customer experience, customer service, and service transformation teams.
  • Establish departmental objectives, budgets, KPIs, and performance management frameworks.
  • Present customer experience performance reports and strategic recommendations to the CEO and Board.
  • Collaborate with senior executives to integrate customer experience priorities into business strategy.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Management, Customer Experience, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA) or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience in customer experience, customer service, operations, client relationship management, or business transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive management position.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, wealth management, financial services, or other regulated service industries.
  • Demonstrated success in developing and implementing customer experience strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of customer journey mapping, CRM platforms, customer analytics, NPS, CSAT, and service quality management.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and large-scale service improvement initiatives.
  • Strong strategic thinking, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).

- Net Promoter Score (NPS).

  • Customer retention and policy renewal rates.
  • Customer attrition and churn reduction.
  • Customer complaint resolution time and satisfaction.

- First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate.

  • Digital channel adoption and self-service utilization.
  • Customer onboarding and service turnaround time.
  • Customer lifetime value and relationship growth.
  • Employee engagement and service culture improvement.
  • Compliance with customer service standards and regulatory requirements.

raw.description:
Hi!

We are Boosta, a holding tech company that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

Didn’t find your next challenge?

We’re always looking for ambitious people to join Boosta — a tech holding company that creates, scales, and invests in digital businesses with global potential.

  • 12 years in the market
  • 800+ experts
  • 15+ businesses

We build an ecosystem for ambitious businesses and people. From early-stage ventures to mature businesses across 10+ industries, find the environment that fits your ambitions.

Why Boosta?

Grow through real challenges

  • Build something from scratch or help take a scaling product to its next stage.
  • Grow together with the business at a fast pace.
  • Work alongside senior experts who raise the bar for each other.
  • Keep growing through learning: internal and external lectures, a corporate library, course compensation.

Comfortable working conditions

  • Work remotely or visit the office in Kyiv, coworking spaces in Lviv or Warsaw.
  • Plan your working day independently — we offer a flexible schedule, because results matter most.
  • Recharge and rest: 28 working days of paid vacation per year, up to 30 days of sick leave, and all public holidays fully covered.
  • Optionally arrange a transfer — swap a working day with a day off and vice versa.

Well-being & support

  • Take care of your health: we provide medical insurance and compensation for sessions with a psychologist.
  • Join socially meaningful initiatives, including the Ukrainian Victory Support program.
  • We celebrate important moments together — receive gifts for special occasions in your life and career.
  • Participate in quarterly team buildings — online or offline — to make teamwork easy and enjoyable.

You don’t need to wait for the perfect vacancy to make your next move.

  1. Share your CVTell us about your experience, strengths, and what you’d like to do next.
  2. We’ll look for your matchOur Talent Acquisition team will explore opportunities across Boosta that align with your experience and ambitions.
  3. Keep up with BoostaIf we find a match, we’ll get in touch. If there’s nothing suitable right now, we may keep your profile and reach out when a fitting opportunity comes up.

Let your ambition find its next challenge.

Req ID:397152

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Corporate Counsel for Commercial contracts - Remote in the US to join our team in Plano, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).

NTT DATA America seeks a Corporate Counsel to join our Legal Department’s commercial transactions team. This attorney will support the sales and delivery organizations of NTT DATA North America and work on transactions and other matters across our various business verticals. As Corporate Counsel, you will be expected to negotiate and document contracts for complex information technology, applications, business process, digital, consulting and AI services (“IT Services”) transactions.

Location: This is a remote role within the United States

Responsibilities include:

  • Lead counsel in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts in support of IT Services

  • Advise business clients on terms and conditions, and risks, in complex outsourcing relationships (including scope of the services, service level agreements, pricing schedules, intellectual property, benchmarking, termination, and IP)

  • Assist in developing and achieving resolutions to disputes with customers

  • Enforce compliance with corporate policies

  • Work collaboratively with internal corporate units and global stakeholders

  • Manage internal executive briefings and escalations

Required Qualifications:

  • Curiosity and eagerness to learn

  • Team player

  • At least 5 years of experience as a lawyer, preferably with some law firm experience, and at least 2 years of experience drafting and negotiating complex IT Services agreements, including leading or “second chairing” the negotiation of outsourcing agreements

  • Willingness to exercise independent judgment and interact with executives

  • Strong written and verbal communications skills (English)

  • Knowledge of the market for IT Services

  • Flexibility and willingness to work with multiple stakeholders in an evolving business

  • Licensed to practice law in at least one US state

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, .

NTT DATA endeavors to make accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at . This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. raw.description:
The Workday Payroll Principal Consultant (Continuous Value Services) position is best suited for expert problem solvers full of patience and tenacity who are eager to work with a variety of customers and dive headfirst into post-production support with Workday Payroll. This role demands a focus on customer satisfaction while working on competing priorities. You must be a self-starter with excellent time management skills who is able to manage both your time and the customers’ expectations. Strong initiative and time management skills are paramount to success is this role.


Responsibilities:


  • Identify strategies, risks, and options while recommending approaches and mitigations to meet client/functional requirements.
  • Work alongside the other functional teams and vendors to configure and test to ensure no impact to their production environment.
  • Perform multiple tasks under limited direction, while regularly keeping the client, your project team, and your Engagement Manager abreast of changes or progress related to the project.
  • Become a Workday Payroll functional expert with deep knowledge of current functionality, design concepts, and touch points across HCM, Finance, Time Tracking, Absence, Integrations, and future product direction.
  • Act as a mentor to fellow consultants and analysts, including providing support for shadow assignments.
  • Drive the project or ticket by driving decisions and recommending best practices related to functionality.
  • Meet utilization goals and contribute to the post-production internal initiatives to help drive client success and efficiencies.
  • Actively participate in update training and internal opportunities to share one’s skills and learnings with others within the organization.
  • Execute the day-to-day activities of Workday project or tickets for a variety of clients including process design, package implementation lifecycle support, and project reviews.
  • Support business development activities such as identification, proposal development, and other pursuit activities.
  • Additional duties as assigned by manager.

Skills & Requirements:


  • 3+ years Workday experience in an implementation or post-production environment support capacity.
  • Experience gathering requirements, designing, prototyping, testing, and deploying solutions to meet client requirements.
  • Subject Matter Expertise in Payroll
  • Proactive problem-solving abilities with the capability to identify issues, analyze options, and implement effective solutions.
  • Passion for exceptional client service.
  • Proven experience managing multiple clients simultaneously, balancing competing priorities, and delivering consistent results.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively manage client expectations and clearly convey complex information to clients and team members.
  • Commitment to staying current with Workday updates, trends, and best practices through ongoing training and development.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Current Workday certification in Workday Payroll highly preferred or prior Workday experience in Payroll.
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Professional (FPP) Certification Preferred.
  • Minimal travel required, but must be willing to travel on-site if needed

Salary and Other Compensation

Applications will be accepted until 02/2/2027The annual salary for this position is between $109,459 - $144,424 USD depending on the experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program , based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

Why choose Cognizant:

  • Entrepreneurial environment that welcomes your ideas
  • Opportunity to do great work
  • Outreach programs that support communities and tap into your volunteer spirit
  • Learning opportunities to help current needs and advancement
  • Global operations, with opportunities in North America, Europe and Asia Pacific
  • An abundance of Affinity groups to meet your needs

Cognizant Core Values:

  • Work as One: We think beyond roles, relying on each other’s strengths to win as a team.
  • Raise the Bar: We always aim for excellence in how we work and what we deliver.
  • Dare to Innovate: We push boundaries and take chances to reimagine what’s possible.
  • Do the Right Thing: We all lead with integrity and always make the ethical choice.
  • Own It: We own the outcomes for our company, colleagues, and community.

raw.excerpt: Title:Junior Salesforce Developer At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world.
raw.description:
Title:

Junior Salesforce Developer

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.


Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 


Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 


Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 


At KBR, we define the future.


We are a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, and dreamers.

But we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely.


Our KBR team is actively hiring a Junior Salesforce Developer to support the implementation, administration, development, and continuous improvement of a new Salesforce environment. This role will support KBR’s internal Growth Operations Excellence organization and will help build scalable Salesforce capabilities that improve customer relationship management, opportunity management, pipeline visibility, business reporting, user adoption, and enterprise growth execution.

The Junior Salesforce Developer will work closely with Growth Operations Excellence, business stakeholders, Salesforce users, IT partners, and technical leads to translate business requirements into practical Salesforce solutions. This position is ideal for a hands-on Salesforce professional who is comfortable supporting both declarative configuration and entry-level development activities in a fast-paced business environment.


No travel is anticipated for this role, though virtual meetings, training sessions, release support, and user adoption activities may be required across U.S. time zones.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, administration, and continuous improvement of a new Salesforce environment.
  • Configure and maintain Salesforce objects, fields, page layouts, record types, Lightning pages, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards, permission sets, and user access controls.
  • Build and maintain Salesforce automation using declarative tools such as Flow, with support for Apex, Lightning Web Components, and other programmatic solutions when needed.
  • Assist with Salesforce data migration, data cleanup, deduplication, validation, and ongoing data quality efforts.
  • Support Salesforce reporting and dashboard development to improve visibility into customer, lead, opportunity, pipeline, forecasting, resource planning, and growth execution data.
  • Troubleshoot Salesforce user issues, investigate system defects, document root causes, and coordinate resolution with business or technical stakeholders.
  • Support integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems, including API-based integrations, middleware, reporting tools, and data platforms.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, configuration notes, user guidance, test scripts, deployment notes, and standard operating procedures.
  • Assist with sandbox management, change tracking, deployment preparation, release validation, and production support activities.
  • Follow Salesforce development, security, testing, data governance, and release management best practices.
  • Help ensure Salesforce remains scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of Salesforce workflows, governance standards, data standards, and user experience.
  • Work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance from senior team members when appropriate.

Work Environment:

  • Location: Remote
  • Travel Requirements: Minimal 0-20%
  • Working Hours: Standard

Required Qualifications:

  • Security clearance requirement: Eligibility to obtain a US Security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  • 2+ years of experience supporting Salesforce administration, Salesforce development, business applications, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration, including standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards, profiles, permission sets, and user administration.
  • Experience building or supporting Salesforce automation using Flow, approval processes, or comparable workflow tools.
  • Foundational experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SOQL, or related Salesforce development technologies.
  • Basic understanding of Salesforce data model concepts, security model concepts, role hierarchy, sharing settings, permissions, and data quality practices.
  • Experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and translating requirements into configuration, automation, documentation, or technical tasks.
  • Experience troubleshooting application issues, validating defects, testing fixes, and supporting end users.
  • Ability to create clear documentation, including technical notes, user guidance, test cases, and process instructions.
  • Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Administrator certification.
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder certification.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.
  • Experience implementing or administering Salesforce Sales Cloud.
  • Experience supporting a new Salesforce org implementation, migration, or major CRM transformation.
  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps, source control, change sets, Salesforce DX, Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Gearset, Copado, or similar deployment tools.
  • Experience building Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience developing Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, scheduled jobs, or test classes.
  • Experience with REST or SOAP API integrations.
  • Experience with Informatica, Appian, integration middleware, enterprise data platforms, or integration patterns.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, CRM Analytics, or other reporting and dashboarding tools.
  • Experience with data migration tools such as Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, Workbench, or comparable ETL tools.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce dashboards, pipeline reporting, forecasting processes, or business development workflows.
  • Experience working in a government contracting, aerospace, defense, professional services, or highly regulated business environment.
  • Experience with Agile delivery practices, user stories, sprint planning, backlog management, and release coordination.
  • Experience documenting business processes, technical designs, data dictionaries, or system administration procedures.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce security, data governance, access management, and least-privilege access principles.
  • Strong curiosity, willingness to learn, and ability to grow into broader Salesforce development and administration responsibilities.

Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 hours/week


Basic Compensation:


The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity.


Additional Compensation:


KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.


Ready to Make a Difference?


If you’re excited about making a significant impact in the field of space defense and working on projects that matter, we encourage you to apply and join our team at KBR. Let's shape the future together.


KBR Benefits


KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.


Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.


KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

raw.description:
ABOUT RED PLANET SOFTWARE:

Red Planet Software is a leading provider of niche loans management software. It specializes in Insurance Premium Funding and Professional Fee Funding solutions. It provides customized and cost-effective end to end software applications and support services for the financial services industry.

Red Planet clients are based in Australia, Canada, United States, and New Zealand. We are a small and friendly company that punches well above its weight globally. You would be joining our Philippine based team of 12 IT professionals who provide the backbone of our global company.

To know more, click this link: www.redplanetsoftware.com

POSITION SUMMARY:

Reporting directly to the Compliance and Administration Manager, you'll play a key role in maintaining our compliance frameworks, coordinating audits, managing policies and procedures, and ensuring our ongoing compliance obligations are met.

You'll work closely with management, technical teams and external auditors to keep our compliance programs running effectively and continuously improving.

This is a compliance coordination and governance role, rather than a hands-on technical cybersecurity position.

The role is working from home as a part of our twelve-person Philippine team and our thirty-person global team. See www.redplanetsoftware.com for more details.

LOCATION:

  • 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM (Flexible Hours)
  • Work From Home
  • Some shift Work Required

JOB DESCRIPTION: Compliance Administrator

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Compliance Management: Coordinate and maintain our ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2, SOC 1, GDPR and PCI DSS compliance programs.
  • Audit Coordination: Manage audit schedules, evidence collection, assessments and certification or attestation requirements.
  • ISMS Management: Oversee recurring Information Security Management System activities and monitor compliance obligations.
  • Policies & Procedures: Maintain, review and update company policies, processes and compliance documentation.
  • Risk & Continuous Improvement: Coordinate risk reviews, corrective actions and improvements to compliance processes.
  • Training & Awareness: Manage staff compliance training, policy awareness and completion records.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Work collaboratively with internal teams, external auditors, consultants and legal advisors.
  • Compliance Platforms: Maintain compliance records, monitor controls and manage activities using our compliance and learning management systems.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Compliance Administrator with a good understanding of compliance requirements, strong organizational skills, and excellent communication abilities.

QUALIFICATIONS / EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience in compliance management, information security governance, risk management or audit coordination.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 27001:2022, SOC 1 and SOC 2 frameworks.
  • Familiarity with GDPR and PCI DSS requirements.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines and recurring activities.
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence working with technical and non-technical teams.
  • Experience maintaining policies, procedures and audit documentation.
  • A proactive, practical and detail-oriented approach to problem-solving.
  • The ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Vanta compliance management software.
  • Experience with TalentLMS or another learning management platform.
  • Previous experience in a software development, SaaS or technology environment.
  • Relevant compliance, information security or auditing qualifications.

Don't tick every box? We'd still love to hear from you! Experience with Vanta and TalentLMS is preferred but not essential.

We are looking for a special someone who aligns with Red Planet Core Values:

  • Have Integrity
  • Be Passionate
  • Enjoy the hard stuff
  • Have attention to detail
  • Care about clients
  • Be a Team Player

Why Join Red Planet Software?

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of an established compliance program, work directly with senior management and make a meaningful contribution to our ongoing commitment to information security and regulatory compliance.

We value people who are accountable, collaborative, organized and always looking for better ways to do things.

If you enjoy bringing structure to processes, building strong working relationships and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks, this could be the role for you!

COMPANY OVERVIEW:

Beepo is an outsourcing and workforce solutions provider helping businesses build dedicated teams in the Philippines. As part of the MicroSourcing Group and backed by global investment firm KKR, Beepo combines local expertise with the resources and capabilities of a growing global organization. Based in Clark, Pampanga, Beepo connects talented Filipino professionals with businesses across a range of industries and functions. We focus on building high-performing teams that support our clients' day-to-day operations and long-term business goals, while creating meaningful career opportunities for our people. At Beepo, you'll be part of a collaborative and supportive workplace with competitive benefits and opportunities to learn, develop your skills, and grow your career. You'll have the opportunity to make an impact, contribute new ideas, and build a rewarding career as Beepo continues to grow.

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Lumen is seeking a Lead Project Manager to guide large-scale, complex customer deployments from planning through completion. You will serve as the primary point of contact, bringing together customers, internal teams, and vendors to deliver solutions on time, within scope, and within budget. This role is ideal for an experienced project leader who can navigate competing priorities, anticipate risks, and communicate confidently with both technical teams and senior stakeholders.

Location

This is a work from home position within the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Lead highly complex customer implementation projects and programs throughout the full project lifecycle.
  • Develop and manage project plans, schedules, resource requirements, deliverables, and success measures.
  • Serve as the primary customer contact, providing clear updates and maintaining alignment on scope, responsibilities, timelines, and expectations.
  • Analyze project progress and deliver concise status, risk, jeopardy, and executive-level reports.
  • Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and schedule changes, escalating issues and recommending alternatives when appropriate.
  • Coordinate internal teams and external vendors to support the timely delivery of contracted services.
  • Facilitate project meetings, document decisions, and track action items through completion.
  • Mentor team members, promote consistent project management practices, and identify additional customer needs that may create future sales opportunities.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Minimum

  • Bachelor’s degree or at least five years of related experience.
  • Experience managing complex customer-facing technology implementations.
  • Experience managing or supporting fiber delivery projects, with working knowledge of Outside Plant (OSP) and/or Inside Plant (ISP) infrastructure, construction, and implementation activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage project scope, schedules, resources, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level project updates.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and work effectively with customers and internal partners.

Preferred

  • Six or more years of project management experience.
  • Experience leading multiple complex projects within the technology or telecommunications industry.
  • Project Management Professional, or PMP, certification or PRINCE2 certification.
  • Experience supporting strategic or global customers with repeat implementation needs.
  • Experience applying change control processes, defining key performance indicators, and improving project management standards.
  • Strong understanding of how technology solutions support customers’ business strategies and long-term goals.

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

Location Based Pay Ranges

$84,629 - $112,838 in these states: AL AR AZ FL GA IA ID IN KS KY LA ME MO MS MT ND NE NM OH OK PA SC SD TN UT VT WI WV WY

Lumen offers a comprehensive package featuring a broad range of Health, Life, Voluntary Lifestyle benefits and other perks that enhance your physical, mental, emotional and financial wellbeing. We're able to answer any additional questions you may have about our bonus structure (short-term incentives, long-term incentives and/or sales compensation) as you move through the selection process.

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Our Lumen 8 behaviors guide how we interact, make decisions, and work together, shaping a culture built to perform and win.

raw.description:
Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

The Customer Service Associate Specialist handles the incoming calls from patients for Customer Service. Performs all customer service duties that occur with a focus on managing the resolution of the phone call and all written and documented communication within the systems and is committed to assisting in meeting all business needs.

**The hourly pay for this position is $17.00 - $18.65 based on experience**

Essential Job Functions:

The Customer Service Associate Specialist performs all customer service and collection activities across the Revenue Cycle. Job duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Answering patient questions regarding statements
  • Posting guarantor payments
  • Setting up payment plans within our policies
  • Researching and resolving issues with accounts that have been identified by patients
  • Reaching out to appropriate departments to resolve any requests made by patients connecting patients with financial counseling department for charity screening
  • Communicating patient balances
  • Meeting collection goals as set by department, and providing excellent customer service for all of our patients
  • Must have knowledge of all areas of the Revenue Cycle. Communicate and partner with other areas of Ensemble and Revenue Cycle to resolve customer service issues
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Employment Qualifications:

  • Customer Service and Call Center experience preferred
  • 1-2 years’ experience in healthcare industry preferred
  • Minimum Education: High School Diploma or GED
  • Certifications: CRCR within 9 months of hire.
  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI (Artificial Intelligence) to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

Other Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Experience in physician and hospital operations
  • Compliance and provider relations
  • Critical Thinking
  • Problem Resolution
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, including access to a secure home office and reliable high-speed internet service with minimum speeds of 50 MBPS

Join an award-winning company


Five-time winner of “Best in KLAS” 2020-2022, 2024-2025

Black Book Research's Top Revenue Cycle Management Outsourcing Solution 2021-2024

22 Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) MAP Awards for High Performance in Revenue Cycle 2019-2024

Leader in Everest Group's RCM Operations PEAK Matrix Assessment 2024

Energage Top Workplaces USA 2022-2024

Fortune Media Best Workplaces in Healthcare 2024

Monster Top Workplace for Remote Work 2024

Great Place to Work certified 2023-2024

  • Innovation
  • Work-Life Flexibility
  • Leadership
  • Purpose + Values

Bottom line, we believe in empowering people and giving them the tools and resources needed to thrive. A few of those include:

  • Associate Benefits – We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial health of you and your family, including healthcare, time off, retirement, and well-being programs.
  • Our Culture – Ensemble is a place where associates can do their best work and be their best selves. We put people first, last and always. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth, and innovation.
  • Growth – We invest in your professional development. Each associate will earn a professional certification relevant to their field and can obtain tuition reimbursement.
  • Recognition – We offer quarterly and annual incentive programs for all employees who go beyond and keep raising the bar for themselves and the company.

Ensemble is an equal employment opportunity employer. It is our policy not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Ensemble also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.


Due to business, operational, payroll, and regulatory requirements, this position is limited to individuals who reside and are authorized to work within the United States. Applications generated from outside the United States will not be considered. Individuals may reapply when located within the United States.


Ensemble provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law. If you require accommodation in the application process, please contact .

As a Technical Account Manager at Action1, you will play a key role in ensuring the technical success and satisfaction of our existing Mid-Market and Enterprise customers. You will work closely with customers to understand how they are using the Action1 platform, assess their current configurations and workflows, and provide expert technical guidance to help them maximize the value of our solution. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically skilled, proactive, and results-oriented, with a passion for building strong customer relationships, driving product adoption, and promoting technical best practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and support existing Action1 customers, primarily across the US region, ensuring a positive technical experience and long-term success.
  • Conduct technical reviews of customers' Action1 environments to evaluate how they are using the console, identify potential gaps, and recommend improvements.
  • Guide customers on best practices for platform configuration, patch management, software deployment, automation, and endpoint security.
  • Deliver tailored technical consultations, product walkthroughs, and training sessions to help customers maximize platform capabilities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve product adoption, operational efficiency, and overall customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, Support, and Product teams to address technical challenges, resolve issues, and ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Build trusted technical relationships with customers, acting as a subject matter expert and strategic advisor throughout their journey with Action1.
  • Support customer retention and expansion by demonstrating the ongoing technical value of the Action1 platform.

Requirements

  • Essential system administration experience, with the ability to assist IT administrators in recognizing Action1 as their preferred patching solution.
  • 1-3 years of B2B pre-sales experience (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Strong understanding of IT administration and security principles.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Genuine interest in information technology and systems administration, with a passion for staying updated on industry trends.

Benefits

  • Fully remote work, giving you the flexibility you need in the modern world
  • A multitude of interesting challenges and opportunities.
  • Non-stop professional growth and learning of new technologies.
  • Stable income and flexible working hours, opportunities for promotion.
  • Friendly and professional peers.

At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Job Purpose
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Alliance Healthcare, a Cencora company, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose.The HR Project Delivery Partner is responsible for coordinating, tracking and delivering day-to-day HR project activities, ensuring agreed actions, milestones and deliverables are completed effectively and on time.

The role supports organisational design and employee relations activity by working with management teams to deliver people-related outcomes aligned to business objectives.

Job Scale
Supports HR delivery across complex large-scale programmes by coordinating key people workstream activity, maintaining workforce analysis and tracking progress against agreed project plans.The role works across AHUK departments and with workstream leads to support delivery of people plans, identify risks and ensure actions, milestones and deliverables are progressed in line with business objectives.Partner with senior leaders to lead and manager people activity in relation to project outcomes. Be the point of contact for leaders in escalations and supporting people process.

Key Responsibilities
Workforce Analysis

  • Complete impacted people analysis to support project planning and decision making.
  • Build and maintain impacted employee trackers, ensuring people data remains accurate and up to date.
  • Prepare As-Is and To-Be workforce analysis to identify organisational impacts and required actions.
  • Validate organisational impacts in partnership with relevant stakeholders.
  • Produce workforce reporting to support project governance, progress tracking and decision making.
  • Manage people data tracking in line with agreed project requirements and confidentiality standards.

  • Coordinate N2 job description development, ensuring progress is tracked and actions are completed.

.

raw.description:
AIR is seeking a Part-Time Senior Researcher to join our Employment and Economic Opportunity Program. The Senior Researcher provides technical support and manages research, operational, and analytic activities that support AIR’s NAEP Technical Support Contract. The role leads technical reviews across the assessment cycle, including reviews of assessment data, results, and technical documentation, and provides support for externally facing research, assessment, and partnership initiatives and business development opportunities. Engagements are typically project- or pursuit-based, part-time, and may vary in duration and hours depending on project needs.

This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of our U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

The responsibilities for the position include:

  • Leading and conducting technical reviews of National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP) data files, data companions, technical documentation, the Nation’s Report Card, and other NAEP products and publications on a cyclical basis.
  • Supporting the management of the NAEP Validity Panel through technical reviews and advisory support.
  • Supporting NAEP assessment systems activities, including attending systems update meetings; monitoring, documenting, and tracking bugs and known issues; participating in milestone and user acceptance testing reviews; and coordinating with project staff to identify and communicate systems-related issues.
  • Providing content expertise in support of NAEP Reading assessment content development, including reviewing items, passages, and related materials for content quality and alignment and providing feedback throughout development and review cycles.
  • Leading business development activities through proposal management and writing, market research, and capture planning.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Master’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience or PhD with 3+ years of relevant experience.
  • Deep knowledge of NAEP content, procedures, and operations.
  • Experience working with the Department of Education, including the National Center for Education Statistics (NCES).
  • Experience reviewing national education reports for U.S. audiences.
  • Experience collaborating and coordinating with the federal government to conduct assessments and surveys.
  • Extensive knowledge in reading content and assessment systems and operations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams on federally funded research projects.

Skills

  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship management skills for working with stakeholders at various levels and from a range of backgrounds.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy and quality.
  • Strong project management skills, including timeline tracking, risk identification, and managing competing priorities.
  • Self-motivated and reliable, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of complex tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Effective communication skills with a commitment to validity, clarity, and evidence-based messaging.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and external partners in a virtual work environment.

Disclosures: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. Employment-based visa sponsorship (including H-1B sponsorship) is not available for this position. Depending on project work, qualified candidates may need to meet certain residency requirements.

American Institutes for Research is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, including, but not limited to, actual or perceived race (including traits historically associated with race, such as hair texture, hair type, and protective hairstyles such as braids, locs, and twists), creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition (e.g., cancer), sex, gender, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, civil union status, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, genetic information, or military or veteran status. raw.excerpt: Role Overview We’re looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to own the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and reliability tooling behind our exchange and trading platform.
raw.description:
Role Overview


We’re looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to own the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and reliability tooling behind our exchange and trading platform. You’ll build and run the cloud foundation that keeps a low-latency, regulated, always-on market available, and make it faster and safer for engineers to ship. You’ll work closely with backend, security, and compliance partners, and you’ll have real ownership from day one.

What You’ll Own

  • Design, build, and operate our AWS infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) across production, staging, and development environments.
  • Run and scale our Kubernetes platform, including cluster upgrades, autoscaling, networking, and cost management.
  • Own CI/CD end to end: fast, reliable build, test, and deploy pipelines with safe rollout strategies (canary, blue/green) and quick rollback.
  • Build observability for the exchange: metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerting tied to SLOs for latency and availability.
  • Operate and tune supporting infrastructure for our event-driven systems, including Kafka, databases, caches, and WebSocket edge services.
  • Participate in on-call, lead incident response, and run blameless postmortems that lead to durable fixes.
  • Partner with security and compliance on access controls, secrets management, audit logging, vulnerability management, and disaster recovery that meet CFTC-regulated expectations.
  • Plan capacity and performance testing ahead of high-volume sports events, and automate away toil.
  • Document runbooks and share knowledge so the whole engineering team can operate with confidence.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering experience running production systems at scale
  • Deep hands-on expertise with AWS (or equivalent), including networking, IAM, compute, and managed data services
  • Strong Kubernetes and Docker experience in production, including cluster operations and troubleshooting
  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform strongly preferred) and configuration management, with GitOps-style workflows
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines at scale (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar)
  • Strong observability skills: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or comparable tooling, plus SLO-driven alerting
  • Solid scripting or programming ability in Go or Python (Go preferred) and comfort with Linux and networking fundamentals
  • Experience operating Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and low-latency, real-time services in production
  • Experience with incident management, on-call, and blameless postmortems
  • Working knowledge of security best practices: secrets management, least-privilege access, vulnerability scanning, and audit logging
  • Experience in trading, exchange, fintech, or other high-throughput regulated systems is strongly preferred
  • Strong communicator who can explain complex tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proactive, growth-focused, and highly adaptable with a strong sense of ownership
Nice to Have
  • Experience in prediction markets, sports betting, or regulated exchanges (CFTC or similar)
  • Familiarity with risk, fraud, KYC/AML, or settlement systems
  • Experience scaling a team through hiring and growth in a startup environment

Why Join Us!

Compensation & Ownership
  • Competitive compensation aligned to role and market
  • Equity opportunities so you share in what we’re building
  • A clear connection between impact and reward
Health & Wellbeing
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible time off built on trust and accountability
  • A culture that respects your time and avoids unnecessary meetings
Remote & Flexible Work
  • Fully remote within the U.S.
  • Flexibility to work in the way that helps you do your best work
The Role
  • Own the cloud infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and reliability tooling behind the real-time, high-throughput systems at the core of America’s first sports-native, CFTC-regulated prediction market
  • Take on a hands-on technical leadership role with real influence over architecture, platform standards, and how engineering ships and operates software safely at speed
  • Help scale a live, regulated exchange as prediction markets grow into America’s next great asset class
