raw.title: Senior Lead Electrical Engineer, Datacenter
raw.excerpt: DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems.
raw.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:Senior Lead Electrical Engineer, Datacenter

Position Location:Remote - workvirtually fromanywhere in the United States

Salary

DLB recognizes salary ranges from jobboardsdo not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

This position is available inDLB’sMission Critical Department and focuses primarily on hyperscale data centers and related mission critical facilities.

TheSenior Lead Electrical Engineer, Datacenterwill have the opportunity to collaborate with all design staff and oversee full cycle electrical design activities for commercial building design and construction. This person will work as part of the Engineering Team and interact closely with organizational leadership to develop and edit projectspecifications and lead design development efforts.

TheSenior Lead Electrical Engineer, Datacenterwill be self-directed onday-to-daywork and independently performs most responsibilities.  Will lead project teams and projects of complex scope and broader programs.  Will coordinate activities of other personnel. Assistsin the development of policies and procedures.

TheSenior Lead Electrical Engineer, Datacenterwill communicate andoperatein line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmentalobjectives.

Essential Functions

LeadElectrical Engineering Design Activities (40%)

  • Serve as the technical authority for complex mission critical electrical infrastructure projects.
  • Establish design strategies supporting highly resilient electrical systems for hyperscale data centers and other mission critical environments.
  • Provide technical oversight and quality assurance for engineering teams across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Independently perform advanced engineering work
  • Perform advanced electrical design tasks including development of electrical distribution systems and topologies, infrastructure and equipment layouts and selection / sizing of equipment from conceptual design through construction documents
  • Provide direction to project engineers tofacilitatedevelopment electrical construction drawings and specifications
  • Utilize AutoCAD and Revit software to prepare drawings and visual aids
  • Review and / or prepare book or sheet specifications for electrical systems
  • Develop and / or review sequence of operations
  • Develop proposals including project scope,scheduleand budget
  • Timely and effective management of project design team including resource forecasting and coordination
  • Identifypotential project scope changes and aid in development of strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines
  • Perform QAQC peer reviews for projects where he or she is not the lead design engineer

LeadConstruction Activities (20%)

  • Survey existing building conditions and prepares technical reports of findings
  • Collect data and other information for construction documents
  • Prepare project design and construction documents
  • Lead the engineering team and interact closely with the project management team
  • Review shop drawings and submittals
  • Review and respond to RFIs
  • Review and completepunch listsand project closeout documents
  • Review and approve change order requests

Manage Stakeholder Relations (20%)

  • ​Responsible for execution of the firm’s client value system and assuring that the project is executedin accordance withcompany policies and standards
  • Serve asprimaryclient contact for one or more clients. May act as a Client Program Manager with business development and marketing responsibilities.
  • Build long-term relationships with hyperscale, enterprise, and mission critical clients while serving as a trusted technical advisor.
  • Assistwith research for technical papers for conferences and journals

Organizational Development and Continuous Improvement of Policies and Procedures (20%)

  • Mentor associates andassistswith training and development to create a learning and growing environment
  • Contribute to organizational training and standards development
  • Mayassistin the strategic planning for the group
  • Mayassistwith hiring process

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Identifyopportunities and lead the strategic use of technology, digital platforms, and AI-enabled tools to enhance efficiency through workflow automation, reduced manual effort, and improved accuracy in forecasting, documentation, reporting, and quality processes.
  • Support adoption of emerging technologies - including advanced analytics, data visualization tools, and digital construction management platforms - to strengthen readiness, quality assurance, and project controls.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure technology solutions align with DLB standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity.
  • Promote a culture that embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and the strategic use of technology tooptimizeperformance and scalability.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (Advanced level for all the following)

  • Expert knowledge of mission critical electrical infrastructure including utility services, medium- and low-voltage distribution, standby generation, UPS systems,parallelingswitchgear, transfer schemes, and critical power distribution.
  • Expert understanding of resilient power architectures including N, N+1, 2N, distributed redundant, and concurrently maintainable system designs.
  • Knowledge of codes and specifications for the design of electrical systems including National Electric Code, Life Safety and Energy Conservation Codes
  • Knowledge of technical / design software including short circuit coordination and arc flash studies, equipment sizing, underground feedercalculationsand lighting calculations
  • Demonstrated experience serving as Engineer of Record or technical lead for complex mission critical projects.
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled at producing drawings and visual aids using AutoCAD and / or Revit
  • Skilled in performing code analysis including selection of equipment, wiring, etc. to meet code requirements
  • Skilled in performing code analysis and advanced knowledge of electrical codes
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents,reportsand correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office,facilityand other environments
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

Travel / Relocation Requirements

  • Up to 10%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from ABET accredited institution
  • PE in related discipline

PLUS

  • Minimumthirteen years of progressive electrical engineering experience, including extensive experience leading the design and execution of mission critical facilities such as hyperscale data centers, enterprise data centers, AI infrastructure, semiconductor facilities, healthcare, or other high-availability environments.

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

​NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of DLB and DLB will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

raw.title: Team Supervisor, Client Delivery (1-year contract)
raw.excerpt: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes.
raw.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a remote Team Supervisor, Global Client Delivery, to join our Central Labs Services Team in Bulgaria.


Work schedule

1-year temporary contract.

Monday to Friday.

Standard hours.


Job Responsibilities

  • Supervise the day-to-day operations of the assigned customer or functional team members:
    • Ensure appropriate resource allocation to successfully implement and execute project plans.
    • Manage workload balance within assigned teams and participate in resource management across global teams.
    • Ensure consistent implementation, use, and review of SOPs.
    • Coordinate and monitor progress to ensure the achievement of team goals.
    • Implement, monitor, and report performance metrics and take corrective action when appropriate.
    • Effective and timely adherence to management communications, meetings and procedures.
    • Participate in departmental strategy execution.

​

  • Grow and develop your team including:
    • Ensure the development of a competent workforce to meet growth plans within budget.
    • Establish and monitor performance objectives for assigned direct reports and take corrective action where appropriate.
    • Complete thorough, timely, and well-documented performance evaluations.
    • Responsible for the activities and outcomes of direct reports, taking corrective actions where appropriate.

​

  • Instill and manage a culture of continuous improvement, quality, and productivity:
    • Responsible for monitoring and tracking resolution of all customer complaints, issues, and concerns related to the team’s responsibilities. Manage and ensure the resolution of such instances in collaboration with leadership.
    • Ensure issues are documented and leveraged to prevent repeated occurrence.
    • Leverage expertise by ensuring the breadth of experiences and liaison network are leveraged.
    • Ensure all services failures are identified, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner. Take preventative action to ensure that the same service failure does not occur again.

​

  • Ensure the team and department deliver on customer commitments in accordance with World Class Project Management and Service Excellence:
    • Ensure best practices are applied within the team regarding budget and risk management.
    • Ensure systems are updated to accurately reflect workload, timelines, etc.
    • Lead client relationship activities; adapt depending on specific client needs.
    • Ensure management of team and/or customer milestones and proactive communication with customers.
    • Proactively consult with customers regarding the impact of their decisions. Seek to understand their true needs and how Labcorp can best deliver to their needs.
    • Understand how each customer defines success and tailor processes and interpersonal approach to best meet customer needs, while balancing the advantages of global consistency.

​

  • Effectively collaborate with others and work across boundaries as necessary:
    • Assist leadership in managing and supervising the day-to-day operations of the team.
    • Work with the appropriate Business Development Directors to understand the culture and evolving needs of customers.
    • Work across CLS functions and Business Units to remove barriers and optimize client delivery consistently.

​

  • Central mentoring / coaching :
    • Lead centralized onboarding, mentoring, and coaching for Study Design Leads through their development journey across all Lead pharma client teams
    • Facilitate cross-team mentoring groups and learning communities.
    • Create a trusted environment that promotes collaboration, networking, and continuous learning.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 3 or more years of experience in clinical research in a client facing role
  • 1 or more years of experience in Central Laboratory Services
  • 1 or more years of experience in coaching or mentoring peers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in life science, medical, scientific, technical, or laboratory related discipline
  • 1 or more years of people leadership experience

Additional Job Standards

  • Fluency in English
  • Demonstrates advanced customer service expertise and a strong commitment to client satisfaction
  • Delivers excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication
  • Brings strong planning, organizational, and analytical problem‑solving capabilities
  • Proven ability to drive continuous improvement and enhance operational efficiency
  • Shows a high degree of initiative and thrives in collaborative team environments
  • Experienced in team building, influencing stakeholders, and resolving conflicts effectively
  • Maintains a consistent record of successfully completing projects and meeting objectives
  • Applies strong change‑management skills to guide teams through evolving priorities

In this position, you will be responsible for the coordination and management of an assigned team with a single or multi-functional area to ensure the successful implementation of the strategy, structures, processes, and metrics of the team all while ensuring customer satisfaction. The Supervisor is also accountable for enabling operational delivery, quality and efficiency, and continuously developing innovative solutions for team and customer success.


Labcorp is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer:

Labcorp strives for inclusion and belonging in the workforce and does not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind. We make employment decisions based on the needs of our business and the qualifications and merit of the individual. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), family or parental status, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, personal appearance, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic. Additionally, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.


We encourage all to apply

If you are an individual with a disability who needs assistance using our online tools to search and apply for jobs, or needs an accommodation, please visit our accessibility site or contact us at Labcorp Accessibility. For more information about how we collect and store your personal data, please see our Privacy Statement.

raw.description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

RN Utilization Review

PRIMARY PURPOSE: To provide timely, evidence-based utilization review services to maximize quality care and cost-effective outcomes.


ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE? We are looking for enthusiastic candidates who thrive in a collaborative environment, who are driven to deliver great work.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identifies treatment plan request(s) and obtains and analyzes medical records that support the request.
  • Clarifies unclear treatment plan requests by contacting the requesting provider's office.
  • Utilizes evidence-based criteria and jurisdictional guidelines to form utilization review determinations.
  • Pursues Physician Advisor services when treatment plan requests do not meet evidenced-based criteria.
  • Negotiates treatment plan requests with requesting provider when medically appropriate and jurisdictionally allowed.
  • Channels certified treatment plan requests to preferred vendors as necessary
  • Documents all utilization review outcomes in utilization review software.
  • Communicates and works with claim examiners as needed to provide clinical information to resolve issues.
  • Maintains a score of 90% or higher on monthly internal utilization review audits.
  • Meets productivity goals as outlined by supervisor.

Education & Licensing
Active unrestricted RN license in a state or territory of the United States required. Associate degree from an accredited college or university required. Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university preferred. Utilization review based certification preferred.


Experience
Four (4) years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required to include two (2) years of recent clinical practice or one (1) year of recent utilization review.


When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations.

Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines

Physical: Computer keyboarding.

Auditory/Visual: Hearing, vision and talking.


TAKING CARE OF YOU BY

  • Offering a blended work environment.
  • Supporting meaningful work that promotes critical thinking and problem solving.
  • Providing on-going learning and professional growth opportunities.
  • Promoting a strong team environment and a culture of support.
  • Recognizing your successes and celebrating your achievements.
  • We offer a diverse and comprehensive benefits package including:
    • Three Medical, and two dental plans to choose from.
    • Tuition reimbursement eligible.
    • 401K plan that matches 50% on every $ you put in up to the first 6% you save.
    • 4 weeks PTO your first full year.

NEXT STEPS


If your application is selected to advance to the next round, a recruiter will be in touch.


As required by law, Sedgwick provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in jurisdictions requiring pay transparency in job postings. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and cost of specific location. For the jurisdiction noted in this job posting only, the range of starting pay for this role is $73,000 - $75,000. A comprehensive benefits package is offered including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, 401k and matching, PTO, disability and life insurance, employee assistance, flexible spending or health savings account, and other additional voluntary benefits

Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

raw.description:
As a Recruiter (Level 2), you will play a hands-on operational role in supporting US recruitment delivery through candidate sourcing support, screening coordination, recruitment workflow execution, and compliance-focused process management. This role is expected to operate with higher independence than Level 1 and contribute to smoother recruitment throughput across multiple requisitions.

You will be responsible for supporting the end-to-end recruitment cycle by maintaining candidate pipelines, coordinating hiring stages, ensuring documentation readiness, and partnering closely with recruiters and leads on process execution. The role requires strong system proficiency, sound process judgment, and the ability to manage multiple recruitment activities in parallel.

Your mission is to strengthen operational reliability, improve candidate stage movement, and contribute to a high-quality recruitment support model through speed, accuracy, and process discipline.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Recruitment Operations & Workflow Execution

  • Requisition Coordination: Support active requisitions by maintaining candidate pipelines and ensuring recruitment stages progress on time.
  • Candidate Screening Support: Conduct initial profile validations or basic screening coordination where applicable, based on defined hiring criteria.
  • Interview Process Management: Coordinate interview stages from scheduling through feedback closure, ensuring no delay in candidate progression.
  • Priority Handling: Identify urgent roles, aging candidates, or delayed workflow items and bring them to recruiter attention proactively.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Work with recruiters, leads, and hiring teams to maintain visibility on pending actions and bottlenecks.

2. Full-Lifecycle Recruitment & Workflow Expertise

  • Pipeline Management: Manage candidate stage movement in Workday or ATS systems from application review through offer or handoff stages.
  • Resume Review Support: Assist in identifying aligned profiles based on role criteria, location, shift fit, and work authorization requirements.
  • Workflow Accuracy: Ensure all movement across recruitment stages is accurately reflected in systems and trackers.
  • Candidate Experience Support: Maintain timely updates and structured follow-up to prevent candidate drop-off.
  • Turnaround Ownership: Ensure scheduling, documentation, and recruiter support tasks are completed within service-level expectations.

3. Pre-Hire, BGV & Compliance Oversight

  • Documentation Verification: Validate that required pre-employment documents are complete before next-stage processing.
  • Compliance Tracking: Ensure background verification, consent forms, and mandatory compliance steps are initiated and tracked correctly.
  • Vendor Coordination Support: Where applicable, coordinate with background check partners or internal teams for status follow-up.
  • Exception Management: Highlight missing, incorrect, or delayed compliance items and ensure they are resolved within defined timelines.
  • Policy Compliance: Ensure recruitment process execution adheres to internal policy, audit standards, and client-specific requirements.

4. Onboarding & Candidate Transition Support

  • Offer-to-Onboarding Handoff: Support smooth transition from offer release to onboarding initiation by ensuring records are updated and complete.
  • Candidate Query Handling: Respond to candidate queries related to joining steps, pending documents, or timeline expectations.
  • Cross-Functional Support: Coordinate with onboarding, HR operations, and recruitment leadership on case-specific issues that may impact joining.
  • Readiness Monitoring: Track onboarding readiness and escalate risks related to delays or candidate drop-off.
  • Employee Support Coordination: Support resolution of first-level issues related to pre-joining process steps.

5. Quality Governance & Reporting

  • Operational Reporting: Maintain daily and weekly recruitment reports, candidate trackers, and open action dashboards.
  • Quality Checks: Review records for data gaps, incorrect stage movement, or documentation errors before final submission or handoff.
  • Trend Identification: Identify repeated workflow issues, scheduling delays, or compliance slippages and escalate them for resolution.
  • Process Improvement Support: Suggest improvements in coordination, tracker usage, or documentation flow to improve efficiency.
  • Knowledge Adherence: Follow defined SOPs, quality guidelines, and reporting formats consistently.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience: 1– 3 years of experience in US recruitment operations, talent acquisition support, HR shared services, or hiring coordination.
  • Availability to work U.S. business hours and follow the U.S. holiday calendar.
  • System Knowledge: Hands-on working knowledge of Workday, ATS platforms, Excel-based trackers, and Outlook/calendar coordination.
  • Operational Strength: Good understanding of recruitment stages, documentation control, and coordination-heavy workflows.
  • Communication (English and Spanish): Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to support candidate and stakeholder interactions confidently.
  • Execution Capability: Ability to manage multiple requisitions and high-volume support activity in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Recruitment Workflow Management: Strong understanding of hiring stages, process sequencing, and candidate lifecycle movement.
  • System Accuracy: Ability to maintain clean, reliable data across ATS, Workday, and recruitment trackers.
  • Analytical Attention: Identifies delays, missing information, or workflow risks before they impact delivery.
  • Process Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned requisitions, candidate actions, and pending closures.
  • Compliance Orientation: Maintains strict adherence to hiring documentation and verification requirements.
  • Stakeholder Responsiveness: Partners effectively with recruiters, onboarding teams, and internal functions to close actions quickly.
  • Candidate Focus: Supports timely communication and structured follow-up to protect candidate experience.
  • Adaptability: Works effectively in fast-paced, changing recruitment environments with competing priorities.

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud Engineering. Advanced Analytics.
For Enterprises, these are key factors of success. For us, they're our core expertise.

We work with global iconic brands. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technologies and business process excellence. At the heart of it all is Digital Engineering - the foundation that powers rapid innovation and scalable business transformation.

We've created 363 unique and independent inventions, 250 of which are AI-based and rolled up under several patent grants in critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation at scale, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless "as-a-service" model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. With proven strategies and agile execution, we don't just enable change - we engineer digital outcomes.

Digital Outcomes.

With our headquarters in Boston, MA, we are growing and expanding our teams located in different countries!


What will you do?

You will lead a team of engineers, participate in architectural decisions, ensure code quality, and collaborate with cross‑functional stakeholders to deliver high‑performance products.

raw.description:
Job Description - Mid-Market Account Executive

Reports To: Director of Sales

Department: Sales

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

As a Mid-Market Account Executive at AxisCare, you will drive net-new revenue, expand existing accounts, and run efficient, high-velocity sales cycles with growing organizations in home care: established single-location agencies, emerging multi-location operators, and regional providers scaling their operations. You will own the full sales lifecycle, from prospecting and multithreaded discovery to negotiation with owners and executives, acting as a trusted advisor who translates AxisCare’s capabilities into clear business ROI.

This role is built for a seasoned hunter who builds internal and external relationships, is energized by building pipeline from a blank page, and measures themselves against excellence, not quota alone.

What Defines an AxisCare Mid-Market AE

Our most successful sellers share a consistent set of traits. We are looking for someone who can raise the water table through their actions and results.

  • MEDDPICC-Driven, Framework-Fluent: Runs every deal on MEDDPICC and draws on techniques found in Challenger, Command of the Message, Sandler, and SPIN to make AxisCare the clear choice.
  • Multithreads by Default: Never single-threads a deal; builds relationships with owners, administrators, operations, finance, and office staff.
  • Speaks Owner: Understands how agency owners and operators measure their business (margin, caregiver retention, cash flow, and growth) and engages them with confidence.
  • Educated and Strategic: Knows the home-based care market and prioritizes accounts by growth, location count, and operational pain.
  • Exceptional Listener: Listens more than they speak and hears what isn’t being said.
  • Creative and Persistent, Never Pushy: Finds new ways into accounts and earns every next meeting with value, not pressure.
  • Highly Organized: Manages a high-volume territory and many concurrent sales cycles with precision.
  • Leads and Follows: Takes command when the moment calls for it and defers when that better serves the outcome.
  • Chases Excellence: Brings an aggressive, competitive mentality and is never satisfied with being good; studies wins and losses and holds a standard higher than any quota.

Key Responsibilities

  • Territory & Account Planning: Build and execute a territory plan for net-new mid-market accounts and expansion, prioritizing targets by growth, location count, and buying signals.
  • Pipeline Generation & Prospecting: Generate the majority of your own pipeline through outbound campaigns, industry events, and your professional network, partnering with BDRs and Marketing to uncover new and expansion opportunities.
  • Multithreading & Stakeholder Engagement: Align the buying committee, building relationships with owners, administrators, operations, and finance leaders to position AxisCare as the platform that supports their growth.
  • Discovery & Value Selling: Lead focused discovery with owners and operational decision-makers to diagnose business challenges, identify key stakeholders, and position AxisCare as a critical business driver.
  • Demos & Solution Design: Deliver high-impact product demonstrations and partner with Implementation to scope tailored solutions.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Manage pricing, contract, and security conversations to close multi-level agreements efficiently and consistently.
  • Forecasting & CRM Discipline: Apply MEDDPICC to every opportunity and maintain accurate pipeline, deal stages, and weekly and quarterly forecasts in HubSpot, using Gong to inspect and strengthen deals.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to ensure a seamless handoff and strong long-term net revenue retention.

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including 2+ years in a closing role targeting SMB or mid-market accounts.
  • Track record of consistently closing five- and six-figure deals with sales cycles of 1 to 4 months while managing a high-volume pipeline.
  • Experience selling into home care, home health, hospice, or post-acute care strongly preferred; experience selling to multi-location or franchise organizations a plus.
  • Strong executive presence and owner-level communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong financial and business acumen to build ROI models and business cases.
  • High grit, resilience, intellectual curiosity, and self-management in a remote or hybrid environment.
  • Deep proficiency in HubSpot, Gong, and a modern sales intelligence and engagement stack.
  • Mastery of MEDDPICC, with working command of Challenger, Command of the Message, Sandler, and SPIN.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Working Conditions

Occasional travel, including overnight; daily use of a computer, Microsoft Office 365, CRM, HRIS, and email.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary plus commission (OTE TBD based on experience and skill level).
  • Medical insurance premiums are covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental and Vision) 
  • 401K with competitive company matching.
  • Personal time off, sick leave, and holidays.
  • Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment.

Why AxisCare?

At AxisCare, you’ll help transform the home care industry, with a direct voice in how we win in the mid-market, close access to leadership, and room to grow in a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and making a difference.

About AxisCare

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.

AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more userfriendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 7 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.

raw.description:
À PROPOS DE L3M HOLDING

L3M Holding structure et développe un portefeuille d’activités à fort potentiel, organisé en 5 business units - services aux entreprises, e-commerce beauté, formation, e-commerce général et hospitality - ainsi qu’en 6 pôles support. Le Groupe est présent dans plusieurs pays, notamment en France, au Maroc, au Sénégal, en Côte d’Ivoire et à Madagascar.

Dans le cadre d’un programme d’accompagnement académique individualisé, nous recherchons des profils scientifiques de très haut niveau capables d’assurer un rôle de tuteur, de référent académique et de coach de réussite.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Il ne s’agit pas simplement de donner quelques heures de cours. Vous accompagnez l’étudiant dans la durée et devenez son référent privilégié pour l’ensemble de son parcours académique : compréhension des cours, organisation du travail, maintien d’un excellent dossier, préparation des examens et préparation intensive à des concours ou processus de sélection particulièrement exigeants.

Objectif : sécuriser le parcours académique de l’étudiant tout en lui permettant de dégager suffisamment de temps et d’énergie pour préparer efficacement ses concours.

VOS MISSIONS PRINCIPALES
1. Accompagnement académique

  • Reprendre avec l’étudiant les cours qu’il maîtrise insuffisamment et consolider les fondamentaux.

  • Intervenir en Mathématiques, Physique ou Informatique, selon votre expertise.

  • Accompagner la résolution d’exercices, TD, études de cas et problèmes scientifiques.

  • Préparer des exercices complémentaires ciblés, supports de révision et examens blancs.

  • Identifier rapidement les lacunes et mettre en place des actions correctives.

  • Préparer l’étudiant à ses évaluations et examens et construire des outils de travail plus efficaces.

2. Préparation intensive aux concours et sélections

  • Comprendre précisément les attendus du concours ou de la sélection préparée.

  • Construire un programme de préparation sur plusieurs semaines ou plusieurs mois, avec priorités, calendrier et objectifs mesurables.

  • Travailler sur des annales, sujets de concours et entraînements progressifs puis intensifs.

  • Créer et corriger des examens blancs en conditions réelles.

  • Analyser les erreurs et ajuster la stratégie de préparation.

  • Renforcer les matières ou compétences susceptibles de limiter les chances de réussite.

3. Garantir un dossier académique solide

  • Suivre les résultats, matières à fort coefficient, échéances et éventuels retards.

  • Identifier les notes ou matières susceptibles de fragiliser le dossier.

  • Mettre en place un plan d’amélioration avant que les difficultés ne deviennent pénalisantes.

  • Alerter rapidement l’étudiant et, lorsque cela est prévu, la famille sur les points de vigilance.

  • Maintenir un niveau académique élevé tout en préparant les échéances sélectives.

4. Organisation, suivi et reporting

  • Hiérarchiser les priorités et anticiper les périodes de forte charge.

  • Construire des plannings de travail réalistes et adaptés au rythme de l’étudiant.

  • Suivre les progrès dans la durée et responsabiliser progressivement l’étudiant.

  • Produire un reporting régulier, factuel et utile : travail réalisé, acquis, difficultés, risques, prochaines priorités et actions correctives.

  • Communiquer clairement avec l’étudiant et, selon l’organisation retenue, avec la famille.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Master 2 scientifique minimum ; doctorant·e ou docteur·e fortement apprécié·e. (Maths, Physique, Informatique)

  • Diplôme d’une grande école, école d’ingénieurs ou cursus scientifique d’excellence apprécié.

  • Enseignant·e du supérieur, chargé·e de TD, doctorant·e enseignant·e, ingénieur·e ou profil scientifique de niveau équivalent.

  • Excellente maîtrise d’au moins une discipline scientifique exigeante : Mathématiques, Physique, Informatique ou domaine connexe.

  • Capacité à intervenir auprès d’étudiants de niveau Licence, Master, école d’ingénieurs ou formation supérieure équivalente.

  • Expérience concrète en enseignement supérieur, tutorat individuel, mentorat, préparation d’examens ou accompagnement académique structuré.

  • Expérience de préparation à des concours ou sélections exigeantes fortement appréciée.

  • Excellente maîtrise du français oral et écrit.

QUALITÉS PROFESSIONNELLES ATTENDUES

  • Très grande pédagogie et capacité à vulgariser des notions complexes.

  • Rigueur, fiabilité, organisation et capacité d’anticipation.

  • Écoute, patience, adaptabilité et excellent sens du relationnel.

  • Réactivité et disponibilité dans le cadre défini pour l’accompagnement.

  • Capacité à créer une relation de confiance tout en maintenant un haut niveau d’exigence.

  • Capacité à construire un suivi structuré et à mesurer la progression.

  • Implication réelle dans la réussite de l’étudiant, au-delà de la simple délivrance d’un cours.

CE QUI FERA LA DIFFÉRENCE

  • Une expérience réelle avec des étudiants du supérieur et non uniquement avec un public scolaire.

  • Une expérience de préparation à des concours, sélections, classes préparatoires ou examens exigeants.

  • La capacité à accompagner l’étudiant sur plusieurs semaines ou plusieurs mois avec une méthode claire et mesurable.

  • La capacité à articuler excellence académique, préparation aux concours, organisation du travail et maintien de la motivation.

  • Des disponibilités suffisamment régulières pour devenir un véritable référent académique.

ORGANISATION DES SÉANCES

  • Séances régulières en visioconférence.

  • Séances en présentiel selon la localisation et le calendrier de l’étudiant.

  • Périodes intensives de préparation avant examens et concours.

  • Disponibilité suffisante et flexible sur une plage horaire du lundi au dimanche en fonction des besoins et horaires des étudiants

CONDITIONS D’EMPLOI

  • Localisation: Casablanca/ Dakar/ Marrakech

  • Organisation: Visioconférence.

  • Statut: Indépendant avec facturation mensuelle

  • Rémunération : A discuter selon le profil

POURQUOI REJOINDRE CE PROGRAMME ?

  • Accompagner des étudiants du supérieur sur des objectifs académiques exigeants et concrets.

  • Intervenir dans la durée et mesurer réellement l’impact de votre accompagnement.

  • Mobiliser vos compétences scientifiques, votre pédagogie et votre capacité d’organisation dans une même mission.

  • Contribuer à la réussite d’étudiants préparant des parcours et sélections à haut niveau d’exigence.

COMMENT POSTULER ?

Votre candidature doit être complète. Les réponses aux questions de présélection permettront d’évaluer votre niveau scientifique, votre expérience pédagogique, votre méthode de suivi et votre disponibilité réelle.

  • CV à jour.

  • Réponses à l’intégralité des questions de présélection.

  • Vidéo obligatoire de 2 à 3 minutes selon les consignes du formulaire.

REJOIGNEZ L3M

...et aidez un élève à réussir les concours les plus exigeants de France, en partageant votre expertise en mathématiques, en physique et en informatique, 100 % à distance.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a New Business Account Executive, you'll be at the forefront of GitLab’s growth strategy, exclusively focused on acquiring new logos and expanding our market presence. You'll work with buyers at high-growth companies, navigating sales cycles while maintaining the high velocity of a true new business seller breaking into new accounts and building relationships from scratch.

This is a greenfield opportunity for someone who combines a strong ability to sell with a startup mentality. In this role, you’ll sell innovation and change to net new customers, compressing decision cycles while building trust at the C-level. You'll own the entire sales cycle from initial outreach through close, building your own pipeline while collaborating with marketing and SDRs to maximize every opportunity. Your success will directly impact our company's growth trajectory and market position.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full new logo acquisition cycle
  • Build and maintain a 3-4x pipeline coverage through high-volume prospecting activities, dedicating the majority of your time to pipeline generation
  • Execute a disciplined daily prospecting cadence, including cold calling, strategic email sequences, social selling, and creative outbound strategies to identify and create new opportunities
  • Run high-quality discovery meetings, uncovering business pain points and articulating compelling value propositions that resonate at executive levels
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes with C-level executives, IT leaders, and cross-functional buying committees
  • Develop and execute strategic territory plans, identifying high-value targets and creating a qualified account prioritization strategy
  • Partner with Solutions Architecture and Customer Success to orchestrate technical evaluations, POCs, and ensure smooth post-sale transitions
  • Master our sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) to qualify opportunities, manage deal velocity, and drive predictable revenue
  • Maintain exceptional Salesforce hygiene, including detailed account notes, use case documentation, competitive intelligence, and accurate forecasting
  • Exceed quotas while maintaining high activity levels and pipeline velocity metrics

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong B2B SaaS sales experience with an emphasis on new business development and net-new logo acquisition
  • Proven track record as a top performer with success in closing new logos
  • Strong prospecting mentality with exceptional pipeline generation skills – you've built territories from scratch and created demand in greenfield accounts
  • Experience with consumption-based or usage-based business models and ability to articulate value beyond traditional licensing
  • Strong discovery and qualification capabilities using consultative selling approaches to uncover business pain and build compelling business cases for C-level stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to compress sales cycles while managing multiple complex opportunities simultaneously (15-20+ active deals)
  • Relentless work ethic and competitive drive – you're energized by prospecting, motivated by competition, and have an insatiable desire to win
  • Adaptability and coachability – you thrive in dynamic, high-velocity environments and continuously iterate based on market feedback
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills with the ability to craft and deliver executive-level presentations that drive urgency
  • Proficiency with modern sales tech stack including Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo/Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, and 6sense

About the team

Our New Business team operates like a startup within the company – we're builders, prospectors, and market makers who are constantly thinking about our next deal and strategising our account plans. We’re looking for sales professionals who get energized by new opportunities and thrive on breaking into accounts that have never heard of us.

The team culture is built on drive, accountability, and continuous improvement (growth mindset). We share competitive intelligence, celebrate wins loudly, learn from losses quickly, and push each other to be better every day. You'll be surrounded by other top performers who are passionate about their craft and committed to building something special.

You'll report to the Director of New Business Sales and work closely with a dedicated SDR pod, Sales Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success. We invest heavily in your development with weekly 1:1 coaching, deal strategy sessions, and ongoing enablement. Come and be a part of this team as we look to build something new!

raw.excerpt: About SodaAt Soda, we're on a mission to bring everyone closer to their data.
raw.description:
About Soda

At Soda, we're on a mission to bring everyone closer to their data. We believe that all data stakeholders (and we think that's everyone) should be able to understand it, trust it, and stay on top of it. We're pioneering the fastest-growing category in the data and analytics space, known as data quality and observability. We allow teams to discover, prioritize, and collaboratively resolve data issues. Our integrated platform brings everyone closer to the data, resulting in data products and analytics everyone can trust.

We are an international team, headquartered in Brussels, Belgium and dispersed globally. Our customers are enterprises (banks, insurers, retailers and utilities), so security compliance isn't paperwork for us. It's part of how we win deals and keep them.

The job

We're looking for someone to own Soda's compliance function and keep building it. We've already built a strong foundation: we've been running a SOC 2 cycle since 2021, and have been making strides in automating and professionalizing the entire compliance process in the past year. But we aren't where we want to be yet. You will be pushing this further: maximizing automation and streamlining processes, so we get even better compliance, while minimizing time our engineers and ops team have to spend on manual execution and evidence gathering.

Soda's product and operations are evolving at lightning speed. You will be the person to find pragmatic ways to make sure we keep our compliance commitments without slowing us down.

If your instinct when you see a manual process is to ask what should be doing this instead of a person, this is a good role for you.

What you'll do

Build the structure. Roughly half of this job is making compliance at Soda easier and more reliable to run:

  • Push the automation of our compliance program as far as it can go. We've already got a compliance automation platform, lots of controls are already fully or partially automated. Your job is to take that even further. Every minute you give back to our engineers by taking away manual tasks is a minute they can spend building a better product instead.
  • Build compliance that enables the future. Soda is leveraging the massive capabilities of AI both in its product and in its internal operations. Our processes and controls need to keep up with the new world. You will adapt our compliance posture to this fast pace of change, with pragmatic solutions that keep/improve our compliance commitments without dragging down our speed in the market.
  • Make our RFP and security-questionnaire answering hyper efficient. Compliance and security are important topics in every RFP and supplier due diligence process. You will make sure this is handled as efficiently as possible, using and expanding our existing tooling and making sure the most up-to-date references are used at all times.

And make it run. The other half is the programme itself, which has to stay audit-ready while you improve it:

  • Own the annual SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3 cycle with our external auditor: planning, access, samples, our part of the report, and closing out findings.
  • Keep the control set audit-ready all year: watch what's lapsing, chase what's failing, make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Run people compliance: the compliance steps in onboarding and offboarding, plus the yearly security training, code of conduct, incident-reporting and phishing cycles.
  • Be Sales' compliance partner in enterprise security reviews, unblocking deals without promising things we don't do.

Who we're looking for

You've run a SOC 2 program or similar before at a SaaS company. You're comfortable being the only compliance person in the room and pragmatic about designing controls that work for a company our size.

Two things make or break this role. First, a lot of it is getting busy engineers to do something on time and prove they did it. You need to manage that, and find ways of making this as low-friction as possible for everyone involved. Second, you have to be able to build: not production software, but scripts, integrations, prompts, and AI-assisted workflows that hold up under an auditor's questions.

Because it's part-time and remote, we need someone predictable and self-directed, who runs their own agenda and flags early when something needs a decision from us.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in security compliance / GRC, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
  • You have run a SOC 2 Type II cycle hands-on, including working directly with an external auditor through scoping, sampling and remediation
  • Hands-on with a compliance automation platform: Drata ideally, or Vanta / Secureframe. You know what these tools genuinely automate and where they still need a person.
  • Comfortable designing and implementing automations, including with AI
  • Comfortable with the systems these controls run against: AWS, Okta, GitHub, endpoint management. Enough to judge whether evidence is real, not just whether a file was uploaded.
  • Comfortable answering enterprise security questionnaires and holding your own live in a customer security review
  • Clear written and spoken English, and the judgement to write a policy people can actually follow
  • Available roughly 2–3 days per week, with solid working-hours overlap with CET
  • Must be working in an EU time zone
  • Able to invoice as a freelancer / contractor

Nice to have

  • Technical experience
  • Experience in a company under 200 people, where compliance is one person plus a lot of automation
  • ISO 27001 experience
  • A certification such as CISA, CISM, CIPP/E or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer

Benefits

  • A real mandate to build a modern, forward-looking compliance system that keeps pace with and leverages opportunities created by the new AI reality
  • A live, certified programme with enterprise customers depending on it, with full freedom to implement improvements
  • A documented starting point: runbooks for every manual control, a scheduling system that tells you what's due, and a full written handover from your predecessor
  • An AI-forward company that will actually fund and use what you build
  • Direct access to decision-makers; no layers between you and the people who can fix things
  • A competitive contractor rate

Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.

  • Structure and evaluate alternative and structured financing schemes for mining operations, including metal prepays, royalties, streaming agreements, offtake and marketing arrangements, and debt/equity hybrids, and assess their impact on project economics and counterparty risk.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Earth Sciences.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in mining, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or technical/financial advisory within the resources sector.

  • Exposure to M&A transactions, project finance, or asset valuation in mining is highly desirable.

  • Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, finance/business degree, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).

  • Demonstrated understanding of mineral resource classification codes (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, or similar).

  • Working knowledge of structured financing instruments used in the mining sector, including prepays, royalties, streams, and offtake agreements.

  • Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.

  • Ability to translate technical geological data into commercial and financial insight.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with mining technical software (e.g., resource and mine-planning tools) is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.

  • Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.

Preferred / Advantageous

  • Knowledge of ESG frameworks relevant to mining.

  • Additional languages and willingness to travel to project sites.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About Epic

Epic Kids is the leading digital reading platform built for kids 12 and under, trusted by millions of children, educators, and families around the world. Our mission is to inspire a lifelong love of reading by providing unlimited access to thousands of high-quality books, videos, and educational content through a safe and engaging experience. We combine technology, storytelling, and learning innovation to help every child become a confident reader.

At Epic, you'll join a collaborative and fast-paced global team passionate about building meaningful products that make a real impact on children's education and literacy.

About the Engagement

We need a hands-on Iterable expert to get our educator email journeys live, running correctly, and measured, and to shape an email engagement strategy across our user segments. Our new educator onboarding journey creative was finished in February and is still not fully live because of Iterable and product setup. More educator journeys are queued behind it, and we have had to pause journeys that sent when they should not have. Recent campaign sends have also shown gaps in our wider email process, such as sends reaching the wrong countries or listing the wrong dates, so we also need email marketing operations help to fix how campaigns get built, checked and approved.

This is a 12-week contract. You'll work alongside our Email team and partner with Product and Engineering on event data. The goal is to clear the backlog, prevent new mistakes, and leave us with a strategy and playbook we can run ourselves.

What You'll Own

  • Educator Journey Launch:Finish setup, QA and launch of the new educator onboarding journey, and retire the old one with no gap in coverage. Then build and launch the other educator journeys in progress, in priority order. Monitor each launch and report results against our journey goals.

  • Iterable Audit & QA:Audit active journeys and campaigns, and flag anything sending to the wrong audience or overlapping another program. Put a pre-launch QA checklist and sign-off step in place so unintended sends stop.

  • Email Marketing Operations Review:Review how our email campaigns move from request to send today across Marketing, Creative, Product and the Email team. Find where errors slip through and recommend improvements, such as clear owners and checks for audience, country, dates and offers before anything sends. Help put the agreed changes in place. Start from the issues the team has already flagged in the weekly email marketing meeting.

  • Conversion Tracking:Review our educator and family conversion definitions and tracking in Iterable, and implement or fix them where needed, with tracking live by December 1. Confirm the product events our journeys rely on to reach Iterable.

  • SMS Integration:Help complete the Iterable SMS setup and define the first educator SMS use case, opt-in and compliance requirements.

  • Engagement Strategy Across Segments:Map current email by segment: free and paid educators, ES+ schools and districts, families, and prospects. Recommend programs, cadence and priority rules so programs don't collide, plus a roadmap for the next two quarters.

  • Documentation & Handoff:Leave a playbook covering journey logic, naming, QA and troubleshooting, and walk the Email team through it.

Timeline & Deliverables

  • Weeks 1–2:Iterable walkthrough, audit of live journeys, QA checklist, prioritized launch list, review of the current email campaign process

  • Weeks 3–8:onboarding journey live and monitored, next journeys launched, conversion tracking live by Dec 1, process improvements recommended and rolling out

  • Weeks 9–12:segment strategy and roadmap, playbook, final walkthrough

  • Weekly:30-minute check-in and a short written status update

Not in scope:email creative and copy, product or engineering builds, changing email platforms.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 3+ years hands-on in Iterable: journeys, segmentation, triggers, data feeds and QA

  • Lifecycle email experience across several user segments

  • Experience setting up conversion or event tracking and reporting on email impact

  • Email marketing operations experience: campaign intake, workflows, QA and approvals across teams

  • Clear, practical recommendations, delivered collaboratively with an in-house team

  • Comfortable working remotely and independently

Nice to Have:

  • EdTech, K-12 or freemium product experience

  • Iterable SMS setup

  • Salesforce and Iterable integrations

  • Deliverability and domain reputation

How We'll Measure Success

  • Educator onboarding journey live, old journey retired, no coverage gap

  • No unintended sends from journeys launched or reviewed

  • Process improvements agreed and in use, with audience, country and dates checked before every send

  • Conversion tracking live in Iterable by December 1

  • Every in-progress educator journey launched or on a dated plan

  • Segment strategy and playbook delivered and reviewed by the Email team

raw.description:
What is the role?

dotCMS is a visual, headless CMS built for compliance-led enterprises that need to manage and scale digital content across brands, regions, and channels.

As a Partner Manager, you'll play a key role in growing dotCMS's partner ecosystem, building strong partner relationships, and turning partnerships into a consistent source of new business opportunities. You'll work closely with our Revenue team to coordinate partner activities, support joint marketing initiatives, and drive partner-generated pipeline and revenue.

We're proud to be 100% remote! This position is open to candidates based in the US or Canada who can work Eastern Time (ET) hours. Please note that this is a full-time employee position, and we are unable to provide or transfer employment visa sponsorship at this time.

What is dotCMS?

Founded in 2003, dotCMS is the most secure, trusted, and scalable content management system built for compliance-led industries. Built on leading Java technology, dotCMS is a visual, headless content management system that gives developers the flexibility of a headless infrastructure while equipping marketers with no-code visual content authoring. Whether you're managing 10 or 1,000+ sites, dotCMS brings flexibility, security, and efficiency to enterprise content operations. Some of our notable customers include Telus, BNP Paribas, Worldline, Estes, ARC Health, Royal Bank of Canada, Southern Phone, and Junior Achievement.

Who are we, really?

At “the dot,” you’ll find a diverse team of authentic individuals who share the goal of building the most agile, scalable, and secure content management system, delighting customers, and having a lot of fun doing it. Our mission is to make content work for everyone by simplifying content creation and delivery to drive collaboration & engagement.

We are accountable, collaborative team players who take ownership and deliver excellence. As doers, we are driven by dedication and a strong work ethic. We are passionately dedicated, innovative, curious, and transparent, while remaining humble. Above all, we are customer-obsessed, focused on exceeding expectations with empathy and solutions-oriented thinking.

What you'll own

  • Growth Partner Management: Manage relationships with strategic growth partners and execute partner plans developed and agreed upon by the GTM Lead, including account mapping, partner engagement, and tracking progress against pipeline targets.
  • Core Partner Management: Maintain relationships with existing partners that require ongoing attention, ensuring appropriate support, communication, and operational continuity.
  • Partner Program & Portal: Lead the strategy and ongoing management of the partner portal and partner program tiers, improving partner engagement, enablement, and operational efficiency.
  • Partner Enablement: Coordinate training, content, resources, and activities that help partners effectively position and deliver dotCMS solutions.
  • Co-Marketing: Coordinate and oversee the execution of joint campaigns, webinars, and partner events, including on-site logistics, coordinating with Marketing and the GTM Lead.
  • Technology Partnerships: Oversee technology partnerships, working closely with Product and technical stakeholders.
  • Partner Performance & Operations: Review partner performance against agreed-upon partnership plans, recommend improvements, track partner-sourced pipeline and ROI, and validate incentive and referral payouts with Finance.

Requirements

  • 5–7+ years of experience, including experience in partner management, channel partnerships, or ecosystem development within B2B SaaS (enterprise preferred).
  • Proven Track Record:
    • Building or scaling partner programs and systems to make the program a success
    • Generating partner-sourced pipeline as a result of the optimized process and systems.
    • Managing a portfolio of partners with different levels of strategic importance and growth potential.
  • Skills & Attributes:
  • Strong relationship management, account planning, and project execution skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple partner initiatives, prioritize resources, and drive measurable outcomes.
  • Experience tracking partner performance, pipeline attribution, and program ROI.
  • Nice to Have
    • Experience working toward defined pipeline or ARR targets.

Key Measure of Success

  • Oversee and execute partner plans for every partner who’s signed an agreement.
  • Ensure 100% of active partners complete the most up-to-date certifications.
  • Generate $800K annually in new pipelines from partners.

Why should you join?

If you have great experience but are tired of being a cog in a giant corporate wheel, this job is for you. It’s a chance to create a new product marketing function at an established, growing company with a mature product in use by major global organizations. Everything you do everyday, will make a huge impact on our company. Your work will be seen, felt and recognized and your past experience valued.

Your Compensation. We offer competitive compensation that allows you to make a great living for yourself and your loved ones.

Your Team. We are a humble, competitive, and small vendor making waves in our industry, and you will be part of a team that has your back. You never walk alone! We are a diverse and distributed team, and we offer annual company-paid training and development to our team members.

Your Voice. Your voice matters to all of us, and we appreciate your opinion as we scale our company to the next level in an open and transparent environment. We will periodically update the entire team on business performance and strategic initiatives and offer the stage for an entrepreneurial-minded professional to produce key initiatives that help to move the needle.

Your Time. We value you as an individual, team member, and professional. We can only expect you to deliver high performance within the right amount of You-time. Therefore, you will have access to an Open PTO policy (after the first 90 days in the company) and a generous number of local company-paid holidays.

raw.description:
Our SAP Technical Solutions Consultant is an essential pre-sales customer-facing role within the Global Revenue Organization, partnering with prospects and clients to drive a mutual understanding of FloQast’s vast integration ecosystem. Directly engaging with customers' IT, Financial Systems Admins, and end-users, this role involves consulting, answering queries, and advocating best practices for integrations across complex SAP setups (ECC and S/4HANA), diverse ERPs, Cloud Storage, SSO, Communication Tools, and other financial platforms. This team player collaborates closely with Account Executives, Solutions Consultants, and Account Managers on late-stage opportunities and will serve as the primary technical authority for SAP-specific landscape and connectivity discussions. This person will in turn play a key role in providing feedback to the product/engineering teams about SAP integration gaps they identify during the sales process.

*Visa sponsorship is NOT available at this time

What You'll Do:

  • Act as the primary technical subject matter expert for FloQast’s SAP integration strategy, effectively navigating and explaining the nuances of SAP S/4HANA (Public/Private Cloud) and legacy ECC environments to prospective clients.
  • Serve as subject matter expert for FloQast’s integration ecosystem, including pre-built APIs, custom APIs and connectors (specifically those for SAP), SFTP, and SAML.
  • Join late-stage Sales opportunities to demonstrate integration requirements to prospective customers, answer questions, and sell on the value these integrations bring to secure IT approval.
  • Strategize with the Sales team on best next steps to get the technical buy-in from the prospect.
  • Collaborate with the Product/Engineering team on developments needed from an integration perspective.
  • Design and validate integration workflows that leverage FloQast’s tri-modal connectivity architecture (Direct APIs, On-Premise Connectors, and Public API endpoints) to overcome technical deal blockers in complex SAP landscapes.
  • Consult with prospects on optimizing their month-end close by identifying opportunities for SAP job orchestration and T-code execution, helping customers achieve parity with enterprise-grade automation solutions.
  • Collaborate with customer IT teams to map financial data requirements to SAP data structures, including native ingestion of Trial Balances, GL transactions, subledgers, and custom client tables (Z-tables).
  • Ensure all customer-facing technical guides for third-party integrations are up-to-date and provide materials to the sales team or prospects, as needed.
  • Answer questions from the sales team about integrations for their customer use cases.
  • Deliver the required integrations and FloQast test environments for occasional proof of concepts needed to secure a customer.
  • Write regular expressions to parse file names and contents for data processing as part of integrations with ERPs (including SAP data extractions), subledgers, banks, etc. related to POCs, as needed.
  • Any other duties or tasks that may be assigned to help the Solutions Consulting department, the Company, and/or our clients meet their goals.

What You'll Bring:

  • Deep understanding of SAP environments, specifically regarding SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Integration Suite entitlements, and the distinction between SAP Public vs. Private Cloud deployment models.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Solutions Engineer or in a Financial Business Systems, Technical IT Consulting, IT, or related role with a focus on integrations, IT infrastructure, and system interoperability.
  • Possess a deep understanding of the IT infrastructure and the associated needs and pain points to position FloQast effectively.
  • Experience with ERP systems (especially SAP S/4HANA or ECC), supporting configuration, integration, or migration of ERP modules.
  • Experience with cloud storage systems and administration experience within a team setting.
  • Experience with Single Sign-On (SSO) solutions and administrative experience within a team setting.
  • Proven experience or strong aptitude for navigating SAP data dictionaries and understanding standard SAP table structures (e.g., ACDOCA for transactional and trial balance data) to facilitate accurate data ingestion.
  • Integration Implementation: Experience implementing or supporting integration projects involving SAP APIs (OData/RESTful) and secure file exchange (SFTP) within the context of financial or ERP systems.
  • Collaborative team player; must be comfortable in a high-velocity sales environment.
  • Energetic communicator who enjoys relationship building via multiple video conferencing calls daily.
  • Strong verbal and written skills to assist customers over live meetings, zoom, and/or email.
  • Ability to communicate technical IT concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter with a high level of initiative and follow-through; views each scenario as an opportunity to improve the current process and strive towards further excellence.
  • Ability to work well under tight deadlines and respond to rapidly changing demands.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%

Nice to haves:

  • Degree in IT, Business Systems, Accounting Information Systems, or a related field
  • Familiarity with scripting and data formats (e.g., regex, JSON, Python, SQL) to assist in advanced troubleshooting and customization for integrations
  • Experience publishing and/or updating technical documentation
The base pay range for this position is $115,000- $150,000. This position is eligible for a commission plan in addition to base pay. Compensation is not limited to base salary. FloQast values our Total Rewards, and offers a competitive and elaborate Benefits Package including, but not limited to, Medical, Dental, Vision, Family Forming benefits, Life & Disability Insurance, and Unlimited Vacation.
