Senior Identity & Access Management (IAM) Analyst


Come build something that matters.


It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of more than 50,000 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.


The Job:

As a Senior Identity & Access Management (IAM) Analyst, you’ll be part of our Cybersecurity team working as a remote employee. As a Senior IAM Analyst within our Cybersecurity team, you will serve as a strategic advisor and technical expert, helping to drive governance, strategy, and advisory services for our Identity and Access Management program. You will lead IAM assessments, partner with Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), and collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to implement and communicate the company’s IAM standards. Your work will focus on key initiatives such as nonhuman identity management, program and process development, identity verification, passwordless authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and Active Directory governance. This role requires broad IAM expertise and the ability to translate complex requirements into actionable solutions and clear communications for technical teams.


You’ll get to:

  • Lead IAM governance, strategy, and advisory initiatives for all identity types (human, nonhuman, customer).
  • Advise and support technical teams in the implementation of the company-wide IAM standard, ensuring both governance and technical requirements are met.
  • Conduct comprehensive IAM assessments across organizational applications, identifying gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Drive program and process development, including onboarding, provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, and access certification campaigns.
  • Provide expert guidance on nonhuman identity strategy and implementation.
  • Lead initiatives around identity verification, passwordless authentication, MFA, SSO, and secure credential management.
  • Champion the elimination of insecure practices (e.g., sharing network credentials via email).
  • Oversee Active Directory governance and compliance efforts.
  • Collaborate with GRC, IT, application owners, and business units to support audits, risk assessments, and compliance initiatives.
  • Communicate IAM standards, policies, and technical requirements to technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Mentor and guide junior IAM team members; facilitate workshops, meetings, and training sessions.
  • Develop and deliver clear, actionable reports, presentations, and metrics for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Stay current with emerging IAM trends, technologies, and threats, translating insights into actionable recommendations for the organization.

The Person:

You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have:

  • Undergraduate degree and 6–8 years of relevant experience,
    OR
  • Graduate degree and 4–6 years of relevant experience,
    OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and work experience totaling 6–8 years of relevant experience.
  • Proven experience in IAM governance, strategy, and advisory services.
  • Broad IAM expertise covering human, nonhuman, and customer identities.
  • Hands-on experience with passwordless authentication, MFA, SSO, and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions.
  • Deep knowledge of Identity Management Systems (e.g., SailPoint, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory) and PAM platforms (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust).
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., ISO27001, NIST).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to expertly advise technical teams and influence stakeholders.
  • Experience facilitating workshops, meetings, and training sessions.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CIAM, CIMP, cloud security) are highly desirable.

The Details:

You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan including:

  • Medical, dental, life, vision, wellness program, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement.
  • Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

And More:

We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:

  • Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.
  • Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.
  • Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!


The Salary range for this position is $90,000.00 - $144,900.00

  • This is the lowest to highest annual full-time salary range we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. The salary offered within the range may vary depending on multiple factors including job level, geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience and in compliance with local wage requirements. Please note that salary is only one component of total rewards at Stanley Black & Decker. ​

  • The salary range listed in this job posting reflects the range for the primary location specified. The salary range may vary for other locations.​

  • The successful candidate may be eligible for annual merit increases. ​

  • Medical, dental, life, vision, disability,401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being. ​

  • Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tool sand other partner programs.

We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.

Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.


Who We Are

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.


What You’ll Also Get

Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.


Benefits & Perks

You’ll get a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits plan that includes medical, dental, life, vision, wellness program, disability, retirement benefits, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Paid Time Off, including paid vacation, holidays & personal days, and tuition reimbursement. And, of course, discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and products and well as discount programs for many other vendors and partners.


Learning & Development:
Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).


Diverse & Inclusive Culture:
We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.


Purpose-Driven Company:
You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.


EEO Statement:
All qualified applicants to Stanley Black & Decker are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran’s status or any other protected characteristic.


If you require reasonable accommodation to complete an application or access our website, please contact us at (860) 827-3923 or at . Due to volume, we cannot respond to unrelated inquiries about the status of a completed application or resetting an account password.


Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal (eeoc.gov)

Any information provided will be kept confidentially other than as required to make the necessary WOTC disclosures and in accordance with applicable laws.

We are seeking a Full-Stack AI Engineer to build and evolve an AI-powered software development environment using Kiro (or similar agentic AI platforms). In this role you will be a hands-on engineer who implements the platform’s core components, reusable frameworks, and AI-assisted workflows, enabling Product, Design, Engineering, and Business teams to collaboratively build applications faster and with consistent quality. You will work within the architectural direction set by the platform’s architects and contribute to technical decisions, while owning the delivery of features end to end.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic Development Platform

  • Build and maintain components of an enterprise-grade agentic development environment using Kiro or similar platforms.
  • Implement multi-agent workflows that support requirements generation, design, code generation, testing, and documentation.
  • Contribute to scalable development patterns and reusable frameworks for application delivery.

Rapid Prototyping & AI-Assisted Development

  • Develop MVPs and proofs of concept, working closely with Product and Design partners.
  • Turn business requirements and natural language inputs into user stories, technical designs, UI prototypes, and working applications.
  • Iterate on and refine concepts through AI-assisted development cycles, gathering stakeholder feedback along the way.

Full-Stack Engineering & Reusability

  • Build and maintain reusable assets, including:
    • Application templates and starter kits
    • Angular component libraries
    • NestJS/Node.js service frameworks
    • AI agent workflows and prompt libraries
  • Apply and promote consistent architecture and coding standards across teams.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code, and participate actively in code reviews.

AI Agent Integration

  • Implement and tune workflows involving requirements, design, code generation, testing, and documentation agents.
  • Integrate LLM-based tools into the software delivery lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines.
  • Evaluate AI-generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability, and improve prompts and workflows based on results.

Adoption & Quality

  • Help implement governance, security, quality controls, and validation processes for AI-generated artifacts.
  • Contribute to workshops, demos, and documentation, and mentor mid-level and junior developers.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in NestJS, TypeScript, and Angular.

  • Experience building or contributing to developer platforms, internal tools, accelerators, or platform engineering solutions.

  • Working knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps practices, and automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end).
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders and communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, agentic AI platforms, or multi-agent frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kiro.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, MCP (Model Context Protocol) architectures, or AI orchestration platforms.
  • Background in Developer Experience (DevEx), Platform Engineering, or Internal Developer Platforms (IDP).
  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems and reusable UI libraries.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to AI adoption and innovation programs.

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

raw.description:
Join ICOMAT – Revolutionising the Future of Lightweight Manufacturing!

iCOMAT is an advanced manufacturing company that invented Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) - the only proven technology for producing defect-free curved-fiber composite parts at industrial scale. We deliver the lightest structures possible for aerospace, automotive, defense, and space, at a rate and cost efficiency that far exceeds existing composite production processes.

We build and operate automated factories for composite materials, delivering components to Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs. The business has three main divisions: development of automated production machines, development of software design and production tools, and operation of the factory. We work with 25+ customers and completed the largest ever Series A in composites manufacturing to fuel a significant scale-up, with growth plans that will see the business multiply in size over the next two to three years and expand operations into the UK, Europe and the US.

The business has currently more than 130,000 sqm of production capacity with manufacturing facilities in the UK (Gloucester and Swindon) and the US (Dayton, Ohio); a Hardware R&D Centre in Bristol, UK; and a Software R&D Centre in Athens, Greece.

We are hiring a Director of Applied AI to turn that data advantage into compounding business value, fast. Series B is the moment to prove that AI is not a story we tell. It is a measurable engine inside the company.

What will you be doing?

  • Quality control. Move from reactive inspection to predictive quality, with AI assisted in process monitoring and automated root cause analysis.

  • Design. Reduce design iteration time, automate repetitive engineering decisions, and unlock generative design where it pays.

  • Tooling. Accelerate tool design, optimize tool life, and bring intelligence to tool path generation.

  • Manufacturing. Improve throughput, reduce scrap, predict defects before they happen, close the loop between machine data and process control.

What success looks like?

You do not produce papers. You ship working systems and you measure them in the language the business already speaks.

  • Time saved per design cycle.

  • Cost per part reduced.

  • Defect rate, scrap rate, and rework hours reduced.

  • Throughput per machine, per shift, per facility increased.

  • Engineering hours redirected from repetitive tasks to high leverage work.

  • MVPs shipped, retired, or scaled, with a clear scoreboard.

If we cannot quantify it, we do not call it success. AI for the sake of AI is not why we are hiring.

What will you own?

  • The AI strategy and roadmap, owned end to end and reviewed with the CEO.

  • A small, sharp portfolio of MVPs running in parallel across design, manufacturing, tooling, and QC.

  • The data architecture decisions that make AI possible across the product lifecycle, in close partnership with the software team and IT.

  • Tooling and model selection. Build, buy, fine tune, or wrap. You make the call on what is fastest to value.

  • A KPI dashboard the senior leadership team uses to track AI driven gains in real money and real time.

  • Year one: hire one to two operators alongside you if and only if the work demands it.

How you fit in?

  • Work alongside the Software Engineering and IT teams to design world-class data architecture, tools and processes that support the global adoption of iCOMAT’s Rapid Tow Shearing technology.

  • Lead the development of iCOMAT’s AI Engineering team and grow the capability in line with the growth of the company.

  • Support the work of the Structures Engineering, RTS Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering teams, unlocking productivity gains and delivering measurable impact.

  • Work closely with the Senior Leadership Team to align AI initiatives to the wider company goals.

  • Report progress directly to the CEO and collaborate on all aspects of the AI Roadmap.

Who you are?

  • A builder. You ship. You break things on purpose to learn faster than everyone around you.

  • Senior individual contributor and player coach. You write code, design systems, and lead by example. You are not allergic to a whiteboard or a shop floor.

  • You have shipped applied machine learning solutions in a real industrial, manufacturing, robotics, or hard tech setting. Not just dashboards. Not just demos.

  • You speak fluent KPI. You can defend an AI investment in front of a board with numbers, not adjectives.

  • You collaborate without ego with software, IT, design, manufacturing, tooling, and QC leaders. You are aligned and accountable.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast cadence, and ownership. Excuses do not ship parts. Execution does.

  • You have MLOps and production deployment experience at scale.

Great plus:

  • Background in composites, advanced manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, or defense.

  • Experience with computer vision applied to automated inspection, generative design, reinforcement learning for process control.

  • Prior experience standing up an AI function from zero inside a fast moving company.

Our Values: Uncompromising Excellence

  • Discipline over excuses. We commit. We follow through. We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standard, especially when the pressure is on.

  • Push the edge. iCOMAT was built on a refusal to accept that curved fiber could not be manufactured at scale. We innovate where others hesitate.

  • Aligned and accountable. Everyone owns their lane, communicates openly, and delivers without being chased. No silos. No ambiguity.

Why iCOMAT?

  • Competitive Salary & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including private healthcare, pension scheme.

  • Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

  • Career Growth Opportunities: Join us at a pivotal time as we scale up, offering unmatched professional growth opportunities in the rapidly advancing field of composite materials.

  • Innovation-Focused Culture: We pride ourselves on our inclusive, forward-thinking work environment. Recognized by Bloomberg as a "UK Startup to Watch," iCOMAT celebrates diversity and encourages all applicants, regardless of background, to apply.

  • Global Impact: Be a part of our mission to redefine lightweight structures for the automotive, aerospace, and space industries, working with some of the most influential companies worldwide.Ready to be part of something big?

Apply now to learn more and join us on our exciting journey!

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

Dragonfli Group is a cybersecurity and IT consulting firm providing services to federal agencies and Fortune 100 enterprises. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Dragonfli supports clients in securing mission-critical systems across on-site, hybrid, and fully remote environments.

Dragonfli Group is seeking two Fraud Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join a cybersecurity analytics team supporting a large federal agency. This is a fully remote role. You will apply AI and machine learning analytics to large volumes of data from disparate sources to uncover cybersecurity threats and fraud schemes, build analytic solutions in Databricks using Python, SQL, and R, and translate complex findings into clear reporting for stakeholders at every level. The ideal candidate brings a minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in fraud analytics, data science, or AI/ML applied to security or fraud detection, and the curiosity to find gaps in systems and processes and recommend practical remediation.

This is a multi-year contract position involving a large US federal agency. Candidates with previous federal contracting experience are preferred. U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency is required. If hired, all work related to this role must be performed within the continental U.S.

Job responsibilities:

  • Apply AI/ML analytic approaches to large volumes of data from disparate sources to uncover cybersecurity threats and fraud schemes against the organization.
  • Develop analytic solutions in Databricks using Python, SQL, and R to create, interpret, visualize, and report on complex data.

raw.excerpt: About Wanta Thome We are results-driven employment lawyers who help individuals navigate employment disputes, secure rightful compensation, and foster equitable work environments with our expert legal representation.
raw.description:
About Wanta Thome

We are results-driven employment lawyers who help individuals navigate employment disputes, secure rightful compensation, and foster equitable work environments with our expert legal representation. We are dedicated to making a positive impact through our legal expertise, tireless commitment to clients, and passion for championing equity. By working together, we aim to be catalysts for change and give a voice to those facing injustice. Our mission is a more just workplace and society for all through employee advocacy.

The role

You will be the front door of the firm. Every inbound call comes to you first. Your job is to answer quickly and warmly, find out who the caller is and what they need, and get them to the right person on our team, every time, without guessing. You will also make sure every call and every web inquiry is recorded accurately in our CRM (HubSpot) so nothing falls through the cracks.

This is a reception and routing role. You will not give legal advice and you will not conduct intake interviews. You will be trained on our scripts, routing rules, and systems, and you will be held to clear, measurable standards.

This is a remote, independent contractor position, open to candidates living in Belize, Costa Rica, Jamaica, or Mexico. Shifts are scheduled between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time, so the phone line has full coverage during business hours.

What you will do

  • Answer all inbound calls on our cloud phone system (3CX) using the firm greeting, within two rings whenever possible.
  • Identify each caller: a potential new client, an existing client, opposing counsel or a court, a vendor, or other.
  • Route potential new clients to an available Intake Paralegal by warm transfer. When no one is available, capture basic contact information and the general nature of the call, and create a follow-up task in HubSpot so an Intake Paralegal calls them back.
  • Route existing clients to the paralegal or case manager assigned to their matter, following the firm's client call routing protocol, even when the caller asks for the attorney by name.
  • Recognize and escalate true emergencies immediately according to firm protocol.
  • Log every call in HubSpot, create or update contact records, and avoid duplicates.
  • Process website inquiry forms within 15 minutes of submission and route them to the appropriate team.
  • Take clear, accurate messages and route them through HubSpot tasks or Microsoft Teams.
  • Maintain HubSpot data quality during slower periods (duplicate checks, missing fields, stale records), following firm procedures.
  • Coordinate coverage with the other receptionists so the phone line is never unattended during business hours.

What this role does not include

  • Giving legal advice or opinions about whether someone has a case
  • Conducting intake interviews or collecting documents from callers
  • Handling physical mail, deliveries, or visitors

What you need to succeed

  • Native or near-native spoken and written English, with a clear, professional phone voice
  • At least 2 years of experience in a phone-based role: call center, customer service, reception, or front desk
  • Calm, empathetic communication with callers who may be upset, emotional, or frustrated
  • Strong judgment and discipline in following procedures exactly, including knowing when to take a message instead of guessing
  • Accurate typing and data entry while talking
  • Comfort learning new software quickly (HubSpot, cloud phone systems, Microsoft Teams)
  • Absolute discretion: you will hear confidential and sensitive information every day

Preferred

  • Experience at a law firm, medical office, or other setting handling confidential information
  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or another CRM
  • Experience with 3CX or another VoIP phone system

Home office requirements

  • A quiet, private workspace free of background noise, where calls cannot be overheard
  • Reliable wired internet of at least 10 Mbps upload and download
  • A backup internet connection (such as a mobile hotspot) for outages
  • The Firm will provide a laptop and headset

How success is measured

  • Call answer rate of 99% or higher during scheduled hours
  • Calls answered within two rings
  • Web inquiries processed within 15 minutes
  • 100% of calls logged in HubSpot with required fields complete
  • Positive feedback in regular call quality reviews

Compensation

  • Rate: US$6 to US$8 per hour, depending on experience, paid to you as an independent contractor

raw.description:
Technical Delivery Lead (East Coast, US)

Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.

We Care Deeply

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership

Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Technical Delivery Leadat Lateral, you’ll be the connective tissue between our clients’ business goals and the technology we build to achieve them. You won’t be the most technical person in the room but you’ll understand technology well enough to guide the conversation, translate between business and engineering, and ensure that what we deliver genuinely moves the needle.

You will:

  • Partner with client stakeholders to understand their business objectives, metrics, and value drivers.

  • Translate those into actionable project scopes, delivery plans, and clear technical requirements.

  • Work closely with engineers, architects, and designers to align on approach, priorities, and constraints, turning business outcomes into deliverable features.

  • Serve as the main technical point of contact for the client: set expectations, surface risks early, and ensure communication is transparent, structured, and human.

  • Track delivery not just by milestones and dates, but by business impact, measuring whether the solution achieves its intended outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities for improvement or expansion by helping clients see where technology can generate additional value.

  • Champion clarity and accountability across distributed teams. Facilitate conversations that keep everyone focused on what matters most.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for thoughtful operators with both business sense and technical fluency. You must bring:

  • 7+ years experience working in client-facing delivery roles (e.g., Technical PM, Delivery Lead, Product Owner, or similar) where you’ve been responsible for both understanding business needs and guiding technical execution.

  • The ability to speak both languages - you can talk tech: APIs, integrations, architecture, and delivery trade-offs with engineers, but also product/business

  • Proven experience translating business objectives into software deliverables - you’ve turned ambiguity into clear scopes, requirements, and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills: you help teams make good decisions quickly.

  • A background in software delivery environments, where projects are complex, multi-disciplinary, and business-critical.

  • Comfort working across time zones and cultures. Our teams are remote and globally distributed.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace.

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is

  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible

  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest

If this sounds like your kind of team and you’re ready to bring your craft to Lateral, we want to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Your resume

  • A short note about what excites you about this role

  • Links to your work: GitHub/ Code snippets, portfolio, architecture /design docs, blog posts, or anything that shows us how you think and build. Please don’t include anything sensitive or proprietary. If you’re sharing team projects, let us know what your specific contributions were.

We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.

  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.

  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics

  • Motivators and demotivators.

  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.

  • Be ready to discuss challenges you've overcome and lessons learned.

  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral's mission and values.

Step 3: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.
Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.

  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.

  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 4: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.

  • How you collaborate across disciplines.

  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.

  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.

  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 5: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you'll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information.

Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

Job Title: Grant Reviewer, Early Childhood Education (Interaction-Based Assessments)
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: Remote, United States
Employment Type: Part-Time, Independent Contractor (1099)
Engagement Type: Short-term, per grant competition; paid per application reviewed
Final Interview:

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring Grant Reviewers on behalf of the Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE), the District of Columbia's state education agency, for its Aligning Quality Across DC's Mixed Delivery System Through Interaction-Based Assessments grant competition. The competition focuses on program quality across the District's mixed delivery system of childcare and early learning programs, and OSSE is seeking qualified professionals with expertise in childcare and early learning to serve on its review panels.

Grant reviewers provide independent subject matter expertise to read, score, and comment on competitive grant applications submitted by local education agencies, schools, community-based organizations, and other eligible entities. All reviews are completed remotely in OSSE's online Enterprise Grants Management System (EGMS), and reviewer scores are used to recommend applications for funding. OSSE selects reviewers from the qualified pool and gives preference to reviewers who have satisfactorily completed reviews for its competitions in previous years.

Work Schedule

This is a remote, part-time assignment. Reviews are completed on your own schedule within each deadline. The approximate commitment for this competition is:

  • Orientation and EGMS training: a virtual webinar held approximately within two weeks of the engagement start date.
  • Review window: usually two weeks from the date applications are assigned, unless OSSE specifies otherwise.
  • Facilitated discussion (only if needed): a phone or video conference, usually about three business days after the scoring due date, held when panel scores differ significantly.
  • Approximate completion of reviewer work: December 4, 2026. Final dates are confirmed before orientation.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Complete OSSE's EGMS training and attend the virtual, grant-specific orientation webinar before reviewing any applications.
  2. Independently read and conduct a detailed review of each assigned application (typically two or more per competition) as one of three reviewers on an EGMS review panel, working remotely and separately.
  3. Apply childcare and early learning expertise to evaluate the quality, feasibility, and alignment of each applicant's plan, including the proposed use of interaction-based assessments across early learning settings.
  4. Complete a fully scored rubric for every section of each application, applying the established scoring criteria consistently and objectively.
  5. Write clear, constructive comments describing strengths and weaknesses that justify and align with the scores given. Reviews may be shared with applicants on request, with reviewer names and contact information removed.
  6. Base all scores and comments only on the content of each applicant's submission in EGMS.
  7. Submit all scores and comments in EGMS by the review deadline, usually two weeks from receiving the applications.
  8. Participate in a facilitated panel discussion by phone or video conference when scores differ significantly, then submit a final rubric with updated scores and comments reflecting any changes.
  9. Disclose any conflict of interest with applicant organizations and do not review any application where a conflict exists.
  10. Direct EGMS technical questions to the EGMS manual, the resources at grants.osse.dc.gov, or the EGMS call center at (202) 719-6500, and direct questions about the grant or about scoring to OSSE grant program staff.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher.
  • Professional expertise in the field or subject matter of childcare and early learning programs.
  • Reliable access to a computer, the internet, and a phone.
  • Availability for the full review process, including EGMS training, the orientation webinar, the complete review window, and a facilitated discussion if one is required.
  • No conflict of interest with any applicant organization in this competition, confirmed through a signed Conflict of Interest Form.
  • No unsatisfactory performance evaluation from past grant review work for OSSE or any other grant-making organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience reviewing competitive grant applications for OSSE or another government agency.
  • Familiarity with interaction-based assessments used to measure quality in childcare and early learning programs.

Compensation

  • $150 per application successfully reviewed. Reviewers are typically assigned two or more applications per competition.
  • Payment is made only after OSSE verifies successful completion of the entire review process: EGMS training, the orientation webinar, timely review and rigorous scoring of every assigned application in EGMS, and, if required, participation in a facilitated discussion with final scores submitted.
  • Payment is issued by Dhaka Technologies Limited Company by direct deposit or check within 30 calendar days of OSSE's verification.
  • Failure to complete timely, high-quality reviews will affect payment and will disqualify a reviewer from future assignments.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the qualifications should send their resume to with the job title in the email subject line. Your resume should show your degree and your experience in the field. Please also mention in your resume the grants you have reviewed previously, including the grant-making organization, the grant program, and the year. Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a Grant Reviewer Application and a Conflict of Interest Form before they are recommended to OSSE.

raw.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Data Science Extern at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

BetterHelp is looking for a Data Science Extern to help us scale and increase our impact. You will use data to drive insight into the product and business. The ideal candidate would have experience/exposure to analyzing large and complex data sets related to web products. You'll be doing plenty of data wrangling and post-hoc analysis, both to support product improvements, marketing efficiency, and business decisions.

What will you do?

  • Language Model Optimization: Engage in the refinement and enhancement of language models, including fine-tuning and retraining to meet specific requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Actively collaborate with the product and development teams to conceptualize and design effective machine learning models and algorithms tailored to our products' needs.
  • Product Enhancement Partnership: Work closely with product managers, initiating and implementing proactive strategies to elevate the functionality and user experience of our products.
  • Data Handling Expertise: Handle extensive text data, demonstrating proficiency in managing, analyzing, and deriving insights from large datasets.
  • Coding for Production: Develop and maintain production-ready code, ensuring robustness and efficiency. Collaborate with the DevOps and ML-Ops teams to integrate machine learning models seamlessly into production environments.
  • Database Proficiency: Write and optimize SQL queries, showcasing your ability to interact with and manipulate databases effectively.
  • Team Dynamics and Impact: Thrive in a team-oriented environment, contributing positively to the team spirit. Enjoy a fun and dynamic work culture while taking pride in developing a world-class product that significantly impacts people's lives

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a PhD program in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science/Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics,Operations Research, or Engineering
  • Completed coursework in NLP and LLM
  • Deep understanding of neural networks and deep learning and generative AI
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning
  • Experience building predictive models and causal inference models
  • Familiarity with generative AI
  • Experience analyzing large and complex data sets
  • Experience using tools like Pytorch(preferably) or Tensorflow
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and communicate technical ideas to non-technical audiences

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

The base salary range for this position is $40 - $60/hr. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

A Caju é uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia, que busca dar mais sabor à vida profissional, transformando a relação entre empresas e colaboradores por meio de soluções mais inovadoras e seguras como o Cartão Multi Benefícios, Solução em Despesas Corporativas e Premiações.

Buscando por novos talentos que queiram transformar o mundo de benefícios com soluções inovadoras. Aqui na Caju, aprendemos sempre, e nos tornamos cada vez melhores em um ambiente colaborativo e divertido!

Estamos buscando uma pessoa estagiária para o time de Revenue Operations da Caju. Você vai cuidar do dia a dia das ferramentas que o time comercial usa. Vai apoiar o ciclo de licenças, atender as dúvidas e os pedidos de acesso dos usuários e acompanhar as reuniões com os fornecedores. Também vai manter atualizados o inventário e os relatórios de adoção do stack. No Salesforce, você vai fazer configurações com supervisão, apoiar os testes de mudanças e documentar o que for construído, além de ajudar nos treinamentos e no registro das demandas da operação. É uma vaga para quem é organizado, curioso por sistemas e gosta de entender como as ferramentas funcionam por dentro, e um ótimo ponto de partida para quem quer construir carreira em RevOps.

São muito bem-vindas candidaturas de pessoas negras, mulheres, indígenas, LGBTQIA+, ou outros grupos minorizados. 🧡

Inscreva-se e conheça mais sobre nosso time 🧡

Operação do stack

  • Apoiar o ciclo de licenças: executar as ativações e desativações quinzenais e acompanhar as renovações automáticas
  • Atender o primeiro nível (N1) das ferramentas: gerenciar acessos e tirar dúvidas de uso, registrando tudo de forma estruturada e escalando para o time quando necessário
  • Acompanhar as reuniões com o CS das ferramentas e registrar novidades de produto e boas práticas
  • Apoiar a montagem dos relatórios mensais de adoção por time e por gestor: uso real versus licenças ativas
  • Manter o inventário do stack atualizado: custo, licenças contratadas × licenças ativas × uso de fato, e status de renovação

CRM

  • Executar configurações simples no Salesforce, com supervisão: campos, picklists, relatórios e dashboards
  • Apoiar os testes de mudanças na trilha sandbox → homologação → produção, com registro
  • Documentar configurações e processos das ferramentas

Treinamento e demandas

  • Apoiar os treinamentos das ferramentas (onboarding e reciclagem) e montar materiais de apoio
  • Receber demandas da operação e registrar no backlog do time

  • Cursando Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins, com previsão de formatura a partir de 2028
  • Disponibilidade de 6h por dia
  • Organização e disciplina com rotinas recorrentes
  • Planilhas (Excel/Google Sheets) em nível básico a intermediário
  • Curiosidade por sistemas: gostar de entender como uma ferramenta funciona por dentro e de fuçar configuração
  • Boa comunicação escrita
  • Capacidade de documentar o que faz

Informações adicionais

Diferenciais:

  • Contato prévio com Salesforce, mesmo que só em Trailhead
  • Noção de SQL ou de ferramentas de BI
  • Curiosidade por automação no-code (n8n, Zapier, Make)
  • Inglês para leitura de documentação técnica

raw.excerpt: About the RoleA great GTM strategy only matters if it changes what happens in the field.
raw.description:
About the Role

A great GTM strategy only matters if it changes what happens in the field. Turning insight into consistent behavior and predictable outcomes is the work, and at Abnormal we want to do it the AI-native way.

As Senior Director, Field Operations, you will own how our entire revenue organization plans, executes, and scales. This is a second-line leadership role: you will lead and develop a team of Field Operations leaders and their teams, and set the operating model they run across our Mid-Market, Enterprise, Strategic, and Channel organizations. You will sit at the intersection of GTM strategy, systems, and field execution, making sure the plans, rhythms, and tools the business relies on lead to better decisions and predictable outcomes at every level. You will work hand in hand with the leaders of Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Channel, Finance, and GTM Operations, and bring a clear point of view on where the field should go next.

Our platform is expanding beyond email into identity and AI security, and our field motions are getting more varied with it: new segments, new partner paths, and more products in every conversation. That complexity is the opportunity. This is a role for a builder and a leader who wants to design modern operating models that balance speed, precision, and scale, develop the next generation of operations leaders, and help Abnormal lead in the age of AI.

What You Will Do

  • Lead leaders. Lead, coach, and develop a team of Field Operations managers and directors, set priorities across the function, and build a bench of future leaders with clear succession plans.
  • Own the operating model. Define and evolve the field operating model across segments, regions, and channel, building scalable, repeatable frameworks that hold up as the business grows up-market and through partners.
  • Turn strategy into field execution. Partner with the CRO and GTM leadership on annual and quarterly planning, including targets, capacity, coverage, territories, and quotas, and translate the plan into clear execution across every sales organization.
  • Make the forecast something leaders trust. Own the accuracy and consistency of global sales forecasting through standardized processes, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled forecasting approaches, and present forecast insight to executive leadership.
  • Own the field operating rhythm. Set the cadence for pipeline and forecast reviews, inspection, QBR inputs, and performance dashboards across the organization.
  • Raise the bar on process and execution. Drive sales process and execution excellence across the full funnel, supporting evolving motions across segments and channel-assisted deals.
  • Lead strategic planning and resource allocation. Guide territory, capacity, and coverage design and segmentation models across multiple teams and regions, in partnership with Sales leadership, including change management at scale.
  • Make our systems work for the field. Partner with RevOps and Systems leaders so GTM tools (e.g., Salesforce, forecasting, engagement, and analytics platforms) support how the field sells and inspects work.
  • Put AI to work. Collaborate with internal AI development teams to launch AI-driven solutions that improve pipeline precision and reduce manual CRM effort, and set the standard for how AI shows up in field operations.
  • Co-lead cross-functional initiatives. Guide new segment launches, partner motions, and pricing or packaging changes from planning through adoption across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Channel, and Finance.
  • Be a strategic partner to executive leadership. Provide data-backed recommendations, highlight risks and tradeoffs, and help prioritize across competing initiatives.

Must Haves

  • 12+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or related GTM functions within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • 6+ years of experience leading and scaling operations, analytics, or GTM teams, including experience managing managers and developing other leaders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience defining metrics and translating complex data into actionable insights for executive audiences.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing scalable operating frameworks across forecasting, pipeline health, territory and coverage, and sales process, across multiple teams, segments, or regions.
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI, advanced analytics, or automation to redesign operating models.
  • Deep familiarity with GTM systems and data, including Salesforce and related analytics or forecasting tools.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience influencing senior GTM leaders and executives and managing change across teams.
  • Experience with strategic planning and execution, including territory design, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous environments while maintaining high execution standards.
  • A continuous improvement mindset focused on balancing short-term execution with long-term scale.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting channel partner motions and partner-influenced forecasting and pipeline inspection.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted forecasting tools or predictive pipeline health frameworks.
  • Experience in companies scaling from Mid-Market into Enterprise or Strategic segments.
  • Experience leading cross-functional operating model changes across multiple GTM functions (Sales, Marketing, CS, Channel).

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$229,500—$330,000 USD

Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. raw.description:
What Supplier Enrollment and Credentialing contributes to Cardinal Health

Cardinal Health at-Home Solutions is seeking an experienced professional to lead Medicare enrollment and credentialing for Edgepark, Advanced Diabetes Supply (ADS), US Med, United States Medical Supply (USMS), and Strive Medical. As Sr. Advisor, Supplier Enrollment & Credentialing, you will serve as the subject matter expert and accountable owner for Medicare DMEPOS credentialing and enrollment across all five DMEPOS companies, ensuring each business remains compliant, in good standing, and able to serve patients without interruption.


Job Summary

This individual contributor role requires a seasoned professional who can navigate complex regulatory environments, anticipate evolving CMS requirements, and operate with both independence and strategic perspective. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands on experience successfully completing Medicare DMEPOS supplier enrollments, knowledge of National Provider Enrollment contractors and DMEPOS supplier standards, an unwavering commitment to compliance, and the executive presence to advise senior leadership and represent the organization with CMS contractors and accrediting bodies.


Responsibilities

  • Own and independently execute end-to-end Medicare enrollment for all five DMEPOS entities, including initial enrollments, revalidations, changes of information, location openings and closures, and changes of ownership through CMS-855S, PECOS, and NPPES.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Palmetto GBA, Novitas, and the DME MACs on enrollment matters, site visits, and deficiency responses.
  • Ensure that every entity and location remains compliant with DMEPOS supplier standards, accreditation requirements, certificates of insurance liabilities, surety bond obligations, and state licensure requirements.
  • Proactively manage revalidation cycles, deadlines, PTANs, and NPI records to prevent disruptions to billing privileges.
  • Lead responses to revocations, deactivations, requests for information, and corrective action plans, including appropriate application appeals and reconsiderations when needed.
  • Develop enrollment strategies, timelines, and risk assessments for acquisitions, new site launches, and other business changes.
  • Monitor CMS regulatory updates and industry developments, assess their impact, and recommend appropriate business responses.
  • Develop and maintain credentialing policies, procedures, tracking tools, and documentation to keep the organization audit ready.
  • Identify enrollment risks early and provide leadership with clear, practical recommendations.
  • Present status updates, risks, and strategic recommendations to senior leaders with clarity and confidence.
  • Partner closely with Compliance, Legal, Regulatory, Revenue Cycle, and Operations to align requirements and priorities.
  • Drive continuous improvement and standardization of enrollment processes across all entities.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Medicare provider or supplier enrollment, including direct, hands-on experience successfully completing DMEPOS enrollment for a multi-entity or multi-location organization preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience preferred; CPCS, CPMSM, or similar certification is a plus.
  • Substantial experience with governmental credentialing and enrollment processes for, suppliers or institutions is essential, including direct interaction with federal or state agencies and their contractors.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Medicare DMEPOS enrollment, including CMS-855S, PECOS, NPPES, supplier standards, accreditation, surety bonds, revalidations, and changes of ownership.
  • Direct experience managing Medicare DMEPOS supplier enrollments, either within a DME supplier organization—or with CMS, Palmetto GBA, Novitas, or a DME MAC—is strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex regulatory environments and remain current on evolving CMS requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and think strategically about enrollment risk and business impact.
  • Strong compliance mindset, with meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Executive presence and the ability to communicate complex regulatory topics clearly to senior leaders.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of deadline-driven work across competing priorities.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions or developing multi-entity enrollment strategies is a plus.

Anticipated salary range: $89,000 - $147,550

Bonus eligible: Yes

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Application window anticipated to close: 01/04/2027 *if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.


The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

About Us

The Role

We are looking for an experienced UX Designer to join our Strategy & Foundations team, embedded in a strategic product program for one of the world's leading dealership management software providers.

You will collaborate closely with our Digital Strategist, User Researcher, Service Designer, and Technical Architect to translate research insight and strategic thinking into tangible, testable product concepts across multiple product areas. You'll collaborate regularly with stakeholders and customers across the UK and US.

Paired is a global recruiting agency that connects talented professionals with remote opportunities at companies around the world. Our mission is to help people find great jobs, wherever they are.

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the action sports and camera-mounting space. Its products help riders and athletes capture footage across motorcycle, motocross, mountain biking, cycling, snow sports, automotive, and other action sports.

Paid social is a major driver of the brand’s growth, and creative is one of its biggest opportunities to improve performance.

About Our Client

We’re looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to own the strategy behind paid social creative across Meta and other performance channels. You’ll use performance data, customer research, and clear hypotheses to decide what the team should produce next—and why.

You’ll build a steady pipeline of new concepts, turn insights into actionable briefs, and help the team identify and scale winning creative. This role focuses on performance creative strategy. It does not involve managing social media or buying media, and it goes beyond making content look good.

Responsibilities

  • Own the creative strategy for paid social across Meta and other performance channels.
  • Maintain a consistent pipeline of new concepts and variations for testing.
  • Review creative performance to identify winning hooks, formats, angles, products, audiences, and offers—and translate those findings into clear next steps.
  • Write detailed briefs for video ads, static ads, UGC, founder-led content, and product demos.
  • Develop hooks, scripts, headlines, calls to action, and messaging angles.
  • Collaborate with creators, video editors, designers, media buyers, and the founder to bring concepts to life.
  • Research customers, reviews, support conversations, competitors, trends, and adjacent markets to uncover creative insights.
  • Structure tests so the team can clearly understand what changed, why it changed, and what was learned.
  • Monitor creative fatigue and plan replacements before performance declines.
  • Adapt winning concepts across products, formats, audiences, and markets.
  • Keep concepts accurate to the products and on brand while moving the creative roadmap forward.

Requirements

  • Experience developing creative strategy for a performance-driven e-commerce brand or agency. This is the core requirement.
  • Strong understanding of Meta advertising and direct-response creative.
  • Ability to interpret ad performance data and use it to make creative decisions, not just produce reports.
  • Understanding of hooks, awareness levels, customer objections, offers, positioning, and purchase motivation.
  • Ability to distinguish a genuinely new concept from a minor visual variation.
  • Experience writing briefs, hooks, scripts, and ad concepts, and collaborating with creators, editors, designers, or media buyers.
  • Comfort giving clear, specific feedback and receiving direct feedback in return.
  • Strong organization across multiple products, audiences, and tests.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Experience in action sports, motorcycles, cycling, cameras, or enthusiast products is a plus, but not required.

What Success Looks Like

  • The creative team knows what to produce next and why.
  • New concepts are ready before the pipeline runs dry, and briefs are clear enough to execute without unnecessary back-and-forth.
  • Creative decisions are backed by data, customer research, or a clear hypothesis.
  • Winning concepts are identified, analysed, and expanded quickly.
  • Failed tests still provide useful insights.
  • The number of profitable, scalable creatives increases over time.
  • Products are represented accurately, without misleading claims.
  • Creative output becomes more consistent without losing quality.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary (USD)
  • Work From Home
  • Flexible hours

raw.description:
The Manager, Revenue Operations leads the Revenue Operations function, owning the technology, processes, data, and reporting that enable the Marketing, Sales, Channel, and Support organizations to operate efficiently and effectively. his role also serves as a core business planning partner, supporting channel and partner performance, quota and compensation planning, and pricing and packaging decisions.

Beyond designing and maintaining revenue systems, this role is a key business partner to leadership: analyzing pipeline health, sales performance, conversion, forecast accuracy, and customer trends, and translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. The role works closely with Marketing, Sales, and Support Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to ensure the organization has accurate data, effective processes, and the insights needed to achieve revenue goals.

Responsibilities
Revenue Strategy, Analytics & Insights
  • Serve as a strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Support, Finance, and executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations that drive revenue growth and operational efficiency.
  • Analyze revenue and customer data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance gaps by segment, geography, product, source, and sales representative.
  • Build and maintain dashboards covering pipeline generation and coverage, conversion rates, sales velocity, win/loss, bookings, retention, expansion, and forecast performance.
  • Define and monitor KPIs aligned with company objectives; analyze performance against targets and identify the drivers of over- or under-performance.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to analyze funnel performance and improve conversion, velocity, and revenue efficiency.
  • Conduct ad hoc analysis and modeling to answer key business questions and support planning and strategic decisions.
Forecasting & Pipeline Management
  • Own and continuously improve the revenue forecasting process, ensuring forecasts are accurate, consistent, and grounded in reliable data.
  • Analyze pipeline health, coverage, aging, velocity, and stage progression to flag stalled or at-risk opportunities and risks to revenue targets.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to understand forecast gaps and develop actionable plans to close them.
Business Planning & Go-to-Market Analysis
  • Analyze channel, partner, and distributor performance, including partner-sourced pipeline, partner productivity, and distributor sell-through, and recommend actions to grow the partner ecosystem.
  • Lead annual and quarterly quota setting, territory design, and sales capacity planning, aligned with the fiscal-year planning calendar.
  • Model, design, and administer sales compensation plans in partnership with Finance and HR, including analysis of plan cost, attainment distribution, and ramp policies for new hires.
  • Support pricing and packaging decisions with analysis of deal size, discounting, win rates, and competitive positioning.
  • Analyze product and license usage data (e.g., migration volumes and license utilization) to identify expansion, renewal, and churn signals.
Revenue Technology & Systems
  • Own the revenue technology roadmap and direct the administration of Salesforce.com and other revenue platforms (Marketo, Outreach, Microsoft Power BI, Zendesk), working hands-on where needed while delegating day-to-day administration.
  • Lead the design and implementation of new features, functionality, and processes; provide technical options and estimates for change requests.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and support technology solutions and integrations that improve productivity, data quality, and reporting.
  • Ensure systems capture the data needed for reporting, analysis, and forecasting, and document platform best practices to maintain data integrity.
Process & Operational Excellence
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Support Operations to deliver scalable solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline revenue processes, eliminate inefficiencies, and automate manual workflows.
  • Establish standardized definitions, methodologies, and data governance practices so revenue data is accurate, consistent, and reliable.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve revenue productivity, efficiency, and scalability.
Leadership & Communication
  • Lead, mentor, and develop the Revenue Operations team, which initially includes Salesforce/systems administration support, and shape the team’s structure and skill mix as the function grows, setting priorities aligned with company and revenue objectives.
  • Regularly present revenue performance, trends, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, translating data into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Balance multiple strategic initiatives with immediate business needs.
